verses.original: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦਝਿ ਮੁਈ ਗਾਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: soohai ves pir kinai na paio manmukh dhajh muiee gaavaar ||
verses.translation: By wearing her red dress, no one has found her Husband Lord; the self-willed manmukh is burnt to death.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai soohaa ves giaa haumai vichahu maar ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, she discards her red dress, and eradicates egotism from within.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rataa laal hoaa rasanaa ratee gun saar ||
verses.translation: Her mind and body are imbued with the deep red color of His Love, and her tongue is imbued, singing His Praises and excellences.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sohaagan sabadh man bhai bhai kare seegaar ||
verses.translation: She becomes His soul-bride forever, with the Word of the Shabad in her mind; she makes the Fear of God and the Love of God her ornaments and decorations.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak karamee mahal paiaa pir raakhiaa ur dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Merciful Grace, she obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and keeps Him enshrined in her heart. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸੂਹਾ ਪਰਹਰਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhe soohaa paraharahu laal karahu seegaar ||
verses.translation: O bride, forsake your red dress, and decorate yourself with the crimson color of His Love.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa veesarai gur sabadhee veechaar ||
verses.translation: Your comings and goings shall be forgotten, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh suhaavee sohanee jis ghar sahaj bhataar ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is adorned and beautiful; the Celestial Lord, her Husband, abides in her home.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਰਾਵੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saa dhan raaveeaai raave raavanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the bride ravishes and enjoys Him; and He, the Ravisher, ravishes and enjoys her. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: moh kooR kuTa(n)b hai manmukh mugadh rataa ||
verses.translation: The foolish, self-willed manmukh is engrossed in false attachment to family.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਲਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa kar mue kichh saath na litaa ||
verses.translation: Practicing egotism and self-conceit, he dies and departs, taking nothing along with him.

verses.original: ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sir upar jamakaal na sujhiee dhoojai bharamitaa ||
verses.translation: He does not understand that the Messenger of Death is hovering over his head; he is deluded by duality.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: fir velaa hath na aaviee jamakaal vas kitaa ||
verses.translation: This opportunity will not come into his hands again; the Messenger of Death will seize him.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਿਤਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jehaa dhur likh paion se karam kamitaa ||5||
verses.translation: He acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜੋ ਮੜਿਆ ਲਗਿ ਜਲੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: sateeaa eh na aakheean jo maRiaa lag jala(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: Do not call them 'satee', who burn themselves along with their husbands' corpses.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿੑ ਜਿ ਬਿਰਹੇ ਚੋਟ ਮਰੰਨਿੑ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sateeaa jaaneeani(h) j birahe choT mara(n)ni(h) ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone are known as 'satee', who die from the shock of separation. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: bhee so sateeaa jaaneean seel sa(n)tokh raha(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: They are also known as 'satee', who abide in modesty and contentment.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੰਨਿੑ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sevan saiee aapanaa nit uTh sa(n)m(h)aala(n)ni(h) ||2||
verses.translation: They serve their Lord, and rise in the early hours to contemplate Him. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)taa naal maheleeaa setee ag jalaeh ||
verses.translation: The widows burn themselves in the fire, along with their husbands' corpses.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: je jaaneh pir aapanaa taa tan dhukh sahaeh ||
verses.translation: If they truly knew their husbands, then they suffer terrible bodily pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ka(n)t na jaananee se kiau ag jalaeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if they did not truly know their husbands, why should they burn themselves in the fire?

verses.original: ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਉ ਕੈ ਮਰਉ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhaavai jeevau kai marau dhoorahu hee bhaj jaeh ||3||
verses.translation: Whether their husbands are alive or dead, those wives remain far away from them. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh dhukh sukh naal upaiaa lekh karatai likhiaa ||
verses.translation: You created pain along with pleasure; O Creator, such is the writ You have written.

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡ ਹੋਰ ਦਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰਿਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naavai jevadd hor dhaat naahee tis roop na rikhiaa ||
verses.translation: There is no other gift as great as the Name; it has no form or sign.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam akhuT nidhaan hai gurmukh man vasiaa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is an inexhaustible treasure; it abides in the mind of the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa naam dhevasee fir lekh na likhiaa ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, He blesses us with the Naam, and then, the writ of pain and pleasure is not written.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sevak bhai se jan mile jin har jap japiaa ||6||
verses.translation: Those humble servants who serve with love, meet the Lord, chanting the Chant of the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਥਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jinee chalan jaaniaa se kiau kareh vithaar ||
verses.translation: They know that they will have to depart, so why do they make such ostentatious displays?

verses.original: ਚਲਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chalan saar na jaananee kaaj savaaranahaar ||1||
verses.translation: Those who do not know that they will have to depart, continue to arrange their affairs. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਭਲਕੇ ਚਲਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: raat kaaran dhan sa(n)cheeaai bhalake chalan hoi ||
verses.translation: He accumulates wealth during the night of his life, but in the morning, he must depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naal na chaliee fir pachhutaavaa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it shall not go along with him, and so he regrets. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਧਾ ਚਟੀ ਜੋ ਭਰੇ ਨਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: badhaa chaTee jo bhare naa gun naa upakaar ||
verses.translation: Paying a fine under pressure, does not bring either merit or goodness.

verses.original: ਸੇਤੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: setee khusee savaareeaai naanak kaaraj saar ||3||
verses.translation: That alone is a good deed, O Nanak, which is done by one's own free will. ||3||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਤਰਫ ਨ ਜਿਪਈ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh taraf na jipiee je bahutaa ghaale ||
verses.translation: Stubborn-mindedness will not win the Lord to one's side, no matter how much it is tried.

verses.original: ਤਰਫ ਜਿਣੈ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ਦੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: taraf jinai sat bhaau dhe jan naanak sabadh veechaare ||4||
verses.translation: The Lord is won over to your side, by offering Him your true love, O servant Nanak, and contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: karatai kaaran jin keeaa so jaanai soiee ||
verses.translation: The Creator created the world; He alone understands it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape sirasaT upaieean aape fun goiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself shall destroy it afterwards.

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jug chaare sabh bhav thakee kin keemat hoiee ||
verses.translation: All have grown weary of wandering throughout the four ages, but none know the Lord's worth.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur ek vikhaaliaa man tan sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has shown me the One Lord, and my mind and body are at peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa salaaheeaai karataa kare su hoiee ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh praises the Lord forever; that alone happens, which the Creator Lord does. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ ਮੁਚੁ ਭਉ ਨਿਭਵਿਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa bhau tin(h) naeh bhau much bhau nibhaviaaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who have the Fear of God, have no other fears; those who do not have the Fear of God, are very afraid.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਪਟੰਤਰਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਗਇਆਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak eh paTa(n)taraa tit dheebaan giaaeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this mystery is revealed at the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਰਦੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਰਦਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਡਤੇ ਕਉ ਉਡਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: turadhe kau turadhaa milai uddate kau uddataa ||
verses.translation: That which flows, mingles with that which flows; that which blows, mingles with that which blows.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੇ ਕਉ ਜੀਵਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeevate kau jeevataa milai mooe kau mooaa ||
verses.translation: The living mingle with the living, and the dead mingle with the dead.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so saalaaheeaai jin kaaran keeaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the One who created the creation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach dhiaain se sache gur sabadh veechaaree ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the True Lord are true; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar man niramalaa har naam ur dhaaree ||
verses.translation: They subdue their ego, purify their minds, and enshrine the Lord's Name within their hearts.

verses.original: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਪਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: koThe ma(n)ddap maaReeaa lag pe gaavaaree ||
verses.translation: The fools are attached to their homes, mansions and balconies.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿੑ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jini(h) ke'ee tiseh na jaananee manmukh gubaaree ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are caught in darkness; they do not know the One who created them.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਹਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jis bujhaieh so bujhasee sachiaa kiaa ja(n)t vichaaree ||8||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the True Lord causes to understand; what can the helpless creatures do? ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman tau seegaar kar jaa pahilaa(n) ka(n)t manai ||
verses.translation: O bride, decorate yourself, after you surrender and accept your Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਏਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mat sejai ka(n)t na aaviee evai birathaa jai ||
verses.translation: Otherwise, your Husband Lord will not come to your bed, and your ornaments will be useless.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman pir man maaniaa tau baniaa seegaar ||
verses.translation: O bride, your decorations will adorn you, only when your Husband Lord's Mind is pleased.

verses.original: ਕੀਆ ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: keeaa tau paravaan hai jaa sahu dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: Your ornaments will be acceptable and approved, only when your Husband Lord loves you.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਤਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhau seegaar tabol ras bhojan bhaau karei ||
verses.translation: So make the Fear of God your ornaments, joy your betel nuts to chew, and love your food.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tan man saupe ka(n)t kau tau naanak bhog karei ||1||
verses.translation: Surrender your body and mind to your Husband Lord, and then, O Nanak, He will enjoy you. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਜਲ ਫੂਲ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਲੇ ਧਨ ਕੀਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaajal fool ta(n)bol ras le dhan keeaa seegaar ||
verses.translation: The wife takes flowers, and fragrance of betel, and decorates herself.

verses.original: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਏਵੈ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sejai ka(n)t na aaio evai bhiaa vikaar ||2||
verses.translation: But her Husband Lord does not come to her bed, and so these efforts are useless. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਬਹਨਿ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan pir eh na aakheean bahan ikaThe hoi ||
verses.translation: They are not said to be husband and wife, who merely sit together.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek jot dhui mooratee dhan pir kaheeaai soi ||3||
verses.translation: They alone are called husband and wife, who have one light in two bodies. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bin bhagat na hoviee naam na lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship, and no love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai bhau uoopajai bhai bhai ra(n)g savaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the Fear of God wells up, and one is embellished with the Fear and the Love of God.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tan man rataa ra(n)g siau haumai tirasanaa maar ||
verses.translation: When the body and mind are imbued with the Lord's Love, egotism and desire are conquered and subdued.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal at sohanaa bheTiaa kirasan muraar ||
verses.translation: The mind and body become immaculately pure and very beautiful, when one meets the Lord, the Destroyer of ego.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bhau bhaau sabh tis dhaa so sach varatai sa(n)saar ||9||
verses.translation: Fear and love all belong to Him; He is the True Lord, permeating and pervading the Universe. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਖਸਮ ਤੂ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu khasam too vaahu jin rach rachanaa ham ke'ee ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! You are wonderful and great, O Lord and Master; You created the creation, and made us.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਰ ਵੇਲਿ ਵਰਸ ਵਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: saagar lahar samu(n)dh sar vel varas varaahu ||
verses.translation: You made the waters, waves, oceans, pools, plants, clouds and mountains.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਖੜੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੀਣੈ ਆਪਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap khaRoveh aap kar aapeenai aapaahu ||
verses.translation: You Yourself stand in the midst of what You Yourself created.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਮਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sevaa thai pavai unaman tat kamaahu ||
verses.translation: The selfless service of the Gurmukhs is approved; in celestial peace, they live the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਮਸਕਤਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਮਜੂਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਸਮ ਦਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: masakat lahahu majooreeaa ma(n)g ma(n)g khasam dharaahu ||
verses.translation: They receive the wages of their labor, begging at the Door of their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਰ ਦਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਤਉ ਦਰਿ ਊਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pur dhar veparavaeh tau dhar uoonaa naeh ko sachaa veparavaahu ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Court of the Lord is overflowing and carefree; O my True Carefree Lord, no one returns empty-handed from Your Court. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਰਤਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੁੜੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: aujal motee sohane ratanaa naal juRa(n)n ||
verses.translation: The teeth are like brilliant, beautiful pearls, and the eyes are like sparkling jewels.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਜਰੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਬੁਢੇ ਥੀਇ ਮਰੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin jar vairee naanakaa j budde theei mara(n)n ||2||
verses.translation: Old age is their enemy, O Nanak; when they grow old, they waste away. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har saalaahee sadhaa sadhaa tan man saup sareer ||
verses.translation: Praise the Lord, forever and ever; dedicate your body and mind to Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee sach paiaa sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the True, Profound and Unfathomable Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man tan hiradhai rav rahiaa har heeraa heer ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the jewel of jewels, is permeating my mind, body and heart.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਫੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran kaa dhukh giaa fir pavai na feer ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death are gone, and I shall never again be consigned to the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaeh too har gunee gaheer ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the ocean of excellence. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ih tan jaal jin jaliaai naam visaariaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, burn this body; this burnt body has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਉਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਿਵੰਧੈ ਤਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paudhee jai paraal pichhai hath na a(n)baRai tit niva(n)dhai taal ||1||
verses.translation: The dirt is piling up, and in the world hereafter, your hand shall not be able to reach down into this stagnant pond to clean it out. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਮ ਫਿਟਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak man ke ka(n)m fiTiaa ganat na aavahee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, wicked are the uncountable actions of the mind.

verses.original: ਕਿਤੀ ਲਹਾ ਸਹੰਮ ਜਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਾ ਧਕਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kitee lahaa saha(n)m jaa bakhase taa dhakaa nahee ||2||
verses.translation: They bring terrible and painful retributions, but if the Lord forgives me, then I will be spared this punishment. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa amar chalaion kar sach furamaan ||
verses.translation: True is the Command He sends forth, and True are the Orders He issues.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa nihachal rav rahiaa so purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: Forever unmoving and unchanging, permeating and pervading everywhere, He is the All-knowing Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee seveeaai sach sabadh neesaan ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, serve Him, through the True Insignia of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa thaaT banaiaa ra(n)g gurmat maan ||
verses.translation: That which He makes is perfect; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: agam agochar alakh hai gurmukh har jaan ||11||
verses.translation: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and unseen; as Gurmukh, know the Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਦਰਾ ਮਾਲ ਕਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਆਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak badharaa maal kaa bheetar dhariaa aan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the bags of coins are brought in

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khoTe khare parakheean saahib kai dheebaan ||1||
verses.translation: and placed in the Court of our Lord and Master, and there, the genuine and the counterfeit are separated. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਵਣ ਚਲੇ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਤਨਿ ਚੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: naavan chale teerathee man khoTai tan chor ||
verses.translation: They go and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but their minds are still evil, and their bodies are thieves.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਭਾਉ ਲਥੀ ਨਾਤਿਆ ਦੁਇ ਭਾ ਚੜੀਅਸੁ ਹੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik bhaau lathee naatiaa dhui bhaa chaReeas hor ||
verses.translation: Some of their filth is washed off by these baths, but they only accumulate twice as much.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਤੂਮੜੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: baahar dhotee toomaRee a(n)dhar vis nikor ||
verses.translation: Like a gourd, they may be washed off on the outside, but on the inside, they are still filled with poison.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਭਲੇ ਅਣਨਾਤਿਆ ਚੋਰ ਸਿ ਚੋਰਾ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadh bhale ananaatiaa chor s choraa chor ||2||
verses.translation: The holy man is blessed, even without such bathing, while a thief is a thief, no matter how much he bathes. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape hukam chalaidhaa jag dha(n)dhai laiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself issues His Commands, and links the people of the world to their tasks.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik aape hee aap laian gur te sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself joins some to Himself, and through the Guru, they find peace.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis ih man dhaavadhaa gur Thaak rahaiaa ||
verses.translation: The mind runs around in the ten directions; the Guru holds it still.

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naavai no sabh lochadhee gurmatee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs for the Name, but it is only found through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: dhur likhiaa meT na sakeeaai jo har likh paiaa ||12||
verses.translation: Your pre-ordained destiny, written by the Lord in the very beginning, cannot be erased. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਦੀਵੇ ਚਉਦਹ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhui dheeve chaudheh haTanaale ||
verses.translation: The two lamps light the fourteen markets.

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jete jeea tete vanajaare ||
verses.translation: There are just as many traders as there are living beings.

verses.original: ਖੁਲੑੇ ਹਟ ਹੋਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: khul(h)e haT hoaa vaapaar ||
verses.translation: The shops are open, and trading is going on;

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo pahuchai so chalanahaar ||
verses.translation: whoever comes there, is bound to depart.

verses.original: ਧਰਮੁ ਦਲਾਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharam dhalaal paae neesaan ||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is the broker, who gives his sign of approval.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam laahaa paravaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who earn the profit of the Naam are accepted and approved.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar aae vajee vaadhaiee ||
verses.translation: And when they return home, they are greeted with cheers;

verses.original: ਸਚ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach naam kee milee vaddiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: they obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਕਾਲੀਆ ਸੁਪੇਦਾ ਸੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: raatee hovan kaaleeaa supedhaa se va(n)n ||
verses.translation: Even when the night is dark, whatever is white retains its white color.

verses.original: ਦਿਹੁ ਬਗਾ ਤਪੈ ਘਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ਕਾਲੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: dhih bagaa tapai ghanaa kaaliaa kaale va(n)n ||
verses.translation: And even when the light of day is dazzlingly bright, whatever is black retains its black color.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe akalee baahare moorakh a(n)dh giaan ||
verses.translation: The blind fools have no wisdom at all; their understanding is blind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee baahare kabeh na paaveh maan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Lord's Grace, they will never receive honor. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa koT rachaiaa har sachai aape ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself created the body-fortress.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhoojai bhai khuaaian haumai vich viaape ||
verses.translation: Some are ruined through the love of duality, engrossed in egotism.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਸਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: eih maanas janam dhula(n)bh saa manmukh sa(n)taape ||
verses.translation: This human body is so difficult to obtain; the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee jis satigur thaape ||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself causes to understand; he is blessed by the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sabh jag khel rachaion sabh varatai aape ||13||
verses.translation: He created the entire world for His play; He is pervading amongst all. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਰੰਡੀਆ ਕੁਟਣੀਆ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥ ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: choraa jaaraa ra(n)ddeeaa kuTaneeaa dheebaan || vedheenaa kee dhosatee vedheenaa kaa khaan ||
verses.translation: Thieves, adulterers, prostitutes and pimps, make friendships with the unrighteous, and eat with the unrighteous.

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sifatee saar na jaananee sadhaa vasai saitaan ||
verses.translation: They do not know the value of the Lord's Praises, and Satan is always with them.

verses.original: ਗਦਹੁ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਖਉਲੀਐ ਭੀ ਸਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gadhahu cha(n)dhan khauleeaai bhee saahoo siau paan ||
verses.translation: If a donkey is anointed with sandalwood paste, he still loves to roll in the dirt.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੈ ਕਤਿਐ ਕੂੜਾ ਤਣੀਐ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kooRai katiaai kooRaa taneeaai taan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by spinning falsehood, a fabric of falsehood is woven.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਕਛੀਐ ਕੂੜਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kooRaa kapaR kachheeaai kooRaa painan maan ||1||
verses.translation: False is the cloth and its measurement, and false is pride in such a garment. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਂਗਾ ਬੁਰਗੂ ਸਿੰਙੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਮਿਲੀ ਕਲਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: baa(n)gaa buragoo si(n)n(g)eeaa naale milee kalaan ||
verses.translation: The callers to prayer, the flute-players, the horn-blowers, and also the singers

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhaate ik ma(n)gate naam teraa paravaan ||
verses.translation: - some are givers, and some are beggars; they become acceptable only through Your Name, Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jin(h)ee sun kai ma(n)niaa hau tinaa viTahu kurabaan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who hear and accept the Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sabh kooR hai kooRo hoi giaa ||
verses.translation: Attachment to Maya is totally false, and false are those who go that way.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਝਗੜੈ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: haumai jhagaRaa paion jhagaRai jag muiaa ||
verses.translation: Through egotism, the world is caught in conflict and strife, and it dies.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓਨੁ ਇਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jhagaR chukaion iko rav rahiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is free of conflict and strife, and sees the One Lord, pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa bhaujal tar giaa ||
verses.translation: Recognizing that the Supreme Soul is everywhere, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jot samaanee jot vich har naam samiaa ||14||
verses.translation: His light merges into the Light, and he is absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਮੈ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheekhiaa dheh mai too(n) sa(n)mrath dhaataar ||
verses.translation: O True Guru, bless me with Your charity; You are the All-powerful Giver.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai garab nivaareeaai kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: May I subdue and quiet my egotism, pride, sexual desire, anger and self-conceit.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh parajaaleeaai naam milai aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Burn away all my greed, and give me the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis navatan niramalaa mailaa kabahoo(n) na hoi ||
verses.translation: Day and night, keep me ever-fresh and new, spotless and pure; let me never be soiled by sin.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ieh bidh chhuTeeaai nadhar teree sukh hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in this way I am saved; by Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕੋ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਬਾਈਆ ਜਿਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: eiko ka(n)t sabaieeaa jitee dhar khaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: There is only the one Husband Lord, for all who stand at His Door.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਬਾਤੜੀਆਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ka(n)tai rateeaa puchheh baataReeaaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they ask for news of their Husband Lord, from those who are imbued with His Love. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe ka(n)tai rateeaa mai dhohaagan kit ||
verses.translation: All are imbued with love for their Husband Lord; I am a discarded bride - what good am I?

verses.original: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਏਤੜੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਫੇਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mai tan avagan etaRe khasam na fere chit ||3||
verses.translation: My body is filled with so many faults; my Lord and Master does not even turn His thoughts to me. ||3||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੈ ਵਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree tin kau sifat jinaa dhai vaat ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord with their mouths.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਇਕ ਮੈ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabh raatee sohaaganee ik mai dhohaagan raat ||4||
verses.translation: All the nights are for the happy soul-brides; I am a discarded bride - if only I could have even one night with Him! ||4||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਤੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhar ma(n)gat jaachai dhaan har dheejai kirapaa kar ||
verses.translation: I am a beggar at Your Door, begging for charity; O Lord, please grant me Your Mercy, and give to me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh leh milai jan paavai naam har ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, unite me, your humble servant, with You, that I may receive Your Name.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh sabadh vajai jotee jot dhar ||
verses.translation: Then, the unstruck melody of the Shabad will vibrate and resound, and my light will blend with the Light.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai har gun gai jai jai sabadh har ||
verses.translation: Within my heart, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and celebrate the Word of the Lord's Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jag meh varatai aap har setee preet kar ||15||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is pervading and permeating the world; so fall in love with Him! ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jinee na paio prem ras ka(n)t na paio saau ||
verses.translation: Those who do not obtain the sublime essence, the love and delight of their Husband Lord,

verses.original: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: su(n)n(j)e ghar kaa paahunaa jiau aaiaa tiau jaau ||1||
verses.translation: are like guests in a deserted house; they leave just as they have come, empty-handed. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਉ ਓਲਾਮੑੇ ਦਿਨੈ ਕੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਨਿੑ ਸਹੰਸ ॥
verses.translit: sau olaam(h)e dhinai ke raatee milani(h) saha(n)s ||
verses.translation: He receives hundreds and thousands of reprimands, day and night;

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਕਰੰਗੀ ਲਗਾ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sifat salaahan chhadd kai kara(n)gee lagaa ha(n)s ||
verses.translation: the swan-soul has renounced the Lord's Praises, and attached itself to a rotting carcass.

verses.original: ਫਿਟੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਇ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਪੇਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: fiT ivehaa jeeviaa jit khai vadhaiaa peT ||
verses.translation: Cursed is that life, in which one only eats to fill his belly.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam vin sabho dhusaman het ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, all one's friends turn to enemies. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee gun gaavai nit janam savaariaa ||
verses.translation: The minstrel continually sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, to embellish his life.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sev salaeh sachaa ur dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh serves and praises the True Lord, enshrining Him within his heart.

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghar dhar paavai mahal naam piaariaa ||
verses.translation: He obtains his own home and mansion, by loving the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paiaa naam hau gur kau vaariaa ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the Naam; I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: too aap savaareh aap sirajanahaariaa ||16||
verses.translation: You Yourself embellish and adorn us, O Creator Lord. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dheevaa balai a(n)dheraa jai ||
verses.translation: When the lamp is lit, the darkness is dispelled;

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bedh paaTh mat paapaa khai ||
verses.translation: reading the Vedas, sinful intellect is destroyed.

verses.original: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: augavai soor na jaapai cha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: When the sun rises, the moon is not visible.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਟੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh giaan pragaas agiaan miTa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Wherever spiritual wisdom appears, ignorance is dispelled.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bedh paaTh sa(n)saar kee kaar ||
verses.translation: Reading the Vedas is the world's occupation;

verses.original: ਪੜਿੑ ਪੜਿੑ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: paRi(h) paRi(h) pa(n)ddit kareh beechaar ||
verses.translation: the Pandits read them, study them and contemplate them.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe sabh hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: Without understanding, all are ruined.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh utaras paar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is carried across. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai saadh na aaio naam na lago piaar ||
verses.translation: Those who do not savor the Word of the Shabad, do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa fikaa bolanaa nit nit hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: They speak insipidly with their tongues, and are continually disgraced.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak piaai kirat kamaavanaa koi na meTanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they act according to the karma of their past actions, which no one can erase. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: j prabh saalaahe aapanaa so sobhaa paae ||
verses.translation: One who praises his God, receives honor.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vichahu dhoor kar sach ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: He drives out egotism from within himself, and enshrines the True Name within his mind.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sach baanee gun ucharai sachaa sukh paae ||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Guru's Bani, he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and finds true peace.

verses.original: ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: mel bhiaa chiree vichhu(n)niaa gur purakh milaae ||
verses.translation: He is united with the Lord, after being separated for so long; the Guru, the Primal Being, unites him with the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਵ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: man mailaa iv sudh hai har naam dhiaae ||17||
verses.translation: In this way, his filthy mind is cleansed and purified, and he meditates on the Name of the Lord. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂਮਲ ਫੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਪਸਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa koomal ful gun naanak gupas maal ||
verses.translation: With the fresh leaves of the body, and the flowers of virtue, Nanak has weaved his garland.

verses.original: ਏਨੀ ਫੁਲੀ ਰਉ ਕਰੇ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਚੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਡਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: enee fulee rau kare avar k chune'eeh ddaal ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord is pleased with such garlands, so why pick any other flowers? ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak tinaa basa(n)t hai jin(h) ghar vasiaa ka(n)t ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it is the spring season for those, within whose homes their Husband Lord abides.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਤ ਦਿਸਾਪੁਰੀ ਸੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜਲੰਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin ke ka(n)t dhisaapuree se ahinis fireh jala(n)t ||2||
verses.translation: But those, whose Husband Lord is far away in distant lands, continue burning, day and night. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase dhiaa kar gur satigur bachanee ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself forgives those who dwell upon the Word of the Guru, the True Guru.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਚਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin sevee gun ravaa man sachai rachanee ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I serve the True Lord, and chant His Glorious Praises; my mind merges into Him.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਖਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh meraa bea(n)t hai a(n)t kinai na lakhanee ||
verses.translation: My God is infinite; no one knows His limit.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur charanee lagiaa har naam nit japanee ||
verses.translation: Grasping hold of the feet of the True Guru, meditate continually on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਘਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਚਨੀ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: jo ichhai so fal paisee sabh gharai vich jachanee ||18||
verses.translation: Thus you shall obtain the fruits of your desires, and all wishes shall be fulfilled within your home. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: pahil basa(n)tai aagaman pahilaa maulio soi ||
verses.translation: Spring brings forth the first blossoms, but the Lord blossoms earlier still.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਉਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਉਲੀਐ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਮਉਲਿਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jit mauliaai sabh mauleeaai tiseh na maulih koi ||1||
verses.translation: By His blossoming, everything blossoms; no one else causes Him to blossom forth. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pahil basa(n)tai aagaman tis kaa karahu beechaar ||
verses.translation: He blossoms forth even earlier than the spring; reflect upon Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so saalaaheeaai j sabhasai dhe aadhaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the One who gives Support to all. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: miliaai miliaa naa milai milai miliaa je hoi ||
verses.translation: By uniting, the united one is not united; he unites, only if he is united.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar aatamai jo milai miliaa kaheeaai soi ||3||
verses.translation: But if he unites deep within his soul, then he is said to be united. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam salaaheeaai sach kaar kamaavai ||
verses.translation: Praise the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and practice truthful deeds.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojee kaarai lagiaa fir jonee paavai ||
verses.translation: Attached to other deeds, one is consigned to wander in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratiaa naam paieeaai naame gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Name, one obtains the Name, and through the Name, sings the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh salaaheeaai har naam samaavai ||
verses.translation: Praising the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: satigur sevaa safal hai seviaai fal paavai ||19||
verses.translation: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; serving Him, the fruits are obtained. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਇਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
verses.translit: kis hee koiee koi ma(n)n(j) nimaanee ik too ||
verses.translation: Some people have others, but I am forlorn and dishonored; I have only You, Lord.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ ਰੋਇ ਜਾ ਲਗੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kiau na mareejai roi jaa lag chit na aavahee ||1||
verses.translation: I might as well just die crying, if You will not come into my mind. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਓ ਦੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿਓਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) sukh taa sahu raavio dhukh bhee sa(n)m(h)aalioi ||
verses.translation: When there is peace and pleasure, that is the time to remember your Husband Lord. In times of suffering and pain, remember Him then as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ ਇਉ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai siaane'ee iau ka(n)t milaavaa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O wise bride, this is the way to meet your Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਰਮ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: hau kiaa saalaahee kiram ja(n)t vaddee teree vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: I am a worm - how can I praise You, O Lord; Your glorious greatness is so great!

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too agam dhiaal aga(n)m hai aap laih milaiee ||
verses.translation: You are inaccessible, merciful and unapproachable; You Yourself unite us with Yourself.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mai tujh bin belee ko nahee too a(n)t sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: I have no other friend except You; in the end, You alone will be my Companion and Support.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਤਿਨ ਲੈਹਿ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo teree saranaagatee tin laih chhaddaiee ||
verses.translation: You save those who enter Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak veparavaahu hai tis til na tamaiee ||20||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He is care-free; He has no greed at all. ||20||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਤਥਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag soohee baanee sree kabeer jeeau tathaa sabhanaa bhagataa kee ||
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Kabeer Jee, And Other Devotees.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੇ
verses.translit: kabeer ke
verses.translation: Of Kabeer

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਵਤਰਿ ਆਇ ਕਹਾ ਤੁਮ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: avatar aai kahaa tum keenaa ||
verses.translation: Since your birth, what have you done?

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam ko naam na kabahoo leenaa ||1||
verses.translation: You have never even chanted the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam na japahu kavan mat laage ||
verses.translation: You have not meditated on the Lord; what thoughts are you attached to?

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਜਇਬੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mar jibe kau kiaa karahu abhaage ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What preparations are you making for your death, O unfortunate one? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh kar kai kuTa(n)b jeevaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through pain and pleasure, you have taken care of your family.

verses.original: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਇਕਸਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maratee baar ikasar dhukh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: But at the time of death, you shall have to endure the agony all alone. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੰਠ ਗਹਨ ਤਬ ਕਰਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th gahan tab karan pukaaraa ||
verses.translation: When you are seized by the neck, then you shall cry out.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਆਗੇ ਤੇ ਨ ਸੰਮੑਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer aage te na sa(n)m(h)aaraa ||3||1||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, why didn't you remember the Lord before this? ||3||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: soohee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਥਰਹਰ ਕੰਪੈ ਬਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tharahar ka(n)pai baalaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: My innocent soul trembles and shakes.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਸੀ ਪੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa jaanau kiaa karasee peeau ||1||
verses.translation: I do not know how my Husband Lord will deal with me. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੈਨਿ ਗਈ ਮਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: rain giee mat dhin bhee jai ||
verses.translation: The night of my youth has passed away; will the day of old age also pass away?

verses.original: ਭਵਰ ਗਏ ਬਗ ਬੈਠੇ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhavar ge bag baiThe aai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My dark hairs, like bumble bees, have gone away, and grey hairs, like cranes, have settled upon my head. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਚੈ ਕਰਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaachai karavai rahai na paanee ||
verses.translation: Water does not remain in the unbaked clay pot;

verses.original: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s chaliaa kaiaa kumalaanee ||2||
verses.translation: when the soul-swan departs, the body withers away. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੁਆਰ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਤ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kuaar ka(n)niaa jaise karat seegaaraa ||
verses.translation: I decorate myself like a young virgin;

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kiau raleeaa maanai baajh bhataaraa ||3||
verses.translation: but how can I enjoy pleasures, without my Husband Lord? ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਗ ਉਡਾਵਤ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaag uddaavat bhujaa piraanee ||
verses.translation: My arm is tired, driving away the crows.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਕਥਾ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer ieh kathaa siraanee ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, this is the way the story of my life ends. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: soohee kabeer jeeau ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਅਮਲੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: amal siraano lekhaa dhenaa ||
verses.translation: Your time of service is at its end, and you will have to give your account.

verses.original: ਆਏ ਕਠਿਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਲੇਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aae kaThin dhoot jam lenaa ||
verses.translation: The hard-hearted Messenger of Death has come to take you away.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਤੈ ਖਟਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa tai khaTiaa kahaa gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: What have you earned, and what have you lost?

verses.original: ਚਲਹੁ ਸਿਤਾਬ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chalahu sitaab dheebaan bulaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Come immediately! You are summoned to His Court! ||1||

verses.original: ਚਲੁ ਦਰਹਾਲੁ ਦੀਵਾਨਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chal dharahaal dheevaan bulaiaa ||
verses.translation: Get going! Come just as you are! You have been summoned to His Court.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har furamaan dharageh kaa aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Order has come from the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਗਾਵ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਾਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: karau aradhaas gaav kichh baakee ||
verses.translation: I pray to the Messenger of Death: please, I still have some outstanding debts to collect in the village.

verses.original: ਲੇਉ ਨਿਬੇਰਿ ਆਜੁ ਕੀ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: leau niber aaj kee raatee ||
verses.translation: I will collect them tonight;

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਭੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਸਾਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: kichh bhee kharach tum(h)aaraa saarau ||
verses.translation: I will also pay you something for your expenses,

verses.original: ਸੁਬਹ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਸਰਾਇ ਗੁਜਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: subeh nivaaj sarai gujaarau ||2||
verses.translation: and I will recite my morning prayers on the way. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jaa kau har ra(n)g laagaa || dhan dhan so jan purakh sabhaagaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the most fortunate servant of the Lord, who is imbued with the Lord's Love, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot jan sadhaa suhele ||
verses.translation: Here and there, the humble servants of the Lord are always happy.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਮੋਲੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath jeet amole ||3||
verses.translation: They win the priceless treasure of this human life. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat soiaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: When he is awake, he is sleeping, and so he loses this life.

verses.original: ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਰਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maal dhan joriaa bhiaa paraiaa ||
verses.translation: The property and wealth he has accumulated passes on to someone else.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇਈ ਨਰ ਭੂਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer teiee nar bhoole ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, those people are deluded,

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੂਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: khasam bisaar maaTee sa(n)g roole ||4||3||
verses.translation: who forget their Lord and Master, and roll in the dust. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਲਲਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: soohee kabeer jeeau lalit ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Kabeer Jee, Lallit:

verses.original: ਥਾਕੇ ਨੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: thaake nain sravan sun thaake thaakee su(n)dhar kaiaa ||
verses.translation: My eyes are exhausted, and my ears are tired of hearing; my beautiful body is exhausted.

verses.original: ਜਰਾ ਹਾਕ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਏਕ ਨ ਥਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaraa haak dhee sabh mat thaakee ek na thaakas maiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Driven forward by old age, all my senses are exhausted; only my attachment to Maya is not exhausted. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baavare tai giaan beechaar na paiaa ||
verses.translation: O mad man, you have not obtained spiritual wisdom and meditation.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: birathaa janam gavaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You have wasted this human life, and lost. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tab lag praanee tisai sarevahu jab lag ghaT meh saasaa ||
verses.translation: O mortal, serve the Lord, as long as the breath of life remains in the body.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਘਟੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: je ghaT jai ta bhaau na jaasee har ke charan nivaasaa ||2||
verses.translation: And even when your body dies, your love for the Lord shall not die; you shall dwell at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਸਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kau sabadh basaavai a(n)tar chookai tiseh piaasaa ||
verses.translation: When the Word of the Shabad abides deep within, thirst and desire are quenched.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਢਾਲੇ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hukamai boojhai chaupaR khelai man jin ddaale paasaa ||3||
verses.translation: When one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he plays the game of chess with the Lord; throwing the dice, he conquers his own mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਜਹਿ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਕਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan jaan bhajeh abigat kau tin kaa kachhoo na naasaa ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings, who know the Imperishable Lord and meditate on Him, are not destroyed at all.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹਿ ਢਾਲਿ ਜੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer te jan kabahu na haareh ddaal ju jaaneh paasaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, those humble beings who know how to throw these dice, never lose the game of life. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਲਲਿਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: soohee lalit kabeer jeeau ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Lalit, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਪੰਚ ਸਿਕਦਾਰਾ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek koT pa(n)ch sikadhaaraa pa(n)che maageh haalaa ||
verses.translation: In the one fortress of the body, there are five rulers, and all five demand payment of taxes.

verses.original: ਜਿਮੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੀ ਬੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਦੇਨੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jimee naahee mai kisee kee boiee aaisaa dhen dhukhaalaa ||1||
verses.translation: I have not farmed anyone's land, so such payment is difficult for me to pay. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨੀਤਿ ਡਸੈ ਪਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke logaa mo kau neet ddasai paTavaaree ||
verses.translation: O people of the Lord, the tax-collector is constantly torturing me!

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uoopar bhujaa kar mai gur peh pukaariaa tin hau leeaa ubaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Raising my arms up, I complained to my Guru, and He has saved me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਉ ਡਾਡੀ ਦਸ ਮੁੰਸਫ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਰਈਅਤਿ ਬਸਨ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: nau ddaaddee dhas mu(n)saf dhaaveh rieeat basan na dhehee ||
verses.translation: The nine tax-assessors and the ten magistrates go out; they do not allow their subjects to live in peace.

verses.original: ਡੋਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਾਪਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਟਾਲਾ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ddoree pooree maapeh naahee bahu bisaTaalaa lehee ||2||
verses.translation: They do not measure with a full tape, and they take huge amounts in bribes. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਹਤਰਿ ਘਰ ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਉਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bahatar ghar ik purakh samaiaa un dheeaa naam likhaiee ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is contained in the seventy-two chambers of the body, and He has written off my account.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਫਤਰੁ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਰਿਜਮ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dharam rai kaa dhafatar sodhiaa baakee rijam na kaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The records of the Righteous Judge of Dharma have been searched, and I owe absolutely nothing. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa kau mat koiee ni(n)dhahu sa(n)t raam hai ekuo ||
verses.translation: Let no one slander the Saints, because the Saints and the Lord are as one.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਬੇਕੋੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer mai so gur paiaa jaa kaa naau bibekuo ||4||5||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have found that Guru, whose Name is Clear Understanding. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag soohee baanee sree ravidhaas jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Sree Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: seh kee saar suhaagan jaanai ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-bride knows the worth of her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: taj abhimaan sukh raleeaa maanai ||
verses.translation: Renouncing pride, she enjoys peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: tan man dhei na a(n)tar raakhai ||
verses.translation: She surrenders her body and mind to Him, and does not remain separate from Him.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਅਭਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avaraa dhekh na sunai abhaakhai ||1||
verses.translation: She does not see or hear, or speak to another. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: so kat jaanai peer paraiee ||
verses.translation: How can anyone know the pain of another,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai a(n)tar dharadh na paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: if there is no compassion and sympathy within? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਦੁਇ ਪਖ ਹੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhukhee dhuhaagan dhui pakh heenee ||
verses.translation: The discarded bride is miserable, and loses both worlds;

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਹ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin naeh nira(n)tar bhagat na keenee ||
verses.translation: she does not worship her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਪੁਰ ਸਲਾਤ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: pur salaat kaa pa(n)th dhuhelaa ||
verses.translation: The bridge over the fire of hell is difficult and treacherous.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਗਵਨੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g na saathee gavan ikelaa ||2||
verses.translation: No one will accompany you there; you will have to go all alone. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦਰਦਵੰਦੁ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhukheeaa dharadhava(n)dh dhar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Suffering in pain, I have come to Your Door, O Compassionate Lord.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bahut piaas jabaab na paiaa ||
verses.translation: I am so thirsty for You, but You do not answer me.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas saran prabh teree ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, I seek Your Sanctuary, God;

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau jaanahu tiau kar gat meree ||3||1||
verses.translation: as You know me, so will You save me. ||3||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: soohee ||
verses.translation: Soohee:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦਿਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhin aaveh so dhin jaahee ||
verses.translation: That day which comes, that day shall go.

verses.original: ਕਰਨਾ ਕੂਚੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: karanaa kooch rahan thir naahee ||
verses.translation: You must march on; nothing remains stable.

verses.original: ਸੰਗੁ ਚਲਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g chalat hai ham bhee chalanaa ||
verses.translation: Our companions are leaving, and we must leave as well.

verses.original: ਦੂਰਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhoor gavan sir uoopar maranaa ||1||
verses.translation: We must go far away. Death is hovering over our heads. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa too soiaa jaag iaanaa ||
verses.translation: Why are you asleep? Wake up, you ignorant fool!

verses.original: ਤੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tai jeevan jag sach kar jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You believe that your life in the world is true. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਅੰਬਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin jeeau dheeaa su rijak a(n)baraavai ||
verses.translation: The One who gave you life shall also provide you with nourishment.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ghaT bheetar haaT chalaavai ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, He runs His shop.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ਛਾਡਿ ਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar ba(n)dhigee chhaadd mai meraa ||
verses.translation: Meditate and renounce all concepts of "I am" and "Mine."

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hiradhai naam sam(h)aar saveraa ||2||
verses.translation: Within your heart, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, sometime. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: janam siraano pa(n)th na savaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your life has passed away, but you have not arranged your path.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਝ ਪਰੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)jh paree dheh dhis a(n)dhiaaraa ||
verses.translation: Evening has set in, and soon there will be darkness on all sides.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas nidhaan dhivaane ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, O ignorant mad-man,

verses.original: ਚੇਤਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਫਨ ਖਾਨੇ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: chetas naahee dhuneeaa fan khaane ||3||2||
verses.translation: don't you realize, that this world is the house of death?! ||3||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: soohee ||
verses.translation: Soohee:

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਾਲ ਰਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: uooche ma(n)dhar saal rasoiee ||
verses.translation: You may have lofty mansions, halls and kitchens.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek gharee fun rahan na hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: But you cannot stay in them, even for an instant, after death. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan aaisaa jaise ghaas kee TaaTee ||
verses.translation: This body is like a house of straw.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਘਾਸੁ ਰਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jal gio ghaas ral gio maaTee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When it is burnt, it mixes with dust. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਬੰਧ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹੇਰਾ ॥ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਾਢੁ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaiee ba(n)dh kuTa(n)b saheraa || oi bhee laage kaadd saveraa ||2||
verses.translation: Even relatives, family and friends begin to say, ""Take his body out, immediately!""||2||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਰਹਿ ਤਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghar kee naar ureh tan laagee ||
verses.translation: And the wife of his house, who was so attached to his body and heart,

verses.original: ਉਹ ਤਉ ਭੂਤੁ ਭੂਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: auh tau bhoot bhoot kar bhaagee ||3||
verses.translation: runs away, crying out, ""Ghost! Ghost!""||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਭੈ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas sabhai jag looTiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, the whole world has been plundered,

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: ham tau ek raam keh chhooTiaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: but I have escaped, chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||4||3||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag soohee baanee sekh fareedh jee kee ||
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

verses.original: ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਮਰੋਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: tap tap luh luh haath marorau ||
verses.translation: Burning and burning, writhing in pain, I wring my hands.

verses.original: ਬਾਵਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਲੋਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: baaval hoiee so sahu lorau ||
verses.translation: I have gone insane, seeking my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: tai seh man meh keeaa ros ||
verses.translation: O my Husband Lord, You are angry with me.

verses.original: ਮੁਝੁ ਅਵਗਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mujh avagan seh naahee dhos ||1||
verses.translation: The fault is with me, and not with my Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: tai saahib kee mai saar na jaanee ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, I do not know Your excellence and worth.

verses.original: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: joban khoi paachhai pachhutaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Having wasted my youth, now I come to regret the past. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਇਲ ਤੂ ਕਿਤ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaalee koil too kit gun kaalee ||
verses.translation: O black bird, what qualities have made you black?

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਬਿਰਹੈ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: apane preetam ke hau birahai jaalee ||
verses.translation: "I have been burnt by separation from my Beloved."

verses.original: ਪਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pireh bihoon kateh sukh paae ||
verses.translation: Without her Husband Lord, how can the soul-bride ever find peace?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa hoi kirapaal taa prabhoo milaae ||2||
verses.translation: When He becomes merciful, then God unites us with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਿਧਣ ਖੂਹੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਇਕੇਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: vidhan khoohee mu(n)dh ikelee ||
verses.translation: The lonely soul-bride suffers in the pit of the world.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko saathee naa ko belee ||
verses.translation: She has no companions, and no friends.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh saadhasa(n)g melee ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, God has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa fir dhekhaa taa meraa alahu belee ||3||
verses.translation: And when I look again, then I find God as my Helper. ||3||

verses.original: ਵਾਟ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਖਰੀ ਉਡੀਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: vaaT hamaaree kharee uddeenee ||
verses.translation: The path upon which I must walk is very depressing.

verses.original: ਖੰਨਿਅਹੁ ਤਿਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)niahu tikhee bahut pieenee ||
verses.translation: It is sharper than a two-edged sword, and very narrow.

verses.original: ਉਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aus uoopar hai maarag meraa ||
verses.translation: That is where my path lies.

verses.original: ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: sekh fareedhaa pa(n)th sam(h)aar saveraa ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Shaykh Fareed, think of that path early on. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਲਲਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: soohee lalit ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Lalit:

verses.original: ਬੇੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਸਕਿਓ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: beRaa ba(n)dh na sakio ba(n)dhan kee velaa ||
verses.translation: You were not able to make yourself a raft when you should have.

verses.original: ਭਰਿ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਜਬ ਊਛਲੈ ਤਬ ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhar saravar jab uoochhalai tab taran dhuhelaa ||1||
verses.translation: When the ocean is churning and over-flowing, then it is very difficult to cross over it. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਥੁ ਨ ਲਾਇ ਕਸੁੰਭੜੈ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hath na lai kasu(n)bhaRai jal jaasee ddolaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Do not touch the safflower with your hands; its color will fade away, my dear. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਪਤਲੀ ਸਹ ਕੇਰੇ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik aapeen(h)ai patalee seh kere bolaa ||
verses.translation: First, the bride herself is weak, and then, her Husband Lord's Order is hard to bear.

verses.original: ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhudhaa thanee na aaviee fir hoi na melaa ||2||
verses.translation: Milk does not return to the breast; it will not be collected again. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਹੁ ਅਲਾਏਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahai fareedh saheleeho sahu alaaesee ||
verses.translation: Says Fareed, O my companions, when our Husband Lord calls,

verses.original: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਸੀ ਡੁੰਮਣਾ ਅਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਢੇਰੀ ਥੀਸੀ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s chalasee ddu(n)manaa eh tan dderee theesee ||3||2||
verses.translation: the soul-swan departs, sad at heart, and this body returns to dust. ||3||2||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਹਉ ਮੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too sulataan kahaa hau meeaa teree kavan vaddaiee ||
verses.translation: You are the Emperor, and I call You a chief - how does this add to Your greatness?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo too dheh su kahaa suaamee mai moorakh kahan na jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: As You permit me, I praise You, O Lord and Master; I am ignorant, and I cannot chant Your Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tere gun gaavaa dheh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaise sach meh rahau rajaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: May I dwell in Truth, according to Your Will. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਅਸਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh hoaa sabh kichh tujh te teree sabh asanaiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever has happened, has all come from You. You are All-knowing.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: teraa a(n)t na jaanaa mere saahib mai a(n)dhule kiaa chaturaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Your limits cannot be known, O my Lord and Master; I am blind - what wisdom do I have? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਕਥੀ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਕਥਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa hau kathee kathe kath dhekhaa mai akath na kathanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: What should I say? While talking, I talk of seeing, but I cannot describe the indescribable.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਆਖਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai soiee aakhaa til teree vaddiaaiee ||3||
verses.translation: As it pleases Your Will, I speak; it is just the tiniest bit of Your greatness. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਉ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਭਉਕਾ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ete kookar hau begaanaa bhaukaa is tan taiee ||
verses.translation: Among so many dogs, I am an outcast; I bark for my body's belly.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagat heen naanak je hoigaa taa khasamai naau na jaiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship, O Nanak, even so, still, my Master's Name does not leave me. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaawal, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਲੰਦਰੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: man ma(n)dhar tan ves kala(n)dhar ghaT hee teerath naavaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is the temple, and my body is the simple cloth of the humble seeker; deep within my heart, I bathe at the sacred shrine.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek sabadh merai praan basat hai baahuR janam na aavaa ||1||
verses.translation: The One Word of the Shabad abides within my mind; I shall not come to be born again. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man bedhiaa dhiaal setee meree maiee ||
verses.translation: My mind is pierced through by the Merciful Lord, O my mother!

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaun jaanai peer paraiee ||
verses.translation: Who can know the pain of another?

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham naahee chi(n)t paraiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I think of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar alakh apaaraa chi(n)taa karahu hamaaree ||
verses.translation: O Lord, inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite: please, take care of me!

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa ghaT ghaT jot tum(h)aaree ||2||
verses.translation: In the water, on the land and in sky, You are totally pervading. Your Light is in each and every heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਖ ਮਤਿ ਸਭ ਬੁਧਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਛਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sikh mat sabh budh tum(h)aaree ma(n)dhir chhaavaa tere ||
verses.translation: All teachings, instructions and understandings are Yours; the mansions and sanctuaries are Yours as well.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tujh bin avar na jaanaa mere saahibaa gun gaavaa nit tere ||3||
verses.translation: Without You, I know no other, O my Lord and Master; I continually sing Your Glorious Praises. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਚਿੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh saran tum(h)aaree sarab chi(n)t tudh paase ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; all thought of their care rests with You.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਚੰਗਾ ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai soiee cha(n)gaa ik naanak kee aradhaase ||4||2||
verses.translation: That which pleases Your Will is good; this alone is Nanak's prayer. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaawal, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੇ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape sabadh aape neesaan ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Word of the Shabad, and He Himself is the Insignia.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape surataa aape jaan ||
