verses.translation: He Himself is the Listener, and He Himself is the Knower.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape kar kar vekhai taan ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself beholds His almighty power.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too dhaataa naam paravaan ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Great Giver; Your Name alone is approved. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa naam nira(n)jan dheau ||
verses.translation: Such is the Name of the Immaculate, Divine Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau jaachik too alakh abheau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am just a beggar; You are invisible and unknowable. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਧਰਕਟੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥ ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਣਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh dharakaTee naar || bhoo(n)ddee kaaman kaamaniaar ||
verses.translation: Love of Maya is like a cursed woman, ugly, dirty and promiscuous.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: raaj roop jhooThaa dhin chaar ||
verses.translation: Power and beauty are false, and last for only a few days.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam milai chaanan a(n)dhiaar ||2||
verses.translation: But when one is blessed with the Naam, the darkness within is illuminated. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਖਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chakh chhoddee sahasaa nahee koi ||
verses.translation: I tasted Maya and renounced it, and now, I have no doubts.

verses.original: ਬਾਪੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਵੇਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: baap dhisai vejaat na hoi ||
verses.translation: One whose father is known, cannot be illegitimate.

verses.original: ਏਕੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eke kau naahee bhau koi ||
verses.translation: One who belongs to the One Lord, has no fear.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karataa kare karaavai soi ||3||
verses.translation: The Creator acts, and causes all to act. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh mue man man te maariaa ||
verses.translation: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers his mind, through his mind.

verses.original: ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: Thaak rahe man saachai dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: Keeping his mind restrained, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: avar na soojhai gur kau vaariaa ||
verses.translation: He does not know any other, and he is a sacrifice to the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate nisataariaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, he is emancipated. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee man sahaj dhiaane ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the mind intuitively meditates on the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: har kai ra(n)g rataa man maane ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mind is satisfied.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਬਉਰਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bharam bhule bauraane ||
verses.translation: The insane, self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har bin kiau raheeaai gur sabadh pachhaane ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, how can anyone survive? Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin dharasan kaise jeevau meree maiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I live, O my mother?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bin jeearaa reh na sakai khin satigur boojh bujhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, even for an instant; the True Guru has helped me understand this. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹਉ ਮਰਉ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh bisarai hau marau dhukhaalee ||
verses.translation: Forgetting my God, I die in pain.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: saas giraas japau apune har bhaalee ||
verses.translation: With each breath and morsel of food, I meditate on my Lord, and seek Him.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: sadh bairaagan har naam nihaalee ||
verses.translation: I remain always detached, but I am enraptured with the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਜਾਨੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ab jaane gurmukh har naalee ||2||
verses.translation: Now, as Gurmukh, I know that the Lord is always with me. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathaa kaheeaai gur bhai ||
verses.translation: The Unspoken Speech is spoken, by the Will of the Guru.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh agam agochar dhei dhikhai ||
verses.translation: He shows us that God is unapproachable and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur karanee kiaa kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, what lifestyle could we practice, and what work could we do?

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai meT chalai gur sabadh samai ||3||
verses.translation: Eradicating egotism, and walking in harmony with the Guru's Will, I am absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh vichhuRai khoTee raas ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are separated from the Lord, gathering false wealth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam milai saabaas ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are celebrated with the glory of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa dhaaree dhaasan dhaas ||
verses.translation: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon me, and made me the slave of His slaves.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har naam dhan raas ||4||4||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the wealth and capital of servant Nanak. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag dhirag khaiaa dhirag dhirag soiaa dhirag dhirag kaapaR a(n)g chaRaiaa ||
verses.translation: Cursed, cursed is the food; cursed, cursed is the sleep; cursed, cursed are the clothes worn on the body.

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੁਣਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag sareer kuTa(n)b sahit siau jit hun khasam na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Cursed is the body, along with family and friends, when one does not find his Lord and Master in this life.

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pauRee chhuRakee fir haath na aavai ahilaa janam gavaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He misses the step of the ladder, and this opportunity will not come into his hands again; his life is wasted, uselessly. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਣਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa bhaau na dheiee liv laagan jin har ke charan visaare ||
verses.translation: The love of duality does not allow him to lovingly focus his attention on the Lord; he forgets the Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan dhaataa jan sevak tere tin ke tai dhookh nivaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Life of the World, O Great Giver, you eradicate the sorrows of your humble servants. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too dhiaal dhiaapat dhaataa kiaa eh ja(n)t vichaare ||
verses.translation: You are Merciful, O Great Giver of Mercy; what are these poor beings?

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਐਸਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: mukat ba(n)dh sabh tujh te hoe aaisaa aakh vakhaane ||
verses.translation: All are liberated or placed into bondage by You; this is all one can say.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so mukat kaheeaai manmukh ba(n)dh vichaare ||2||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh is said to be liberated, while the poor self-willed manmukhs are in bondage. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: so jan mukat jis ek liv laagee sadhaa rahai har naale ||
verses.translation: He alone is liberated, who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Lord, always dwelling with the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee gahan gat kahee na jaiee sachai aap savaare ||
verses.translation: His depth and condition cannot be described. The True Lord Himself embellishes him.

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ ਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulaane s manmukh kahe'eeh naa uravaar na paare ||3||
verses.translation: Those who wander around, deluded by doubt, are called manmukhs; they are neither on this side, nor on the other side. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare soiee jan paae gur kaa sabadh sam(h)aale ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains Him, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan maiaa maeh nisataare ||
verses.translation: In the midst of Maya, the Lord's servant is emancipated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bhaag hovai jis masatak kaaleh maar bidhaare ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead, conquers and destroys death. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: atul kiau toliaa jai ||
verses.translation: How can the unweighable be weighed?

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa hoi ta sojhee pai ||
verses.translation: If there is anyone else as great, then he alone could understand the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis te dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: There is no other than Him.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਕੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis dhee keemat kikoo hoi ||1||
verses.translation: How can His value be estimated? ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa ko jaanai dhubidhaa jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One comes to know Him, when duality departs. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aap saraaf kasavaTee laae ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Assayer, applying the touch-stone to test it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape parakhe aap chalaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself analyzes the coin, and He Himself approves it as currency.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape tole pooraa hoi ||
verses.translation: He Himself weights it perfectly.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape jaanai eko soi ||2||
verses.translation: He alone knows; He is the One and Only Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa kaa roop sabh tis te hoi ||
verses.translation: All the forms of Maya emanate from Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no mele su niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: He alone becomes pure and immaculate, who is united with the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no laae lagai tis aai ||
verses.translation: He alone is attached, whom the Lord attaches.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh sach dhikhaale taa sach samai ||3||
verses.translation: All Truth is revealed to him, and then, he merges in the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape liv dhaat hai aape ||
verses.translation: He Himself leads the mortals to focus on Him, and He Himself causes them to chase after Maya.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap bujhaae aape jaape ||
verses.translation: He Himself imparts understanding, and He reveals Himself.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape satigur sabadh hai aape ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aakh sunaae aape ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself speaks and teaches. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬਹਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: saahib te sevak sev saahib te kiaa ko kahai bahaanaa ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has made me His servant, and blessed me with His service; how can anyone argue about this?

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਇਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaisaa ik teraa khel baniaa hai sabh meh ek samaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Such is Your play, One and Only Lord; You are the One, contained among all. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur parachai har naam samaanaa || jis karam hovai so satigur paae anadhin laagai sahaj dhiaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is pleased and appeased, one is absorbed in the Lord's Name. One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy, finds the True Guru; night and day, he automatically remains focused on the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa koiee teree sevaa kare kiaa ko kare abhimaanaa ||
verses.translation: How can I serve You? How can I be proud of this?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਖਿੰਚਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਬ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਖਾ ਵਖਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jab apunee jot khi(n)cheh too suaamee tab koiee karau dhikhaa vakhiaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: When You withdraw Your Light, O Lord and Master, then who can speak and teach? ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape gunee nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the humble disciple; You Yourself are the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਚਾਲੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau aap chalaae tivai koiee chaalai jiau har bhaavai bhagavaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: As You cause us to move, so do we move, according to the Pleasure of Your Will, O Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak too saachaa saahib kaun jaanai tere kaamaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, You are the True Lord and Master; who can know Your actions?

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: eikanaa ghar meh dhe vaddiaaiee ik bharam bhaveh abhimaanaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: Some are blessed with glory in their own homes, while others wander in doubt and pride. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa thaaT banaiaa poorai vekhahu ek samaanaa ||
verses.translation: The perfect Lord has fashioned the Perfect Creation. Behold the Lord pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਧਰਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eis parapa(n)ch meh saache naam kee vaddiaaiee mat ko dharahu gumaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: In this play of the world, is the glorious greatness of the True Name. No one should take pride in himself. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee jis no mat aavai so satigur maeh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: One who accepts the wisdom of the True Guru's Teachings, is absorbed into the True Guru.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eeh baanee jo jeeahu jaanai tis a(n)tar ravai har naamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name abides deep within the nucleus of one who realizes the Bani of the Guru's Word within his soul. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਨਰ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: chahu jugaa kaa hun nibeRaa nar manukhaa no ek nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Now, this is the essence of the teachings of the four ages: for the human race, the Name of the One Lord is the greatest treasure.

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਓਨਾ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jat sa(n)jam teerath onaa jugaa kaa dharam hai kal meh keerat har naamaa ||2||
verses.translation: Celibacy, self-discipline and pilgrimages were the essence of Dharma in those past ages; but in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Praise of the Lord's Name is the essence of Dharma. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug aapo aapanaa dharam hai sodh dhekhahu bedh puraanaa ||
verses.translation: Each and every age has its own essence of Dharma; study the Vedas and the Puraanas, and see this as true.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਿ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jinee dhiaaiaa har har jag te poore paravaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: They are Gurmukh, who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; in this world, they are perfect and approved. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਏ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak sache siau preet laae chookai man abhimaanaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, loving the True Lord, the mind's egotism and self-conceit is eradicated.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਤ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahat sunat sabhe sukh paaveh maanat paeh nidhaanaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Those who speak and listen to the Lord's Name, all find peace. Those who believe in it, obtain the supreme treasure. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh preet jis no aape laae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself attaches the Gurmukh to His Love;

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tit ghar bilaaval gur sabadh suhaae ||
verses.translation: joyful melodies permeate his home, and he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gal naaree gaaveh aae ||
verses.translation: The women come and sing the songs of joy.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil preetam sadhaa sukh paae ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with their Beloved, lasting peace is obtained. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hau tin balihaarai jin(h) har ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jan kau miliaa sukh paieeaai har gun gaavai sahaj subhaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble servant of the Lord, peace is obtained, and one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ra(n)g raate terai chaae ||
verses.translation: They are always imbued with Your Joyful Love;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau aap vasai man aae ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You Yourself come to dwell in their minds.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape sobhaa sadh hee paae ||
verses.translation: They obtain eternal glory.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh melai mel milaae ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raate sabadh ra(n)gaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the love of the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vaasaa har gun gaae ||
verses.translation: They abide in the home of their own being, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g chaloolai har ras bhaae ||
verses.translation: They are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they look so beautiful.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eih ra(n)g kadhe na utarai saach samaae ||3||
verses.translation: This dye never fades away; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sabadh miTiaa agiaan a(n)dheraa ||
verses.translation: The Shabad deep within the nucleus of the self dispels the darkness of ignorance.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur giaan miliaa preetam meraa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with my Friend, the True Guru, I have obtained spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo sach raate tin bahuR na feraa ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the True Lord, do not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiraRaae pooraa gur meraa ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my Perfect Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te vaddiaaiee paiee ||
verses.translation: From the Perfect Guru, I have obtained glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: achi(n)t naam vasiaa man aaiee ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has spontaneously come to abide in my mind.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maiaa sabadh jalaiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away egotism and Maya.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhar saachai gur te sobhaa paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, I have obtained honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਗਦੀਸ ਸੇਵਉ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jagadhees sevau mai avar na kaajaa ||
verses.translation: I serve the Lord of the Universe; I have no other work to do.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin anadh hovai man merai gurmukh maagau teraa naam nivaajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, my mind is in ecstasy; as Gurmukh, I beg for the bliss-giving Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man kee parateet man te paiee ||
verses.translation: From the mind itself, mental faith is obtained.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te sabadh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, I have realized the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਕੋ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan maran ko samasar vekhai ||
verses.translation: How rare is that person, who looks upon life and death alike.

verses.original: ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਜਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bahuR na marai naa jam pekhai ||2||
verses.translation: She shall never die again, and shall not have to see the Messenger of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕੋਟ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: ghar hee meh sabh koT nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Within the home of the self are all the millions of treasures.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਇਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhikhaae giaa abhimaan ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has revealed them, and my egotistical pride is gone.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: sadh hee laagaa sahaj dhiaan ||
verses.translation: I keep my meditation always focused on the Cosmic Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin gaavai eko naam ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, I sing the One Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug meh vaddiaaiee paiee ||
verses.translation: I have obtained glorious greatness in this age,

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te naam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: from the Perfect Guru, meditating on the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sukhadhaataa keemat nahee paiee ||4||
verses.translation: He is forever the Giver of peace; His worth cannot be estimated. ||4||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag gur pooraa paiaa ||
verses.translation: By perfect destiny, I have found the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar naam nidhaan dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has revealed to me the treasure of the Naam, deep within the nucleus of my self.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh at meeThaa laiaa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is so very sweet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੬॥੪॥੬॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak tirasan bujhee man tan sukh paiaa ||5||6||4||6||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my thirst is quenched, and my mind and body have found peace. ||5||6||4||6||10||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਉਦਮ ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: audham mat prabh a(n)tarajaamee jiau prere tiau karanaa ||
verses.translation: Effort and intelligence come from God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as He wills, they act.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਨਟੂਆ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਤੰਤੀ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau naTooaa ta(n)t vajaae ta(n)tee tiau vaajeh ja(n)t janaa ||1||
verses.translation: As the violinist plays upon the strings of the violin, so does the Lord play the living beings. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raam naam rasanaa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, O mind.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: masatak likhat likhe gur paiaa har hiradhai har basanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: According to the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead, I have found the Guru, and the Lord abides within my heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਗਿਰਸਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa girasat bhramat hai praanee rakh levahu jan apanaa ||
verses.translation: Entangled in Maya, the mortal wanders around. Save Your humble servant, O Lord,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਹਰਣਾਖਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau prahilaadh haranaakhas grasio har raakhio har saranaa ||2||
verses.translation: as you saved Prahlaad from the clutches of Harnaakash; keep him in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kavan kavan kee gat mit kaheeaai har ke'ee patit pava(n)naa ||
verses.translation: How can I describe the state and the condition, O Lord, of those many sinners you have purified?

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਢੋਵੈ ਢੋਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਚਮੁ ਚਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oh ddovai ddor haath cham chamare har udhario pario saranaa ||3||
verses.translation: Ravi Daas, the leather-worker, who worked with hides and carried dead animals was saved, by entering the Lord's Sanctuary. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਨ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dheen dhiaal bhagat bhav taaran ham paapee raakh papanaa ||
verses.translation: O God, Merciful to the meek, carry Your devotees across the world-ocean; I am a sinner - save me from sin!

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੰਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: har dhaasan dhaas dhaas ham kareeahu jan naanak dhaas dhaasa(n)naa ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham moorakh mugadh agiaan matee saranaagat purakh ajanamaa ||
verses.translation: I am foolish, idiotic and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, O Primal Being, O Lord beyond birth.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਹੀਨ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa rakh levahu mere Thaakur ham paathar heen akaramaa ||1||
verses.translation: Have Mercy upon me, and save me, O my Lord and Master; I am a lowly stone, with no good karma at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man bhaj raam naamai raamaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat har ras paieeaai hor tiaagahu nihafal kaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instructions, obtain the sublime, subtle essence of the Lord; renounce other fruitless actions. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਉਪਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jan sevak se har taare ham niragun raakh upamaa ||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are saved by the Lord; I am worthless - it is Your glory to save me.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਵਡੇ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tujh bin avar na koiee mere Thaakur har japeeaai vadde kara(n)maa ||2||
verses.translation: I have no other than You, O my Lord and Master; I meditate on the Lord, by my good karma. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਡ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: naamaheen dhirag jeevate tin vadd dhookh saha(n)maa ||
verses.translation: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, their lives are cursed, and they must endure terrible pain.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਮੂੜ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oi fir fir jon bhavaie'eeh ma(n)dhabhaagee mooR akaramaa ||3||
verses.translation: They are consigned to reincarnation over and over again; they are the most unfortunate fools, with no good karma at all. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਵਡ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jan naam adhaar hai dhur poorab likhe vadd karamaa ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the Support of the Lord's humble servants; their good karma is pre-ordained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨੰਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur satigur naam dhiraRaiaa jan naanak safal jana(n)maa ||4||2||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within servant Nanak, and his life is fruitful. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੁਭਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa chit lubhat moh bikhiaa bahu dhuramat mail bharaa ||
verses.translation: My consciousness is lured by emotional attachment and corruption; is is filled with evil-minded filth.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਤਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree sevaa kar na sakeh prabh ham kiau kar mugadh taraa ||1||
verses.translation: I cannot serve You, O God; I am ignorant - how can I cross over? ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap narahar naam naraharaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Lord of man.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jan uoopar kirapaa prabh dhaaree mil satigur paar paraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God has showered His Mercy upon His humble servant; meeting with the True Guru, he is carried across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hamare pitaa Thaakur prabh suaamee har dheh matee jas karaa ||
verses.translation: O my Father, my Lord and Master, Lord God, please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Praises.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਤਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tum(h)rai sa(n)g lage se udhare jiau sa(n)g kaasaT loh taraa ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to You are saved, like iron which is carried across with wood. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saakat nar hochhee mat madhim jin(h) har har sev na karaa ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics have little or no understanding; they do not serve the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀ ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: te nar bhaagaheen dhuhachaaree oi janam mue fir maraa ||3||
verses.translation: Those beings are unfortunate and vicious; they die, and are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਨੑਾਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau tum(h) har melahu suaamee te n(h)aae sa(n)tokh gur saraa ||
verses.translation: Those whom You unite with Yourself, O Lord and Master, bathe in the Guru's cleansing pool of contentment.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhuramat mail giee har bhajiaa jan naanak paar paraa ||4||3||
verses.translation: Vibrating upon the Lord, the filth of their evil-mindedness is washed away; servant Nanak is carried across. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu sa(n)t milahu mere bhaiee mil har har kathaa karahu ||
verses.translation: Come, O Saints, and join together, O my Siblings of Destiny; let us tell the Stories of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har naam bohith hai kalajug khevaT gur sabadh tarahu ||1||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the boat in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the boatman to ferry us across. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har gun har ucharahu ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: masatak likhat likhe gun gaae mil sa(n)gat paar parahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: According to the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon your forehead, sing the Praises of the Lord; join the Holy Congregation, and cross over the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagar meh raam ras uootam kiau paieeaai upadhes jan karahu ||
verses.translation: Within the body-village is the Lord's supreme, sublime essence. How can I obtain it? Teach me, O humble Saints.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur sev safal har dharasan mil a(n)mrit har ras peeahu ||2||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, you shall obtain the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan; meeting Him, drink in the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Nectar. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਦਿਖਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam a(n)mrit har meeThaa har sa(n)tahu chaakh dhikhahu ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so sweet; O Saints of the Lord, taste it, and see.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਖ ਰਸਹੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmat har ras meeThaa laagaa tin bisare sabh bikh rasahu ||3||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, the Lord's essence seems so sweet; through it, all corrupt sensual pleasures are forgotten. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ras raam rasain har sevahu sa(n)t janahu ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all diseases; so serve the Lord, O humble Saints.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਚਾਰੇ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath chaare paae gurmat naanak har bhajahu ||4||4||
verses.translation: The four great blessings are obtained, O Nanak, by vibrating upon the Lord, under Guru's Instruction. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਪੈਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: khatree braahaman soodh vais ko jaapai har ma(n)tr japainee ||
verses.translation: Anyone, from any class - Kh'shaatriya, Brahman, Soodra or Vaishya - can chant, and meditate on the Mantra of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰੈਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur satigur paarabraham kar poojahu nit sevahu dhinas sabh rainee ||1||
verses.translation: Worship the Guru, the True Guru, as the Supreme Lord God; serve Him constantly, all day and night. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jan dhekhahu satigur nainee ||
verses.translation: O humble servants of the Lord, behold the True Guru with your eyes.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo ichhahu soiee fal paavahu har bolahu gurmat bainee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever you wish for, you shall receive, chanting the Word of the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਚਿਤਵੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik upaav chitave'eeh bahutere saa hovai j baat hovainee ||
verses.translation: People think of many and various efforts, but that alone happens, which is to happen.

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚਿਤੈਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: apanaa bhalaa sabh koiee baachhai so kare j merai chit na chitainee ||2||
verses.translation: All beings seek goodness for themselves, but what the Lord does - that may not be what we think and expect. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਏਹਾ ਬਾਤ ਕਠੈਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: man kee mat tiaagahu har jan ehaa baat kaThainee ||
verses.translation: So renounce the clever intellect of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord, no matter how hard this may be.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੈਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin har har naam dhiaavahu gur satigur kee mat lainee ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; accept the wisdom of the Guru, the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੰਤੈਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: mat sumat terai vas suaamee ham ja(n)t too purakh ja(n)tainee ||
verses.translation: Wisdom, balanced wisdom is in Your power, O Lord and Master; I am the instrument, and You are the player, O Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲੈਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke prabh karate suaamee jiau bhaavai tivai bulainee ||4||5||
verses.translation: O God, O Creator, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, as You wish, so do I speak. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: anadh mool dhiaaio purakhotam anadhin anadh ana(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the source of bliss, the Sublime Primal Being; night and day, I am in ecstasy and bliss.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਚੂਕੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਛੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharam rai kee kaan chukaiee sabh chooke jam ke chha(n)dhe ||1||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma has no power over me; I have cast off all subservience to the Messenger of Death. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: jap man har har naam guobi(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Meditate, O mind, on the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur satigur paiaa gun gaae paramaana(n)dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਧਿਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat mooR maiaa ke badhik vich maiaa fireh fira(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: The foolish faithless cynics are held captive by Maya; in Maya, they continue wandering, wandering around.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਕਿਰਤ ਕੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa jalat kirat ke baadhe jiau telee baladh bhava(n)dhe ||2||
verses.translation: Burnt by desire, and bound by the karma of their past actions, they go round and round, like the ox at the mill press. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sev lage se udhare vaddabhaagee sev kara(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs, who focus on serving the Guru, are saved; by great good fortune, they perform service.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਤੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੰਦੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin har japiaa tin fal paiaa sabh tooTe maiaa fa(n)dhe ||3||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord obtain the fruits of their rewards, and the bonds of Maya are all broken. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape Thaakur aape sevak sabh aape aap govi(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant. The Lord of the Universe Himself is all by Himself.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਹੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai jiau raakhai tivai raha(n)dhe ||4||6||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, He Himself is All-pervading; as He keeps us, we remain. ||4||6||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ॥
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa paRataal ghar tayrvaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Partaal, Thirteenth House:

verses.original: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: bolahu bhieeaa raam naam patit paavano ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਾਰਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)t bhagat taarano ||
verses.translation: The Lord emancipates his Saints and devotees.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰੇ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har bharipure rahiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere;

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jal thale raam naam ||
verses.translation: the Name of the Lord is pervading the water and the land.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nit gaieeaai har dhookh bisaarano ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So sing continuously of the Lord, the Dispeller of pain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har keeaa hai safal janam hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has made my life fruitful and rewarding.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har japiaa har dhookh bisaaranahaaraa ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Lord, the Dispeller of pain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur bheTiaa hai mukat dhaataa ||
verses.translation: I have met the Guru, the Giver of liberation.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਫਲ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har keeiee hamaaree safal jaataa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has made my life's journey fruitful and rewarding.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)gatee gun gaavano ||1||
verses.translation: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: man raam naam kar aasaa ||
verses.translation: O mortal, place your hopes in the Name of the Lord,

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhaau dhoojaa binas binaasaa ||
verses.translation: and your love of duality shall simply vanish.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਆਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: vich aasaa hoi niraasee ||
verses.translation: One who, in hope, remains unattached to hope,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: so jan miliaa har paasee ||
verses.translation: such a humble being meets with his Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: koiee raam naam gun gaavano ||
verses.translation: And one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name

verses.translit: jan naanak tis pag laavano ||2||1||7||4||6||7||17||
verses.translation: - servant Nanak falls at his feet. ||2||1||7||4||6||7||17||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee aavai tis siau moh ||
verses.translation: He is attached to what he sees.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiau mileeaai prabh abinaasee toh ||
verses.translation: How can I meet You, O Imperishable God?

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa moh maarag paavahu ||
verses.translation: Have Mercy upon me, and place me upon the Path;

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kai a(n)chal laavahu ||1||
verses.translation: let me be attached to the hem of the robe of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiau tareeaai bikhiaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: How can I cross over the poisonous world-ocean?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bohith paavai paar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the boat to carry us across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਵਨ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: pavan jhulaare maiaa dhei ||
verses.translation: The wind of Maya blows and shakes us,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ke bhagat sadhaa thir sei ||
verses.translation: but the Lord's devotees remain ever-stable.

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog te raheh niraaraa ||
verses.translation: They remain unaffected by pleasure and pain.

verses.original: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sir uoopar aap guroo rakhavaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru Himself is the Savior above their heads. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਵੇੜੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰਬ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa veR maiaa sarab bhuia(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Maya, the snake, holds all in her coils.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚੇ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai pache dheepak dhekh pata(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: They burn to death in egotism, like the moth lured by seeing the flame.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sagal seegaar kare nahee paavai ||
verses.translation: They make all sorts of decorations, but they do not find the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa hoi kirapaal taa guroo milaavai ||3||
verses.translation: When the Guru becomes Merciful, He leads them to meet the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਦਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau firau udhaasee mai ik ratan dhasaiaa ||
verses.translation: I wander around, sad and depressed, seeking the jewel of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: niramolak heeraa milai na upaiaa ||
verses.translation: This priceless jewel is not obtained by any efforts.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa ma(n)dhar tis meh laal ||
verses.translation: That jewel is within the body, the Temple of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur kholiaa paRadhaa dhekh bhiee nihaal ||4||
verses.translation: The Guru has torn away the veil of illusion, and beholding the jewel, I am delighted. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin chaakhiaa tis aaiaa saadh ||
verses.translation: One who has tasted it, comes to know its flavor;

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau goo(n)gaa man meh bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: he is like the mute, whose mind is filled with wonder.

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aanadh roop sabh nadharee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I see the Lord, the source of bliss, everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har gun aakh samaiaa ||5||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and merges in Him. ||5||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kaliaan ke'ee gurdhev ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru has blessed me with total happiness.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਾਇਓ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: sevak apanee laio sev ||
verses.translation: He has linked His servant to His service.

verses.original: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bighan na laagai jap alakh abhev ||1||
verses.translation: No obstacles block my path, meditating on the incomprehensible, inscrutable Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਧਰਤਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dharat puneet bhiee gun gaae ||
verses.translation: The soil has been sanctified, singing the Glories of His Praises.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhurat giaa har naam dhiaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sins are eradicated, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਂਈ ਰਵਿਆ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanee thaa(n)iee raviaa aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself is pervading everywhere;

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh jaa kaa vadd parataap ||
verses.translation: from the very beginning, and throughout the ages, His Glory has been radiantly manifest.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh na hoi sa(n)taap ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, sorrow does not touch me. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan lage man meeThe ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Feet seem so sweet to my mind.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਥਾਂਈ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: nirabighan hoi sabh thaa(n)iee vooThe ||
verses.translation: He is unobstructed, dwelling everywhere.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੂਠੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh sukh paae satigur tooThe ||3||
verses.translation: I found total peace, when the Guru was pleased. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh bhe rakhavaale ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become my Savior.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jithai kithai dheeseh naale ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see Him there with me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਖਸਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas khasam pratipaale ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord and Master protects and cherishes His slaves. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh nidhaan preetam prabh mere ||
verses.translation: You are the treasure of peace, O my Beloved God.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਤ ਗੁਣ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aganat gun Thaakur prabh tere ||
verses.translation: Your Glories are uncounted, O God, my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: moh anaath tumaree saranaiee ||
verses.translation: I am an orphan, entering Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa har charan dhiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Have Mercy on me, O Lord, that I may meditate on Your Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karahu basahu man aai ||
verses.translation: Take pity upon me, and abide within my mind;

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun leejai laR lai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am worthless - please let me grasp hold of the hem of Your robe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੀੜ ॥
verses.translit: prabh chit aavai taa kaisee bheeR ||
verses.translation: When God comes into my consciousness, what misfortune can strike me?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੀੜ ॥
verses.translit: har sevak naahee jam peeR ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servant does not suffer pain from the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab dhookh har simarat nase ||
verses.translation: All pains are dispelled, when one remembers the Lord in meditation;

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kai sa(n)g sadhaa prabh basai ||2||
verses.translation: God abides with him forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kaa naam man tan aadhaar ||
verses.translation: The Name of God is the Support of my mind and body.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bisarat naam hovat tan chhaar ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body is reduced to ashes.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਕਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: prabh chit aae pooran sabh kaaj ||
verses.translation: When God comes into my consciousness, all my affairs are resolved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਭ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har bisarat sabh kaa muhataaj ||3||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Lord, one becomes subservient to all. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal sa(n)g laagee preet ||
verses.translation: I am in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bisar giee sabh dhuramat reet ||
verses.translation: I am rid of all evil-minded ways.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar har har ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is deep within my mind and body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagatan kai ghar sadhaa ana(n)dh ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, eternal bliss fills the home of the Lord's devotees. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਯਾਨੜੀਏ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa yaanaRe'e kai ghar gaavanaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Second House, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Yaan-Ree-Ay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: mai man teree Tek mere piaare mai man teree Tek ||
verses.translation: You are the Support of my mind, O my Beloved, You are the Support of my mind.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਬਿਰਥੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar siaanapaa biratheeaa piaare raakhan kau tum ek ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All other clever tricks are useless, O Beloved; You alone are my Protector. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur pooraa je milai piaare so jan hot nihaalaa ||
verses.translation: One who meets with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, that humble person is enraptured.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa so kare piaare jis no hoi dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: He alone serves the Guru, O Beloved, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: safal moorat gurdheau suaamee sarab kalaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the form of the Divine Guru, O Lord and Master; He is overflowing with all powers.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gur paarabraham paramesar sadhaa sadhaa hajoore ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; He is ever-present, forever and ever. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun jeevaa soi tinaa kee jin(h) apunaa prabh jaataa ||
verses.translation: I live by hearing, hearing of those who know their God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam araadheh naam vakhaaneh har naame hee man raataa ||
verses.translation: They contemplate the Lord's Name, they chant the Lord's Name, and their minds are imbued with the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevak jan kee sevaa maagai poorai karam kamaavaa ||
verses.translation: I am Your servant; I beg to serve Your humble servants. By the karma of perfect destiny, I do this.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)tee suaamee tere jan dhekhan paavaa ||2||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer: O my Lord and Master, may I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your humble servants. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇ ਕਾਢੀਅਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee se kaadde'eeh piaare sa(n)tasa(n)gat jinaa vaaso ||
verses.translation: They are said to be very fortunate, O Beloved, who dwell in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam araadheeaai niramal manai hovai paragaaso ||
verses.translation: They contemplate the Immaculate, Ambrosial Naam, and their minds are illuminated.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh kaaTeeaai piaare chookai jam kee kaane ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, O Beloved, and the fear of the Messenger of Death is ended.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tinaa paraapat dharasan naanak jo prabh apane bhaane ||3||
verses.translation: They alone obtain the Blessed Vision of this Darshan, O Nanak, who are pleasing to their God. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: uooch apaar bea(n)t suaamee kaun jaanai gun tere ||
verses.translation: O my lofty, incomparable and infinite Lord and Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

verses.original: ਗਾਵਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸੁਣਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavate udhareh sunate udhareh binaseh paap ghanere ||
verses.translation: Those who sing them are saved, and those who listen to them are saved; all their sins are erased.

verses.original: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੇ ਪਾਹਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: pasoo paret mugadh kau taare paahan paar utaarai ||
verses.translation: You save the beasts, demons and fools, and even stones are carried across.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas teree saranaiee sadhaa sadhaa balihaarai ||4||1||4||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: bikhai ban feekaa tiaag ree sakhe'ee naam mahaa ras peeo ||
verses.translation: Renounce the tasteless water of corruption, O my companion, and drink in the supreme nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ਬੁਡਿ ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਜੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: bin ras chaakhe budd giee sagalee sukhee na hovat jeeo ||
verses.translation: Without the taste of this nectar, all have drowned, and their souls have not found happiness.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਸਾਧਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਥੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: maan mahat na sakat hee kaiee saadhaa dhaasee theeo ||
verses.translation: You have no honor, glory or power - become the slave of the Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕੀਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak se dhar sobhaava(n)te jo prabh apunai keeo ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone look beautiful in the Court of the Lord, whom the Lord has made His Own. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਚਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: haricha(n)dhauree chit bhram sakhe'ee mirag tirasanaa dhrum chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Maya is a mirage, which deludes the mind, O my companion, like the scent-crazed deer, or the transitory shade of a tree.

verses.original: ਚੰਚਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਤੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)chal sa(n)g na chaalatee sakhe'ee a(n)t taj jaavat maiaa ||
verses.translation: Maya is fickle, and does not go with you, O my companion; in the end, it will leave you.

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗਣ ਅਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ras bhogan at roop ras maate in sa(n)g sookh na paiaa ||
verses.translation: He may enjoy pleasures and sensual delights with supremely beautiful women, but no one finds peace in this way.

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸਖੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n har saadh jan sakhe'ee naanak jinee naam dhiaaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are the humble, Holy Saints of the Lord, O my companion. O Nanak, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jai basahu vaddabhaaganee sakhe'ee sa(n)taa sa(n)g samaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Go, O my very fortunate companion: dwell in the Company of the Saints, and merge with the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: teh dhookh na bhookh na rog biaapai charan kamal liv laieeaai ||
verses.translation: There, neither pain nor hunger nor disease will afflict you; enshrine love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: teh janam na maran na aavan jaanaa nihachal saranee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going in reincarnation, when you enter the Sanctuary of the Eternal Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prem bichhoh na moh biaapai naanak har ek dhiaaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Love does not end, and attachment does not grip you, O Nanak, when you meditate on the One Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਤੜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT dhaar man bedhiaa piaare rataRe sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, my Beloved has pierced my mind, and I am intuitively attuned to His Love.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sej suhaavee sa(n)g mil preetam anadh ma(n)gal gun gaae ||
verses.translation: My bed is embellished, meeting with my Beloved; in ecstasy and bliss, I sing His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee sahelee raam ra(n)g raatee man tan ichh pujaae ||
verses.translation: O my friends and companions, I am imbued with the Lord's Love; the desires of my mind and body are satisfied.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak acharaj acharaj siau miliaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaae ||4||2||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the wonder-struck soul blends with the Wonderful Lord; this state cannot be described. ||4||2||5||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਸਗਲੋ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek roop sagalo paasaaraa ||
verses.translation: The entire Universe is the form of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਨਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape banaj aap biauhaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself is the trade, and He Himself is the trader. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso giaan biralo iee paae ||
verses.translation: How rare is that one who is blessed with such spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jat jat jaieeaai tat dhirasaTaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wherever I go, there I see Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: anik ra(n)g niragun ik ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: He manifests many forms, while still unmanifest and absolute, and yet He has One Form.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape jal aap hee tara(n)gaa ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself is the water, and He Himself is the waves. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap hee ma(n)dhar aapeh sevaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the temple, and He Himself is selfless service.

verses.original: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap hee poojaaree aap hee dhevaa ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself is the worshipper, and He Himself is the idol. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਹਿ ਜੋਗ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aapeh jog aap hee jugataa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Yoga; He Himself is the Way.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak ke prabh sadh hee mukataa ||4||1||6||
verses.translation: Nanak's God is forever liberated. ||4||1||6||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਨ ਆਪਿ ਸਧਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaavan aap sadharanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates, and He Himself supports.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap karaavan dhos na lainaa ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself causes all to act; He takes no blame Himself. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਬਚਨੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aapan bachan aap hee karanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the teaching, and He Himself is the teacher.

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਬਿਭਉ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aapan bibhau aap hee jaranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the splendor, and He Himself is the experiencer of it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮਸਟਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਬੁਲਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap hee masaT aap hee bulanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is silent, and He Himself is the speaker.

verses.original: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਅਛਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਛਲਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap hee achhal na jaiee chhalanaa ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself is undeceivable; He cannot be deceived. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਗੁਪਤ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਗਟਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap hee gupat aap paragaTanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is manifest.

verses.original: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap hee ghaT ghaT aap alipanaa ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself is in each and every heart; He Himself is unattached. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਆਪ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape avigat aap sa(n)g rachanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is absolute, and He Himself is with the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh ke sabh jachanaa ||4||2||7||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, all are beggars of God. ||4||2||7||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੂਲੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhoole maarag jineh bataiaa ||
verses.translation: He places the one who strays back on the Path;

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaisaa gur vaddabhaagee paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: such a Guru is found by great good fortune. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: simar manaa raam naam chitaare ||
verses.translation: Meditate, contemplate the Name of the Lord, O mind.

verses.original: ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bas rahe hiradhai gur charan piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Feet of the Guru abide within my heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh man leenaa ||
verses.translation: The mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaT mukat gur keenaa ||2||
verses.translation: Breaking my bonds, the Guru has liberated me. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh karat janam fun mooaa ||
verses.translation: Experiencing pain and pleasure, one is born, only to die again.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan kamal gur aasram dheeaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Lotus Feet of the Guru bring peace and shelter. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੂਡਤ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: agan saagar booddat sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: The world is drowning in the ocean of fire.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak baeh pakar satigur nisataaraa ||4||3||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, holding me by the arm, the True Guru has saved me. ||4||3||8||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tan man dhan arapau sabh apanaa ||
verses.translation: Body, mind, wealth and everything, I surrender to my Lord.

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kavan su mat jit har har japanaa ||1||
verses.translation: What is that wisdom, by which I may come to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਗਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar aasaa aaio prabh maagan ||
verses.translation: Nurturing hope, I have come to beg from God.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਆਗਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) pekhat sobhaa merai aagan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon You, the courtyard of my heart is embellished. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik jugat kar bahut beechaarau ||
verses.translation: Trying several methods, I reflect deeply upon the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g is maneh udhaarau ||2||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this mind is saved. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mat budh surat naahee chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: I have neither intelligence, wisdom, common sense nor cleverness.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa mileeaai jaa le milaiee ||3||
verses.translation: I meet You, only if You lead me to meet You. ||3||

verses.original: ਨੈਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nain sa(n)tokhe prabh dharasan paiaa ||
verses.translation: My eyes are content, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੋ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak safal so aaiaa ||4||4||9||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, such a life is fruitful and rewarding. ||4||4||9||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut saath na maiaa ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, children and the wealth of Maya, will not go along with you.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g sabh dhookh miTaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pain is dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: rav rahiaa prabh sabh meh aape ||
verses.translation: God Himself is pervading, and permeating all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jap rasanaa dhukh na viaape ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, and pain will not afflict you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਖਾ ਭੂਖ ਬਹੁ ਤਪਤਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tikhaa bhookh bahu tapat viaapiaa ||
verses.translation: One who is afflicted by the terrible fire of thirst and desire,

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: seetal bhe har har jas jaapiaa ||2||
verses.translation: becomes cool, chanting the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koT jatan sa(n)tokh na paiaa ||
verses.translation: By millions of efforts, peace is not obtained;

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man tirapataanaa har gun gaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: the mind is satisfied only by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: dheh bhagat prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with devotion, O God, O Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)tee suaamee ||4||5||10||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord and Master. ||4||5||10||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa vaddabhaagee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the Perfect Guru is found.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo har naam dhiaaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Holy Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh teree saranaa ||
verses.translation: O Supreme Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kilabikh kaaTai bhaj gur ke charanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Guru's Feet, sinful mistakes are erased. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: avar karam sabh lokaachaar ||
verses.translation: All other rituals are just worldly affairs;

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo sa(n)g hoi udhaar ||2||
verses.translation: joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)mirat saasat bedh beechaare ||
verses.translation: One may contemplate the Simritees, Shaastras and Vedas,

verses.original: ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: japeeaai naam jit paar utaare ||3||
verses.translation: but only by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is one saved and carried across. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa kareeaai ||
verses.translation: Have Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God,

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: saadhoo dhoor milai nisatareeaai ||4||6||11||
verses.translation: and bless him with the dust of the feet of the Holy, that he may be emancipated. ||4||6||11||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh ridhe meh cheenaa ||
verses.translation: I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad within my heart;

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath pooran aaseenaa ||1||
verses.translation: all my hopes and desires are fulfilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kaa mukh uoojal keenaa ||
verses.translation: The faces of the humble Saints are radiant and bright;

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apunaa naam dheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: the Lord has mercifully blessed them with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop te kar geh leenaa ||
verses.translation: Holding them by the hand, He has lifted them up out of the deep, dark pit,

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar jagat pragaTeenaa ||2||
verses.translation: and their victory is celebrated throughout the world. ||2||

verses.original: ਨੀਚਾ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਊਨ ਪੂਰੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: neechaa te uooch uoon pooreenaa ||
verses.translation: He elevates and exalts the lowly, and fills the empty.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
