verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam mahaa ras leenaa ||3||
verses.translation: They receive the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਜਲਿ ਖੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal paap jal kheenaa ||
verses.translation: The mind and body are made immaculate and pure, and sins are burnt to ashes.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਸੀਨਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh bhe praseenaa ||4||7||12||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, God is pleased with me. ||4||7||12||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath paie'eeh meetaa ||
verses.translation: All desires are fulfilled, O my friend,

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau laieeaai cheetaa ||1||
verses.translation: lovingly centering your consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree jo prabhoo dhiaavat ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on God.

verses.original: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jalan bujhai har har gun gaavat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The fire of desire is quenched, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam hovat vaddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: One's life become fruitful and rewarding, by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g raameh liv laagee ||2||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, enshrine love for the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mat pat dhan sukh sahaj ana(n)dhaa || ik nimakh na visarahu paramaana(n)dhaa ||3||
verses.translation: Wisdom, honor, wealth, peace and celestial bliss are attained, if one does not forget the Lord of supreme bliss, even for an instant. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har dharasan kee man piaas ghaneree ||
verses.translation: My mind is so very thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak saran prabh teree ||4||8||13||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, O God, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||4||8||13||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਭ ਗੁਣਹ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun sabh guneh bihoonaa ||
verses.translation: I am worthless, totally lacking all virtues.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhaar apunaa kar leenaa ||1||
verses.translation: Bless me with Your Mercy, and make me Your Own. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man tan har gopaal suhaiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are embellished by the Lord, the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh ghar meh aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Granting His Mercy, God has come into the home of my heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal bhai kaaTanahaare ||
verses.translation: He is the Lover and Protector of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਬ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar ab utare paare ||2||
verses.translation: Now, I have been carried across the world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan prabh biradh bedh lekhiaa ||
verses.translation: It is God's Way to purify sinners, say the Vedas.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paarabraham so nainahu pekhiaa ||3||
verses.translation: I have seen the Supreme Lord with my eyes. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g pragaTe naarain ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord becomes manifest.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sabh dhookh palain ||4||9||14||
verses.translation: O slave Nanak, all pains are relieved. ||4||9||14||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: kavan jaanai prabh tum(h)ree sevaa ||
verses.translation: Who can know the value of serving You, God?

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh avinaasee alakh abhevaa ||1||
verses.translation: God is imperishable, invisible and incomprehensible. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gun bea(n)t prabh gahir ga(n)bheere ||
verses.translation: His Glorious Virtues are infinite; God is profound and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਮਹਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: uooch mahal suaamee prabh mere ||
verses.translation: The Mansion of God, my Lord and Master, is lofty and high.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too apara(n)par Thaakur mere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are unlimited, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: ekas bin naahee ko dhoojaa ||
verses.translation: There is no other than the One Lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tum(h) hee jaanahu apanee poojaa ||2||
verses.translation: You alone know Your worship and adoration. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapahu kachhoo na hovat bhaiee ||
verses.translation: No one can do anything by himself, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis prabh dhevai so naam paiee ||3||
verses.translation: He alone obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God bestows it. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jo jan prabh bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, that humble being who pleases God,

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan prabh tin hee paiaa ||4||10||15||
verses.translation: he alone finds God, the treasure of virtue. ||4||10||15||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: maat garabh meh haath dhe raakhiaa ||
verses.translation: Extending His Hand, the Lord protected you in your mother's womb.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ras chhodd bikhiaa fal chaakhiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Renouncing the sublime essence of the Lord, you have tasted the fruit of poison. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: bhaj gobidh sabh chhodd ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and renounce all entanglements.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੂੜੇ ਤਬ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਬੇਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab jam aai sa(n)ghaarai mooRe tab tan binas jai behaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the Messenger of Death comes to murder you, O fool, then your body will be shattered and helplessly crumble. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan man dhan apanaa kar thaapiaa ||
verses.translation: You hold onto your body, mind and wealth as your own,

verses.original: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karanahaar ik nimakh na jaapiaa ||2||
verses.translation: and you do not meditate on the Creator Lord, even for an instant. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa moh a(n)dh koop pariaa ||
verses.translation: You have fallen into the deep, dark pit of great attachment.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਟਲਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paarabraham maiaa paTal bisariaa ||3||
verses.translation: Caught in the illusion of Maya, you have forgotten the Supreme Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag prabh keeratan gaiaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one sings the Kirtan of God's Praises.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g naanak prabh paiaa ||4||11||16||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, Nanak has found God. ||4||11||16||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhap bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, children, relatives and siblings

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak hoaa paarabraham sahaiee ||1||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, the Supreme Lord is our help and support. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ghane ||
verses.translation: He blesses us with peace, and abundant celestial bliss.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਗਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa pooree jaa kee baanee anik gunaa jaa ke jaeh na gane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Perfect is the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. His Virtues are so many, they cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਰੰਜਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal sara(n)jaam kare prabh aape ||
verses.translation: God Himself makes all arrangements.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhe manorath so prabh jaape ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating on God, desires are fulfilled. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: arath dharam kaam mokh kaa dhaataa ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of wealth, Dharmic faith, pleasure and liberation.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੀ ਭਈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pooree bhiee simar simar bidhaataa ||3||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny, I am fulfilled. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak ra(n)g maaniaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak enjoys the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: ghar aaiaa poorai gur aaniaa ||4||12||17||
verses.translation: He has returned home, with the Perfect Guru. ||4||12||17||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: srab nidhaan pooran gurdhev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All treasures come from the Perfect Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਰ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japat nar jeeve ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the man lives.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਥੀਵੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mar khuaar saakat nar theeve ||1||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic dies in shame and misery. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam hoaa rakhavaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord has become my Protector.

verses.original: ਝਖ ਮਾਰਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jhakh maarau saakat vechaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The wretched, faithless cynic makes only useless efforts. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhaa kar kar pacheh ghanere ||
verses.translation: Spreading slander, many have been ruined.

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਫਾਸ ਗਲੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mritak faas galai sir paire ||3||
verses.translation: Their necks, heads and feet are tied by death's noose. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak japeh jan naam ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the humble devotees chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਮ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: taa ke nikaT na aavai jaam ||4||13||18||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||4||13||18||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਮਿਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: kavan sa(n)jog milau prabh apane ||
verses.translation: What blessed destiny will lead me to meet my God?

verses.original: ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pal pal nimakh sadhaa har japane ||1||
verses.translation: Each and every moment and instant, I continually meditate on the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal prabh ke nit dhiaavau ||
verses.translation: I meditate continually on the Lotus Feet of God.

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kavan su mat jit preetam paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What wisdom will lead me to attain my Beloved? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee kirapaa karahu prabh mere ||
verses.translation: Please, bless me with such Mercy, O my God,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: har naanak bisar na kaahoo bere ||2||1||19||
verses.translation: that Nanak may never, ever forget You. ||2||1||19||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal prabh hiradhai dhiaae ||
verses.translation: Within my heart, I meditate on the Lotus Feet of God.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rog ge sagale sukh paae ||1||
verses.translation: Disease is gone, and I have found total peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhukh kaaTiaa dheeno dhaan ||
verses.translation: The Guru relieved my sufferings, and blessed me with the gift.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam jeevan paravaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My birth has been rendered fruitful, and my life is approved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathaa a(n)mirat prabh baanee ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Bani of God's Word is the Unspoken Speech.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jap jeeve giaanee ||2||2||20||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the spiritually wise live by meditating on God. ||2||2||20||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t paiee gur satigur poore ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, has blessed me with peace and tranquility.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh upaje baaje anahadh toore ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Peace and joy have welled up, and the mystical trumpets of the unstruck sound current vibrate. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: taap paap sa(n)taap binaase ||
verses.translation: Sufferings, sins and afflictions have been dispelled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har simarat kilavikh sabh naase ||1||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all sinful mistakes have been erased. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadh karahu mil su(n)dhar naaree ||
verses.translation: Joining together, O beautiful soul-brides, celebrate and make merry.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: gur naanak meree paij savaaree ||2||3||21||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak has saved my honor. ||2||3||21||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: mamataa moh dhroh madh maataa ba(n)dhan baadhiaa at bikaraal ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with the wine of attachment, love of worldly possessions and deceit, and bound in bondage, he is wild and hideous.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਛਿਜਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਅਉਧ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥਾ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhin dhin chhijat bikaar karat aaudh faahee faathaa jam kai jaal ||1||
verses.translation: Day by day, his life is winding down; practicing sin and corruption, he is trapped by the noose of Death. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: teree saran prabh dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, O God, Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa bikham saagar at bhaaree udharahu saadhoo sa(n)g ravaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have crossed over the terrible, treacherous, enormous world-ocean, with the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: prabh sukhadhaate samarath suaamee jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tumaraa maal ||
verses.translation: O God, Giver of peace, All-powerful Lord and Master, my soul, body and all wealth are Yours.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: bhram ke ba(n)dhan kaaTahu paramesar naanak ke prabh sadhaa kirapaal ||2||4||22||
verses.translation: Please, break my bonds of doubt, O Transcendent Lord, forever Merciful God of Nanak. ||2||4||22||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sagal ana(n)dh keeaa paramesar apanaa biradh sam(h)aariaa ||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord has brought bliss to all; He has confirmed His Natural Way.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਬਿਗਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa hoe kirapaalaa bigase sabh paravaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: He has become Merciful to the humble, holy Saints, and all my relatives blossom forth in joy. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaaraj satigur aap savaariaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru Himself has resolved my affairs.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee aarajaa har gobi(n)dh kee sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan beechaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has blessed Hargobind with long life, and taken care of my comfort, happiness and well-being. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: van tiran tirabhavan hariaa hoe sagale jeea saadhaariaa ||
verses.translation: The forests, meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in greenery; He gives His Support to all beings.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: man ichhe naanak fal paae pooran ichh pujaariaa ||2||5||23||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires; his desires are totally fulfilled. ||2||5||23||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis uoopar hovat dhiaal ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har simarat kaaTai so kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: passes his time in contemplative meditation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g bhajeeaai gopaal ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat tooTai jam jaal ||1||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the noose of death is cut away. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: aape satigur aape pratipaal ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Cherisher.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak jaachai saadh ravaal ||2||6||24||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||2||6||24||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: man meh si(n)chahu har har naam ||
verses.translation: Irrigate your mind with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin keeratan har gun gaam ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee preet karahu man mere ||
verses.translation: Enshrine such love, O my mind,

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar prabh jaanahu nere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that twenty-four hours a day, God will seem near to you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jaa ke niramal bhaag ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who has such immaculate destiny

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: har charanee taa kaa man laag ||2||7||25||
verses.translation: - his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||2||7||25||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: rog giaa prabh aap gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The disease is gone; God Himself took it away.

verses.original: ਨੀਦ ਪਈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: needh piee sukh sahaj ghar aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I sleep in peace; peaceful poise has come to my home. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raj raj bhojan khaavahu mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Eat to your fill, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam ridh maeh dhiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gur poore saranaiee ||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: jin apane naam kee paij rakhaiee ||2||8||26||
verses.translation: who has preserved the honor of His Name. ||2||8||26||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kar dheene asathir ghar baar || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has protected my hearth and home, and made them permanent. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਇਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਮਾਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jo ni(n)dh karai in girahan kee tis aagai hee maarai karataar ||1||
verses.translation: Whoever slanders these homes, is pre-destined by the Creator Lord to be destroyed. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੰਡ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas taa kee saranaiee jaa ko sabadh akha(n)dd apaar ||2||9||27||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; the Word of His Shabad is unbreakable and infinite. ||2||9||27||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਗਏ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: taap sa(n)taap sagale ge binase te rog ||
verses.translation: The fever and sickness are gone, and the diseases are all dispelled.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham too bakhasiaa sa(n)tan ras bhog || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has forgiven you, so enjoy the happiness of the Saints. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa teree ma(n)ddalee teraa man tan aarog ||
verses.translation: All joys have entered your world, and your mind and body are free of disease.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਇਹ ਅਵਖਦ ਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun gaavahu nit raam ke ieh avakhadh jog ||1||
verses.translation: So chant continuously the Glorious Praises of the Lord; this is the only potent medicine. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਦੇਸ ਮਹਿ ਇਹ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: aai basahu ghar dhes meh ieh bhale sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: So come, and dwell in your home and native land; this is such a blessed and auspicious occasion.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਲਹਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਓਗ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh suprasa(n)n bhe leh ge biog ||2||10||28||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with you; your time of separation has come to an end. ||2||10||28||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo sa(n)g na chaalahee maiaa ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: The entanglements of Maya do not go along with anyone.

verses.original: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਖਿਆਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooTh sidhaare chhatrapat sa(n)tan kai khiaal || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even kings and rulers must arise and depart, according to the wisdom of the Saints. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਨਾ ਇਹ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਢਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)budh kau binasanaa ieh dhur kee ddaal ||
verses.translation: Pride goes before the fall - this is a primal law.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bahu jonee janameh mareh bikhiaa bikaraal ||1||
verses.translation: Those who practice corruption and sin, are born into countless incarnations, only to die again. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sat bachan saadhoo kaheh nit japeh gupaal ||
verses.translation: The Holy Saints chant Words of Truth; they meditate continually on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: simar simar naanak tare har ke ra(n)g laal ||2||11||29||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, those who are imbued with the color of the Lord's Love are carried across. ||2||11||29||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੂਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaadh ana(n)dh sookh poore gur dheen ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with celestial Samaadhi, bliss and peace.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sahaiee sa(n)g prabh a(n)mirat gun cheen || rahaau ||
verses.translation: God is always my Helper and Companion; I contemplate His Ambrosial Virtues. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar jagatr meh locheh sabh jeeaa ||
verses.translation: Triumphant cheers greet me all across the world, and all beings yearn for me.

verses.original: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: suprasa(n)n bhe satigur prabhoo kachh bighan na theeaa ||1||
verses.translation: The True Guru and God are totally pleased with me; no obstacle blocks my way. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa a(n)g dhiaal prabh taa ke sabh dhaas ||
verses.translation: One who has the Merciful Lord God on his side - everyone becomes his slave.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa vaddiaaieeaa naanak gur paas ||2||12||30||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, O Nanak, glorious greatness rests with the Guru. ||2||12||30||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar panjavaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: mirat ma(n)ddal jag saajiaa jiau baaloo ghar baar ||
verses.translation: This perishable realm and world has been made like a house of sand.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਗਦ ਬੂੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binasat baar na laagiee jiau kaagadh boo(n)dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: In no time at all, it is destroyed, like the paper drenched with water. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sun meree manasaa manai maeh sat dhekh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Listen to me, people: behold, and consider this within your mind.

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik girahee jogee taj ge ghar baar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas, the seekers, house-holders and Yogis have forsaken their homes and left. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਿ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa supanaa rain kaa taisaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: This world is like a dream in the night.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਲਗਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhirasaTimaan sabh binaseeaai kiaa lageh gavaar ||2||
verses.translation: All that is seen shall perish. Why are you attached to it, you fool? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਨੈਨ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa su bhaiee meet hai dhekh nain pasaar ||
verses.translation: Where are your brothers and friends? Open your eyes and see!

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eik chaale ik chaalaseh sabh apanee vaar ||3||
verses.translation: Some have gone, and some will go; everyone must take his turn. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin pooraa satigur seviaa se asathir har dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Perfect True Guru, remain ever-stable at the Door of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kaa dhaas hai raakh paij muraar ||4||1||31||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; preserve his honor, O Lord, Destroyer of ego. ||4||1||31||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਗਉ ॥
verses.translit: lokan keeaa vaddiaaieeaa baisa(n)tar paagau ||
verses.translation: The glories of the world, I cast into the fire.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਨਾ ਤੇ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਾਗਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau milai piaaraa aapanaa te bol karaagau ||1||
verses.translation: I chant those words, by which I may meet my Beloved. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਤਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥
verses.translit: jau prabh jeeau dhiaal hoi tau bhagatee laagau ||
verses.translation: When God becomes Merciful, then He enjoins me to His devotional service.

verses.original: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lapaT rahio man baasanaa gur mil ieh tiaagau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind clings to worldly desires; meeting with the Guru, I have renounced them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਮਾਗਉ ॥
verses.translit: karau benatee at ghanee ih jeeau homaagau ||
verses.translation: I pray with intense devotion, and offer this soul to Him.

verses.original: ਅਰਥ ਆਨ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਿਮਖ ਸੋਹਾਗਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: arath aan sabh vaariaa pria nimakh sohaagau ||2||
verses.translation: I would sacrifice all other riches, for a moment's union with my Beloved. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਗਉ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch sa(n)g gur te chhuTe dhokh ar raagau ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, I am rid of the five villains, as well as emotional love and hate.

verses.original: ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਜਾਗਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ridhai pragaas pragaT bhiaa nis baasur jaagau ||3||
verses.translation: My heart is illumined, and the Lord has become manifest; night and day, I remain awake and aware. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥
verses.translit: saran sohaagan aaiaa jis masatak bhaagau ||
verses.translation: The blessed soul-bride seeks His Sanctuary; her destiny is recorded on her forehead.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tin paiaa tan man seetalaagau ||4||2||32||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, she obtains her Husband Lord; her body and mind are cooled and soothed. ||4||2||32||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: laal ra(n)g tis kau lagaa jis ke vaddabhaagaa ||
verses.translation: One is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mailaa kadhe na hoviee neh laagai dhaagaa ||1||
verses.translation: This color is never muddied; no stain ever sticks to it. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਈਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh paiaa sukhadhaieeaa miliaa sukh bhai ||
verses.translation: He finds God, the Giver of peace, with feelings of joy.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਭੀਤਰੇ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaanaa bheetare chhoddiaa neh jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Celestial Lord blends into his soul, and he can never leave Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaraa maraa neh viaapiee fir dhookh na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Old age and death cannot touch him, and he shall not suffer pain again.

verses.original: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਘਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pee a(n)mrit aaghaaniaa gur amar karaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is satisfied; the Guru makes him immortal. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: so jaanai jin chaakhiaa har naam amolaa ||
verses.translation: He alone knows its taste, who tastes the Priceless Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: keemat kahee na jaieeaai kiaa keh mukh bolaa ||3||
verses.translation: Its value cannot be estimated; what can I say with my mouth? ||3||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: safal dharas teraa paarabraham gun nidh teree baanee ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Supreme Lord God. The Word of Your Bani is the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਪਾਵਉ ਧੂਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: paavau dhoor tere dhaas kee naanak kurabaanee ||4||3||33||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||4||3||33||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raakhahu apanee saran prabh moh kirapaa dhaare ||
verses.translation: Keep me under Your Protection, God; shower me with Your Mercy.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਊ ਨੀਚੁ ਮੂਰਖਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sevaa kachhoo na jaanuoo neech moorakhaare ||1||
verses.translation: I do not know how to serve You; I am just a low-life fool. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਊਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maan karau tudh uoopare mere preetam piaare ||
verses.translation: I take pride in You, O my Darling Beloved.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਤੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham aparaadhee sadh bhoolate tum(h) bakhasanahaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sinner, continuously making mistakes; You are the Forgiving Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਰਹ ਅਸੰਖ ਨੀਤਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham avagan kareh asa(n)kh neet tum(h) niragun dhaataare ||
verses.translation: I make mistakes each and every day. You are the Great Giver;

verses.original: ਦਾਸੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhaasee sa(n)gat prabhoo tiaag e karam hamaare ||2||
verses.translation: I am worthless. I associate with Maya, your hand-maiden, and I renounce You, God; such are my actions. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਹਮ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਨਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) dhevahu sabh kichh dhiaa dhaar ham akirataghanaare ||
verses.translation: You bless me with everything, showering me with Mercy; And I am such an ungrateful wretch!

verses.original: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਖਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: laag pare tere dhaan siau neh chit khasamaare ||3||
verses.translation: I am attached to Your gifts, but I do not even think of You, O my Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਵ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tujh te baahar kichh nahee bhav kaaTanahaare ||
verses.translation: There is none other than You, O Lord, Destroyer of fear.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak saran dhiaal gur leh mugadh udhaare ||4||4||34||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Guru; I am so foolish - please, save me! ||4||4||34||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhos na kaahoo dheejeeaai prabh apanaa dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Don't blame anyone else; meditate on your God.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਨਾ ਮਨ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jit seviaai sukh hoi ghanaa man soiee gaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Serving Him, great peace is obtained; O mind, sing His Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਝੁ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaheeaai kai piaare tujh binaa ||
verses.translation: O Beloved, other than You, who else should I ask?

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਅਵਗਨ ਹਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) dhiaal suaamee sabh avagan hamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my Merciful Lord and Master; I am filled with all faults. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau tum(h) raakhahu tiau rahaa avar nahee chaaraa ||
verses.translation: As You keep me, I remain; there is no other way.

verses.original: ਨੀਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: needhariaa dhar tereeaa ik naam adhaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: You are the Support of the unsupported; You Name is my only Support. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਲੇਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo tum(h) karahu soiee bhalaa man letaa mukataa ||
verses.translation: One who accepts whatever You do as good - that mind is liberated.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sagal samagree tereeaa sabh teree jugataa ||3||
verses.translation: The entire creation is Yours; all are subject to Your Ways. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: charan pakhaarau kar sevaa je Thaakur bhaavai ||
verses.translation: I wash Your Feet and serve You, if it pleases You, O Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: hoh kirapaal dhiaal prabh naanak gun gaavai ||4||5||35||
verses.translation: Be Merciful, O God of Compassion, that Nanak may sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||5||35||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਹਸੈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰੇ ਪਸੂਆ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: mrit hasai sir uoopare pasooaa nahee boojhai ||
verses.translation: Death hovers over his head, laughing, but the beast does not understand.

verses.original: ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baadh saadh aha(n)kaar meh maranaa nahee soojhai ||1||
verses.translation: Entangled in conflict, pleasure and egotism, he does not even think of death. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਫਿਰਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevahu aapanaa kaahe firahu abhaage ||
verses.translation: So serve your True Guru; why wander around miserable and unfortunate?

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh kasu(n)bhaa ra(n)gulaa kaahe bhool laage ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You gaze upon the transitory, beautiful safflower, but why do you get attached to it? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਦਰਬੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਰਤਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar paap dharab keeaa varatan kai taiee ||
verses.translation: You commit sins again and again, to gather wealth to spend.

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲੀ ਨਾਗਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maaTee siau maaTee ralee naagaa uTh jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: But your dust shall mix with dust; you shall arise and depart naked. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਐ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਤੇ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai keeaai sram karai te bair birodhee ||
verses.translation: Those for whom you work, will become your spiteful enemies.

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਲਹੁ ਕਰੋਧੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal bhaj jaahige kaahe jalahu karodhee ||3||
verses.translation: In the end, they will run away from you; why do you burn for them in anger? ||3||

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas ren soiee hoaa jis masatak karamaa ||
verses.translation: He alone becomes the dust of the Lord's slaves, who has such good karma upon his forehead.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ba(n)dhan chhuTe satigur kee saranaa ||4||6||36||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, he is released from bondage, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||4||6||36||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਖਲ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਕੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: pi(n)gul parabat paar pare khal chatur bakeetaa ||
verses.translation: The cripple crosses over the mountain, the fool becomes a wise man,

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੂਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhule tirabhavan soojhiaa gur bheT puneetaa ||1||
verses.translation: and the blind man sees the three worlds, by meeting with the True Guru and being purified. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: mahimaa saadhoo sa(n)g kee sunahu mere meetaa ||
verses.translation: This is the Glory of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; listen, O my friends.

verses.original: ਮੈਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਹਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mail khoiee koT agh hare niramal bhe cheetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Filth is washed away, millions of sins are dispelled, and the consciousness becomes immaculate and pure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee bhagat govi(n)dh kee keeT hasatee jeetaa ||
verses.translation: Such is devotional worship of the Lord of the Universe, that the ant can overpower the elephant.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਪਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo jo keeno aapano tis abhai dhaan dheetaa ||2||
verses.translation: Whoever the Lord makes His own, is blessed with the gift of fearlessness. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿੰਘੁ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਮੇਰੁ ਦਿਖੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)gh bilaiee hoi gio tiran mer dhikheetaa ||
verses.translation: The lion becomes a cat, and the mountain looks like a blade of grass.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਦਮ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਗਨੀ ਧਨੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sram karate dham aadd kau te ganee dhaneetaa ||3||
verses.translation: Those who worked for half a shell, will be judged very wealthy. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kavan vaddaiee keh sakau bea(n)t guneetaa ||
verses.translation: What glorious greatness of Yours can I describe, O Lord of infinite excellences?

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰ ਸਰੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa moh naam dheh naanak dhar sareetaa ||4||7||37||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and grant me Your Name; O Nanak, I am lost without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||7||37||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਬਾਦ ਨੀਤ ਲੋਭ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)budh parabaadh neet lobh rasanaa saadh ||
verses.translation: He is constantly entangled in pride, conflict, greed and tasty flavors.

verses.original: ਲਪਟਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆਦਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lapaT kapaT gireh bedhiaa mithiaa bikhiaadh ||1||
verses.translation: He is involved in deception, fraud, household affairs and corruption. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee pekhee netr meh poore gur parasaadh ||
verses.translation: I have seen this with my eyes, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨਾ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raaj milakh dhan jobanaa naamai bin baadh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Power, property, wealth and youth are useless, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਸੋਗੰਧਤਾ ਕਾਪਰ ਭੋਗਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: roop dhoop soga(n)dhataa kaapar bhogaadh ||
verses.translation: Beauty, incense, scented oils, beautiful clothes and foods

verses.original: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਰਗਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: milat sa(n)g paapisaT tan hoe dhuragaadh ||2||
verses.translation: - when they come into contact with the body of the sinner, they stink. ||2||

verses.original: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗਨ ਦੇਹਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: firat firat maanukh bhiaa khin bha(n)gan dhehaadh ||
verses.translation: Wandering, wandering around, the soul is reincarnated as a human, but this body lasts only for an instant.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਅਉਸਰ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eeh aausar te chookiaa bahu jon bhramaadh ||3||
verses.translation: Losing this opportunity, he must wander again through countless incarnations. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kirapaa te gur mile har har bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, he meets the Guru; contemplating the Lord, Har, Har, he is wonderstruck.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨੰਦ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੪॥੮॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj naanak ana(n)dh taa kai pooran naadh ||4||8||38||
verses.translation: He is blessed with peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak, through the perfect sound current of the Naad. ||4||8||38||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: charan bhe sa(n)t bohithaa tare saagar jet ||
verses.translation: The feet of the Saints are the boat, to cross over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗ ਪਾਏ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਭੇਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maarag paae udhiaan meh gur dhase bhet ||1||
verses.translation: In the wilderness, the Guru places them on the Path, and reveals the secrets of the Lord's Mystery. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har har hare har har har het ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har Har Har, Har Har Haray, Har Har Har, I love You.

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat sovate har har har chet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, think of the Lord, Har Har Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਆਗੈ ਭਗੇ ਜਬ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch chor aagai bhage jab saadhasa(n)get ||
verses.translation: The five thieves run away, when one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਘਣੋ ਲਾਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee saabat ghano laabh gireh sobhaa set ||2||
verses.translation: His investment is intact, and he earns great profits; his household is blessed with honor. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਣੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਲੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal aasan miTee chi(n)t naahee ddolet ||
verses.translation: His position is unmoving and eternal, his anxiety is ended, and he wavers no more.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੇਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulaavaa miT giaa prabh pekhat net ||3||
verses.translation: His doubts and misgivings are dispelled, and he sees God everywhere. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਭੀਰ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: gun gabheer gun naikaa gun kahe'eeh ket ||
verses.translation: The Virtues of our Virtuous Lord and Master are so profound; how many of His Glorious Virtues should I speak?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰੇਤ ॥੪॥੯॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: naanak paiaa saadhasa(n)g har har a(n)mret ||4||9||39||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Holy. ||4||9||39||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਤੇਤੋ ਬਿਰਥਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin saadhoo jo jeevanaa teto birathaaree ||
verses.translation: That life, which has no contact with the Holy, is useless.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਿਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: milat sa(n)g sabh bhram miTe gat bhiee hamaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Joining their congregation, all doubts are dispelled, and I am emancipated. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa dhin bheTe saadh moh uaa dhin balihaaree ||
verses.translation: That day, when I meet with the Holy - I am a sacrifice to that day.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan man apano jeearaa fir fir hau vaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Again and again, I sacrifice my body, mind and soul to them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਤ ਛਡਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੇ ਇਤਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: et chhaddaiee moh te itanee dhiraRataaree ||
verses.translation: They have helped me renounce this ego, and implant this humility within myself.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਅਪਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sagal ren ih man bhiaa binasee apadhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: This mind has become the dust of all men's feet, and my self-conceit has been dispelled. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਪਰ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dh chi(n)dh par dhookhanaa e khin meh jaaree ||
verses.translation: In an instant, I burnt away the ideas of slander and ill-will towards others.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhiaa miaa ar nikaT pekh naahee dhooraaree ||3||
verses.translation: I see close at hand, the Lord of mercy and compassion; He is not far away at all. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਅਬ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tan man seetal bhe ab mukate sa(n)saaree ||
verses.translation: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, and now, I am liberated from the world.

verses.original: ਹੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: heet cheet sabh praan dhan naanak dharasaaree ||4||10||40||
verses.translation: Love, consciousness, the breath of life, wealth and everything, O Nanak, are in the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||10||40||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਬਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: Tahal karau tere dhaas kee pag jhaarau baal ||
verses.translation: I perform service for Your slave, O Lord, and wipe his feet with my hair.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਰਸਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: masatak apanaa bheT dheau gun sunau rasaal ||1||
verses.translation: I offer my head to him, and listen to the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the source of bliss. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਓ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) milate meraa man jeeo tum(h) milahu dhiaal ||
verses.translation: Meeting You, my mind is rejuvenated, so please meet me, O Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nis baasur man anadh hot chitavat kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, my mind enjoys bliss, contemplating the Lord of Compassion. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨੑ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: jagat udhaaran saadh prabh tin(h) laagahu paal ||
verses.translation: God's Holy people are the saviors of the world; I grab hold of the hem of their robes.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਗ ਰਾਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mo kau dheejai dhaan prabh sa(n)tan pag raal ||2||
verses.translation: Bless me, O God, with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: aukat siaanap kachh nahee naahee kachh ghaal ||
verses.translation: I have no skill or wisdom at all, nor any work to my credit.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੋਹ ਤੇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhram bhai raakhahu moh te kaaTahu jam jaal ||3||
verses.translation: Please, protect me from doubt, fear and emotional attachment, and cut away the noose of Death from my neck. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: binau karau karunaapate pitaa pratipaal ||
verses.translation: I beg of You, O Lord of Mercy, O my Father, please cherish me!

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: gun gaavau tere saadhasa(n)g naanak sukh saal ||4||11||41||
verses.translation: I sing Your Glorious Praises, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Lord, Home of peace. ||4||11||41||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa loReh so kareh tujh bin kachh naeh ||
verses.translation: Whatever You wish, You do. Without You, there is nothing.

verses.original: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: parataap tum(h)aaraa dhekh kai jamadhoot chhadd jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon Your Glory, the Messenger of Death leaves and goes away. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree kirapaa te chhooTeeaai binasai aha(n)mev ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, one is emancipated, and egotism is dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa samarath prabh poore gurdhev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God is omnipotent, possessing all powers; He is obtained through the Perfect, Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat khojiaa naamai bin koor ||
verses.translation: Searching, searching, searching - without the Naam, everything is false.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeevan sukh sabh saadhasa(n)g prabh manasaa poor ||2||
verses.translation: All the comforts of life are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; God is the Fulfiller of desires. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਭ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: jit jit laavahu tit tit lageh siaanap sabh jaalee ||
verses.translation: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; I have burnt away all my cleverness.

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਮੑ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jat kat tum(h) bharapoor hahu mere dheen dhiaalee ||3||
verses.translation: You are permeating and pervading everywhere, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh tum te maaganaa vaddabhaagee paae ||
verses.translation: I ask for everything from You, but only the very fortunate ones obtain it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kee aradhaas prabh jeevaa gun gaae ||4||12||42||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer, O God, I live by singing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||12||42||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਾਸਬੈ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਨਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kai baasabai kalamal sabh nasanaa ||
verses.translation: Dwelling in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sins are erased.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh setee ra(n)g raatiaa taa te garabh na grasanaa ||1||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Love of God, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਭਈ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam kahat govi(n)dh kaa soochee bhiee rasanaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, the tongue becomes holy.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal hoiee hai gur kaa jap japanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The mind and body become immaculate and pure, chanting the Chant of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਤ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਹਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ras chaakhat dhraapiaa man ras lai hasanaa ||
verses.translation: Tasting the subtle essence of the Lord, one is satisfied; receiving this essence, the mind becomes happy.

verses.original: ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਉਲਟਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: budh pragaas pragaT bhiee ulaT kamal bigasanaa ||2||
verses.translation: The intellect is brightened and illuminated; turning away from the world, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: seetal saa(n)t sa(n)tokh hoi sabh boojhee tirasanaa ||
verses.translation: He is cooled and soothed, peaceful and content; all his thirst is quenched.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis dhaavat miT ge niramal thaan basanaa ||3||
verses.translation: The mind's wandering in the ten directions is stopped, and one dwells in the immaculate place. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaarai raakhiaa bhe bhram bhasanaa ||
verses.translation: The Savior Lord saves him, and his doubts are burnt to ashes.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan naanak sukhee pekh saadh dharasanaa ||4||13||43||
verses.translation: Nanak is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He finds peace, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan. ||4||13||43||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: paanee pakhaa pees dhaas kai tab hoh nihaal ||
verses.translation: Carry water for the Lord's slave, wave the fan over him, and grind his corn; then, you shall be happy.

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raaj milakh sikadhaareeaa aganee meh jaal ||1||
verses.translation: Burn in the fire your power, property and authority. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kaa chhoharaa tis charanee laag ||
verses.translation: Grasp hold of the feet of the servant of the humble Saints.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਛੋਡਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maiaadhaaree chhatrapat tin(h) chhoddau tiaag ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Renounce and abandon the wealthy, the regal overlords and kings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਰੂਖਾ ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kaa dhaanaa rookhaa so sarab nidhaan ||
verses.translation: The dry bread of the Saints is equal to all treasures.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਛਤੀਹ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਖੂ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gireh saakat chhateeh prakaar te bikhoo samaan ||2||
verses.translation: The thirty-six tasty dishes of the faithless cynic, are just like poison. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਲੂਗਰਾ ਓਢਿ ਨਗਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kaa loogaraa odd nagan na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Wearing the old blankets of the humble devotees, one is not naked.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਰੇਸਮੀ ਪਹਿਰਤ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saakat sirapaau resamee pahirat pat khoiee ||3||
verses.translation: But by putting on the silk clothes of the faithless cynic, one loses one's honor. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰਿਐ ਅਧ ਵੀਚਹੁ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: saakat siau mukh joriaai adh veechahu TooTai ||
verses.translation: Friendship with the faithless cynic breaks down mid-way.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਇਤ ਊਤਹਿ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har jan kee sevaa jo kare it uooteh chhooTai ||4||
verses.translation: But whoever serves the humble servants of the Lord, is emancipated here and hereafter. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh tum(h) hee te hoaa aap banat banaiee ||
verses.translation: Everything comes from You, O Lord; You Yourself created the creation.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੪॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: dharasan bheTat saadh kaa naanak gun gaiee ||5||14||44||
verses.translation: Blessed with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||14||44||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: sravanee sunau har har hare Thaakur jas gaavau ||
verses.translation: With my ears, I listen to the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Praises of my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t charan kar sees dhar har naam dhiaavau ||1||
verses.translation: I place my hands and my head upon the feet of the Saints, and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਇਹ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa dhiaal prabh ieh nidh sidh paavau ||
verses.translation: Be kind to me, O Merciful God, and bless me with this wealth and success.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਲੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee renukaa lai maathai laavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Obtaining the dust of the feet of the Saints, I apply it to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨੀਚ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: neech te neech at neech hoi kar binau bulaavau ||
verses.translation: I am the lowest of the low, absolutely the lowest; I offer my humble prayer.

verses.original: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paav malovaa aap tiaag sa(n)tasa(n)g samaavau ||2||
verses.translation: I wash their feet, and renounce my self-conceit; I merge in the Saints' Congregation. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas neh veesarai an kateh na dhaavau ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, I never forget the Lord; I never go to another.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: safal dharasan gur bheTeeaai maan moh miTaavau ||3||
verses.translation: Obtaining the Fruitful Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I discard my pride and attachment. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam seegaar banaavau ||
verses.translation: I am embellished with truth, contentment, compassion and Dharmic faith.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: safal suhaagan naanakaa apune prabh bhaavau ||4||15||45||
verses.translation: My spiritual marriage is fruitful, O Nanak; I am pleasing to my God. ||4||15||45||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aTal bachan saadhoo janaa sabh meh pragaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: The words of the Holy are eternal and unchanging; this is apparent to everyone.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis jan hoaa saadhasa(n)g tis bheTai har raiaa ||1||
verses.translation: That humble being, who joins the Saadh Sangat, meets the Sovereign Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eeh parateet govi(n)dh kee jap har sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: This faith in the Lord of the Universe, and peace, are found by meditating on the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik baataa sabh kar rahe gur ghar lai aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Everyone is speaking in various ways, but the Guru has brought the Lord into the home of my self. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saran pare kee raakhataa naahee sahasaiaa ||
verses.translation: He preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; there is no doubt about this at all.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਇ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karam bhoom har naam boi aausar dhulabhaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: In the field of actions and karma, plant the Lord's Name; this opportunity is so difficult to obtain! ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee aap prabh sabh kare karaiaa ||
verses.translation: God Himself is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He does, and causes everything to be done.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਘਣੇ ਕਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: patit puneet ghane kare Thaakur biradhaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: He purifies so many sinners; this is the natural way of our Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mat bhoolahu maanukh jan maiaa bharamaiaa ||
verses.translation: Don't be fooled, O mortal being, by the illusion of Maya.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਸੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: naanak tis pat raakhasee jo prabh pahiraiaa ||4||16||46||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God saves the honor of those of whom He approves. ||4||16||46||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: maaTee te jin saajiaa kar dhuralabh dheh ||
verses.translation: He fashioned you from clay, and made your priceless body.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik chhidhr man meh ddake niramal dhirasaTeh ||1||
verses.translation: He covers the many faults in your mind, and makes you look immaculate and pure. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਹ ॥
verses.translit: kiau bisarai prabh manai te jis ke gun eh ||
verses.translation: So why do you forget God from your mind? He has done so many good things for you.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਜਿ ਰਚੇ ਜਿ ਆਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਰਲੀਐ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh taj rache j aan siau so raleeaai kheh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who forsakes God, and blends himself with another, in the end is blended with dust. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਤ ਬਿਲਮ ਕਰੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: simarahu simarahu saas saas mat bilam kareh ||
verses.translation: Meditate, meditate in remembrance with each and every breath - do not delay!

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਪੰਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chhodd prapa(n)ch prabh siau rachahu taj kooRe neh ||2||
verses.translation: Renounce worldly affairs, and merge yourself into God; forsake false loves. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਏਕ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਏ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਏਹ ॥
verses.translit: jin anik ek bahu ra(n)g ke'ee hai hosee eh ||
verses.translation: He is many, and He is One; He takes part in the many plays. This is as He is, and shall be.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar sevaa tis paarabraham gur te mat leh ||3||
verses.translation: So serve that Supreme Lord God, and accept the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਵਡਾ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਰਨੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: uooche te uoochaa vaddaa sabh sa(n)g baraneh ||
verses.translation: God is said to be the highest of the high, the greatest of all, our companion.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਸਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: dhaas dhaas ko dhaasaraa naanak kar leh ||4||17||47||
verses.translation: Please, let Nanak be the slave of the slave of Your slaves. ||4||17||47||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਅਨ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: ek Tek govi(n)dh kee tiaagee an aas ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is my only Support. I have renounced all other hopes.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh uoopar samarath prabh pooran gunataas ||1||
verses.translation: God is All-powerful, above all; He is the perfect treasure of virtue. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jan kaa naam adhaar hai prabh saranee paeh ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the humble servant who seeks God's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paramesar kaa aasaraa sa(n)tan man maeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In their minds, the Saints take the Support of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap rakhai aap dhevasee aape pratipaarai ||
verses.translation: He Himself preserves, and He Himself gives. He Himself cherishes.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal kirapaa nidhe saas saas sam(h)aarai ||2||
verses.translation: Merciful to the meek, the treasure of mercy, He remembers and protects us with each and every breath. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: karanahaar jo kar rahiaa saiee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator Lord does is glorious and great.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur poorai upadhesiaa sukh khasam rajaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, that peace comes by the Will of our Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਤਜਿ ਜਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: chi(n)t a(n)dhesaa ganat taj jan hukam pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: Anxieties, worries and calculations are dismissed; the Lord's humble servant accepts the Hukam of His Command.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਹ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: neh binasai neh chhodd jai naanak ra(n)g raataa ||4||18||48||
verses.translation: He does not die, and He does not leave; Nanak is attuned to His Love. ||4||18||48||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਰਸਤ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa tapat te bhiee saa(n)t parasat paap naaThe ||
verses.translation: The great fire is put out and cooled; meeting with the Guru, sins run away.

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤ ਥੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਦੇ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop meh galat the kaadde dhe haathe ||1||
verses.translation: I fell into the deep dark pit; giving me His Hand, He pulled me out. ||1||

verses.original: ਓਇ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਹਮ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: oi hamaare saajanaa ham un kee ren ||
verses.translation: He is my friend; I am the dust of His Feet.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੁਖੀ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin bheTat hovat sukhee jeea dhaan dhen ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting with Him, I am at peace; He blesses me with the gift of the soul. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅਬ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: paraa poorabalaa leekhiaa miliaa ab aai ||
verses.translation: I have now received my pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਬਸਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: basat sa(n)g har saadh kai pooran aasai ||2||
verses.translation: Dwelling with the Lord's Holy Saints, my hopes are fulfilled. ||2||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਕੇ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: bhai binase tih lok ke paae sukh thaan ||
verses.translation: The fear of the three worlds is dispelled, and I have found my place of rest and peace.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karee samarath gur basiaa man naam ||3||
verses.translation: The all-powerful Guru has taken pity upon me, and the Naam has come to dwell in my mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਟੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kee too Tek prabh teraa aadhaar ||
verses.translation: O God, You are the Anchor and Support of Nanak.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath prabh har agam apaar ||4||19||49||
verses.translation: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes; the All-powerful Lord God is inaccessible and infinite. ||4||19||49||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਮਲੀਨੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਹੀਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee maleen dheen heen jis prabh bisaraanaa ||
verses.translation: One who forgets God is filthy, poor and low.

verses.original: ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਈ ਆਪੁ ਗਨੈ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karanaihaar na boojhiee aap ganai bigaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: The fool does not understand the Creator Lord; instead, he thinks that he himself is the doer. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਜਦਿ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh tadhe jadh veesarai sukh prabh chit aae ||
verses.translation: Pain comes, when one forgets Him. Peace comes when one remembers God.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kai aana(n)dh eh nit har gun gaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is the way the Saints are in bliss - they continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ਕਰੈ ਨੀਚ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: uooche te neechaa karai neech khin meh thaapai ||
verses.translation: The high, He makes low, and the low, he elevates in an instant.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: keemat kahee na jaieeaai Thaakur parataapai ||2||
verses.translation: The value of the glory of our Lord and Master cannot be estimated. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੇਖਤ ਲੀਲਾ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਚਲਨੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pekhat leelaa ra(n)g roop chalanai dhin aaiaa ||
verses.translation: While he gazes upon beautiful dramas and plays, the day of his departure dawns.

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: supane kaa supanaa bhiaa sa(n)g chaliaa kamaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The dream becomes the dream, and his actions will go along with him. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath prabh teree saranaiee ||
verses.translation: God is All-powerful, the Cause of causes; I seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਪੈ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: har dhinas rain naanak japai sadh sadh bal jaiee ||4||20||50||
verses.translation: Day and night, Nanak meditates on the Lord; forever and ever he is a sacrifice. ||4||20||50||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਢੋਵਉ ਇਹ ਸੀਸ ਕਰਿ ਕਰ ਪਗ ਪਖਲਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: jal ddovau ieh sees kar kar pag pakhalaavau ||
verses.translation: I carry water on my head, and with my hands I wash their feet.

verses.original: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baar jaau lakh bereeaa dharas pekh jeevaavau ||1||
verses.translation: Tens of thousands of times, I am a sacrifice to them; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I live. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: karau manorath manai maeh apane prabh te paavau ||
verses.translation: The hopes which I cherish in my mind - my God fulfills them all.

verses.original: ਦੇਉ ਸੂਹਨੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਬੀਜਨੁ ਢੋਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheau soohanee saadh kai beejan ddolaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With my broom, I sweep the homes of the Holy Saints, and wave the fan over them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਲਤੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਪੀਲਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat gun sa(n)t bolate sun maneh peelaavau ||
verses.translation: The Saints chant the Ambrosial Praises of the Lord; I listen, and my mind drinks it in.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: auaa ras meh saa(n)t tirapat hoi bikhai jalan bujhaavau ||2||
verses.translation: That sublime essence calms and soothes me, and quenches the fire of sin and corruption. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab bhagat kareh sa(n)t ma(n)ddalee tin(h) mil har gaavau ||
verses.translation: When the galaxy of Saints worship the Lord in devotion, I join them, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karau namasakaar bhagat jan dhoor mukh laavau ||3||
verses.translation: I bow in reverence to the humble devotees, and apply the dust of their feet to my face. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਜਪਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat japau naam ih karam kamaavau ||
verses.translation: Sitting down and standing up, I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is what I do.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kee prabh benatee har saran samaavau ||4||21||51||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer to God, that he may merge in the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||21||51||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih saagar soiee tarai jo har gun gaae ||
verses.translation: He alone crosses over this world-ocean, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
