verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kai sa(n)g vasai vaddabhaagee paae ||1||
verses.translation: He dwells with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; by great good fortune, he finds the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਨ ਆਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun jeevai dhaas tum(h) baanee jan aakhee ||
verses.translation: Your slave lives by hearing, hearing the Word of Your Bani, chanted by Your humble servant.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਲੋਅ ਮਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pragaT bhiee sabh loa meh sevak kee raakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru is revealed in all the worlds; He saves the honor of His servant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: agan saagar te kaaddiaa prabh jalan bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: God has pulled me out of the ocean of fire, and quenched my burning thirst.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਲੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam jal sa(n)chiaa gur bhe sahaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru has sprinkled the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has become my Helper. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh kaaTiaa sukh kaa thaan paiaa ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death are removed, and I have obtained a resting place of peace.

verses.original: ਕਾਟੀ ਸਿਲਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaaTee silak bhram moh kee apane prabh bhaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The noose of doubt and emotional attachment has been snapped; I have become pleasing to my God. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: mat koiee jaanahu avar kachh sabh prabh kai haath ||
verses.translation: Let no one think that there is any other at all; everything is in the Hands of God.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh naanak paae sa(n)g sa(n)tan saath ||4||22||52||
verses.translation: Nanak has found total peace, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||22||52||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaTe aap prabh hoaa kirapaal ||
verses.translation: My bonds have been snapped; God Himself has become compassionate.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal prabh paarabraham taa kee nadhar nihaal ||1||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; by His Glance of Grace, I am in ecstasy. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai kirapaa karee kaaTiaa dhukh rog ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has shown mercy to me, and eradicated my pains and illnesses.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal sukhee bhiaa prabh dhiaavan jog ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed, meditating on God, most worthy of meditation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaukhadh har kaa naam hai jit rog na viaapai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all disease; with it, no disease afflicts me.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਤੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g man tan hitai fir dhookh na jaapai ||2||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind and body are tinged with the Lord's Love, and I do not suffer pain any longer. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har jaapeeaai a(n)tar liv laiee ||
verses.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, lovingly centering my inner being on Him.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kilavikh utareh sudh hoi saadhoo saranaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Sinful mistakes are erased and I am sanctified, in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਤ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਬਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sunat japat har naam jas taa kee dhoor balaiee ||
verses.translation: Misfortune is kept far away from those who hear and chant the Praises of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: mahaa ma(n)tr naanak kathai har ke gun gaiee ||4||23||53||
verses.translation: Nanak chants the Mahaa Mantra, the Great Mantra, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||23||53||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai te upajai bhagat prabh a(n)tar hoi saa(n)t ||
verses.translation: From the Fear of God, devotion wells up, and deep within, there is peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam japat govi(n)dh kaa binasai bhram bhraa(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, doubt and delusions are dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa jis bheTiaa taa kai sukh paraves ||
verses.translation: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, is blessed with peace.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man kee mat tiaageeaai suneeaai upadhes ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, and listen to the Teachings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: simarat simarat simareeaai so purakh dhaataar ||
verses.translation: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord, the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man te kabahu na veesarai so purakh apaar ||2||
verses.translation: May I never forget that Primal, Infinite Lord from my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau ra(n)g lagaa acharaj gurdhev ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined love for the Lotus Feet of the Wondrous Divine Guru.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kau kirapaa karahu prabh taa kau laavahu sev ||3||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by Your Mercy, God, is committed to Your service. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: nidh nidhaan a(n)mrit peeaa man tan aana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, the treasure of wealth, and my mind and body are in bliss.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: naanak kabahu na veesarai prabh paramaana(n)dh ||4||24||54||
verses.translation: Nanak never forgets God, the Lord of supreme bliss. ||4||24||54||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਗਈ ਨਾਠੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: tirasan bujhee mamataa giee naaThe bhai bharamaa ||
verses.translation: Desire is stilled, and egotism is gone; fear and doubt have run away.

verses.original: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਆਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: thit paiee aanadh bhiaa gur keene dharamaa ||1||
verses.translation: I have found stability, and I am in ecstasy; the Guru has blessed me with Dharmic faith. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa binasee meree peer ||
verses.translation: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, my anguish is eradicated.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan man sabh seetal bhiaa paiaa sukh beer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My body and mind are totally cooled and soothed; I have found peace, O my brother. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: sovat har jap jaagiaa pekhiaa bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: I have awakened from sleep, chanting the Name of the Lord; gazing upon Him, I am filled with wonder.

verses.original: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pee a(n)mrit tirapataasiaa taa kaa acharaj suaadh ||2||
verses.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, I am satisfied. How wondrous is its taste! ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap mukat sa(n)gee tare kul kuTa(n)b udhaare ||
verses.translation: I myself am liberated, and my companions swim across; my family and ancestors are also saved.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: safal sevaa gurdhev kee niramal dharabaare ||3||
verses.translation: Service to the Divine Guru is fruitful; it has made me pure in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਣਹੀਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: neech anaath ajaan mai niragun gunaheen ||
verses.translation: I am lowly, without a master, ignorant, worthless and without virtue.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਨੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: naanak kau kirapaa bhiee dhaas apanaa keen ||4||25||55||
verses.translation: Nanak has been blessed with God's Mercy; God has made him His Slave. ||4||25||55||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa kaa aasaraa an naahee Thaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Hope and Support of His devotees; there is nowhere else for them to go.

verses.original: ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taan dheebaan paravaar dhan prabh teraa naau ||1||
verses.translation: O God, Your Name is my power, realm, relatives and riches. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee apane dhaas rakh le'ee ||
verses.translation: God has granted His Mercy, and saved His slaves.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਚੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੀਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak ni(n)dhaa kar pache jamakaal grase'ee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The slanderers rot in their slander; they are seized by the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਨਾ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa ek dhiaavanaa dhoosar ko naeh ||
verses.translation: The Saints meditate on the One Lord, and no other.

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ekas aagai benatee raviaa srab thai ||2||
verses.translation: They offer their prayers to the One Lord, who is pervading and permeating all places. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਥਾ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਇਉ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kathaa puraatan iau sunee bhagatan kee baanee ||
verses.translation: I have heard this old story, spoken by the devotees,

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਦੁਸਟ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਏ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sagal dhusaT kha(n)dd kha(n)dd ke'ee jan le'ee maanee ||3||
verses.translation: that all the wicked are cut apart into pieces, while His humble servants are blessed with honor. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਪਰਗਟ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sat bachan naanak kahai paragaT sabh maeh ||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the true words, which are obvious to all.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: prabh ke sevak saran prabh tin kau bhau naeh ||4||26||56||
verses.translation: God's servants are under God's Protection; they have absolutely no fear. ||4||26||56||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਲ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaTai so prabhoo jaa kai kal haath ||
verses.translation: God breaks the bonds which hold us; He holds all power in His hands.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਕਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avar karam nahee chhooTeeaai raakhahu har naath ||1||
verses.translation: No other actions will bring release; save me, O my Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਮਾਧਵੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: tau saranaagat maadhave pooran dhiaal ||
verses.translation: I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Lord of Mercy.

verses.original: ਛੂਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhooT jai sa(n)saar te raakhai gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those whom You preserve and protect, O Lord of the Universe, are saved from the trap of the world. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa bharam bikaar moh in meh lobhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Hope, doubt, corruption and emotional attachment - in these, he is engrossed.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੁ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jhooTh samagree man vasee paarabraham na jaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: The false material world abides in his mind, and he does not understand the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: param jot pooran purakh sabh jeea tum(h)aare ||
verses.translation: O Perfect Lord of Supreme Light, all beings belong to You.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau too raakheh tiau rahaa prabh agam apaare ||3||
verses.translation: As You keep us, we live, O infinite, inaccessible God. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath prabh dheh apanaa naau ||
verses.translation: Cause of causes, All-powerful Lord God, please bless me with Your Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: naanak tareeaai saadhasa(n)g har har gun gaau ||4||27||57||
verses.translation: Nanak is carried across in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||27||57||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਤਰਿਆ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kavan kavan nahee patariaa tum(h)ree parateet ||
verses.translation: Who? Who has not fallen, by placing their hopes in you?

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਨਰਕ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahaa mohanee mohiaa narak kee reet ||1||
verses.translation: You are enticed by the great enticer - this is the way to hell! ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਖੁਟਹਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਤੂ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਮਾਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: man khuTahar teraa nahee bisaas too mahaa udhamaadhaa ||
verses.translation: O vicious mind, no faith can be placed in you; you are totally intoxicated.

verses.original: ਖਰ ਕਾ ਪੈਖਰੁ ਤਉ ਛੁਟੈ ਜਉ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khar kaa paikhar tau chhuTai jau uoopar laadhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The donkey's leash is only removed, after the load is placed on his back. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਖੰਡੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਂਡ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam tum(h) kha(n)dde jam ke dhukh ddaa(n)dd ||
verses.translation: You destroy the value of chanting, intensive meditation and self-discipline; you shall suffer in pain, beaten by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਰਲਜੇ ਭਾਂਡ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: simareh naahee jon dhukh niralaje bhaa(n)dd ||2||
verses.translation: You do not meditate, so you shall suffer the pains of reincarnation, you shameless buffoon! ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g sahaiee mahaa meet tis siau teraa bhedh ||
verses.translation: The Lord is your Companion, your Helper, your Best Friend; but you disagree with Him.

verses.original: ਬੀਧਾ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰਈ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਖੇਦੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: beedhaa pa(n)ch baTavaariee upajio mahaa khedh ||3||
verses.translation: You are in love with the five thieves; this brings terrible pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak tin sa(n)tan saranaagatee jin man vas keenaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints, who have conquered their minds.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: tan dhan sarabas aapanaa prabh jan kau dheen(h)aa ||4||28||58||
verses.translation: He gives body, wealth and everything to the slaves of God. ||4||28||58||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਆਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: audham karat aanadh bhiaa simarat sukh saar ||
verses.translation: Try to meditate, and contemplate the source of peace, and bliss will come to you.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jap jap naam gobi(n)dh kaa pooran beechaar ||1||
verses.translation: Chanting, and meditating on the Name of the Lord of the Universe, perfect understanding is achieved. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal gur ke japat har jap hau jeevaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Guru, and chanting the Name of the Lord, I live.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਤੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham aaraadhate mukh a(n)mrit peevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Worshipping the Supreme Lord God in adoration, my mouth drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸੇ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲੋਚ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh sukh base sabh kai man loch ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures dwell in peace; the minds of all yearn for the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਚਿਤਵਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paraupakaar nit chitavate naahee kachh poch ||2||
verses.translation: Those who continually remember the Lord, do good deeds for others; they harbor no ill will towards anyone. ||2||

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਬਸੰਤ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਹ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su thaan basa(n)t dha(n)n jeh japeeaai naam ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that place, and blessed are those who dwell there, where they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kathaa keeratan har at ghanaa sukh sahaj bisraam ||3||
verses.translation: The Sermon and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung there very often; there is peace, poise and tranquility. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: man te kadhe na veesarai anaath ko naath ||
verses.translation: In my mind, I never forget the Lord; He is the Master of the masterless.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kai sabh kichh haath ||4||29||59||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; everything is in His hands. ||4||29||59||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਬੰਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin too ba(n)dh kar chhoddiaa fun sukh meh paiaa ||
verses.translation: The One who bound you in the womb and then released you, placed you in the world of joy.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸੀਤਲ ਹੋਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa simar charanaarabi(n)dh seetal hotaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Contemplate His Lotus Feet forever, and you shall be cooled and soothed. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਅਥਵਾ ਮੁਇਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeevatiaa athavaa muiaa kichh kaam na aavai ||
verses.translation: In life and in death, this Maya is of no use.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin eh rachan rachaiaa kouoo tis siau ra(n)g laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He created this creation, but rare are those who enshrine love for Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਘਾਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
verses.translit: re praanee usan seet karataa karai ghaam te kaaddai ||
verses.translation: O mortal, the Creator Lord made summer and winter; He saves you from the heat.

verses.original: ਕੀਰੀ ਤੇ ਹਸਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਟੂਟਾ ਲੇ ਗਾਢੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: keeree te hasatee karai TooTaa le gaaddai ||2||
verses.translation: From the ant, He makes an elephant; He reunites those who have been separated. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਕਿਰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)ddaj jeraj setaj utabhujaa prabh kee ieh kirat ||
verses.translation: Eggs, wombs, sweat and earth - these are God's workshops of creation.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਰਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kirat kamaavan sarab fal raveeaai har nirat ||3||
verses.translation: It is fruitful for all to practice contemplation of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ॥
verses.translit: ham te kachhoo na hovanaa saran prabh saadh ||
verses.translation: I cannot do anything; O God, I seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਕੂਪ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਢ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੦॥
verses.translit: moh magan koop a(n)dh te naanak gur kaadd ||4||30||60||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak pulled me up, out of the deep, dark pit, the intoxication of attachment. ||4||30||60||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਾ ਖੋਜਉ ਬਨ ਥਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat mai firaa khojau ban thaan ||
verses.translation: Searching, searching, I wander around searching, in the woods and other places.

verses.original: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਐਸੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: achhal achhedh abhedh prabh aaise bhagavaan ||1||
verses.translation: He is undeceivable, imperishable, inscrutable; such is my Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਆਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: kab dhekhau prabh aapanaa aatam kai ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: When shall I behold my God, and delight my soul?

verses.original: ਜਾਗਨ ਤੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਬਸੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaagan te supanaa bhalaa baseeaai prabh sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even better than being awake, is the dream in which I dwell with God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਰਨ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: baran aasram saasatr sunau dharasan kee piaas ||
verses.translation: Listening to the Shaastras teaching about the four social classes and the four stages of life, I grow thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: roop na rekh na pa(n)ch tat Thaakur abinaas ||2||
verses.translation: He has no form or outline, and He is not made of the five elements; our Lord and Master is imperishable. ||2||

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ॥
verses.translit: oh saroop sa(n)tan kaheh virale jogeesur ||
verses.translation: How rare are those Saints and great Yogis, who describe the beautiful form of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਤੇ ਈਸੁਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jaa kau mile dhan dhan te ieesur ||3||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are they, whom the Lord meets in His Mercy. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤਹ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: so a(n)tar so baahare binase teh bharamaa ||
verses.translation: They know that He is deep within, and outside as well; their doubts are dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tis prabh bheTiaa jaa ke pooran karamaa ||4||31||61||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God meets those, whose karma is perfect. ||4||31||61||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t suprasa(n)n bhe dhekh prabh parataap ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are totally pleased, gazing on God's glorious radiance.

verses.original: ਕਰਜੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਿ ਆਹਰੁ ਆਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karaj utaariaa satiguroo kar aahar aap ||1||
verses.translation: The True Guru has paid off my debt; He Himself did it. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੂਟ ॥
verses.translit: khaat kharachat nibahat rahai gur sabadh akhooT ||
verses.translation: Eating and expending it, it is always available; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is inexhaustible.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸਮਗਰੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pooran bhiee samagaree kabahoo nahee tooT ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Everything is perfectly arranged; it is never exhausted. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g aaraadhanaa har nidh aapaar ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I worship and adore the Lord, the infinite treasure.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਦੇਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dharam arath ar kaam mokh dhete nahee baar ||2||
verses.translation: He does not hesitate to bless me with Dharmic faith, wealth, fulfilment of desires and liberation. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat araadheh ek ra(n)g gobi(n)dh gupaal ||
verses.translation: The devotees worship and adore the Lord of the Universe with single-minded love.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan sa(n)chiaa jaa kaa nahee sumaar ||3||
verses.translation: They gather in the wealth of the Lord's Name, which cannot be estimated. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: saran pare prabh tereeaa prabh kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, the glorious greatness of God. Nanak:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)t na paieeaai bea(n)t gusaiee ||4||32||62||
verses.translation: Your end or limitation cannot be found, O Infinite World-Lord. ||4||32||62||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾਰਜ ਭਏ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar pooran prabhoo kaaraj bhe raas ||
verses.translation: Meditate, meditate in remembrance of the Perfect Lord God, and your affairs shall be perfectly resolved.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਪੁਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karataar pur karataa vasai sa(n)tan kai paas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In Kartaarpur, the City of the Creator Lord, the Saints dwell with the Creator. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: bighan na kouoo laagataa gur peh aradhaas ||
verses.translation: No obstacles will block your way, when you offer your prayers to the Guru.

verses.original: ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rakhavaalaa gobi(n)dh rai bhagatan kee raas ||1||
verses.translation: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is the Saving Grace, the Protector of the capital of His devotees. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਮੂਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: toT na aavai kadhe mool pooran bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: There is never any deficiency at all; the Lord's treasures are over-flowing.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: charan kamal man tan base prabh agam apaar ||2||
verses.translation: His Lotus Feet are enshrined within my mind and body; God is inaccessible and infinite. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਸਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਊਨ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: basat kamaavat sabh sukhee kichh uoon na dheesai ||
verses.translation: All those who work for Him dwell in peace; you can see that they lack nothing.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh bheTe prabhoo pooran jagadheesai ||3||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have met God, the Perfect Lord of the Universe. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar sabhai kareh sach thaan suhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Everyone congratulates me, and celebrates my victory; the home of the True Lord is so beautiful!

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: jap naanak naam nidhaan sukh pooraa gur paiaa ||4||33||63||
verses.translation: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of peace; I have found the Perfect Guru. ||4||33||63||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਈਐ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: har har har aaraadheeaai hoieeaai aarog ||
verses.translation: Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and you shall be free of disease.

verses.original: ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਕੀ ਲਸਟਿਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raamacha(n)dh kee lasaTikaa jin maariaa rog ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is the Lord's healing rod, which eradicates all disease. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਕੀਚੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa har jaapeeaai nit keechai bhog ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, through the Perfect Guru, he constantly enjoys pleasure.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kai vaaranai miliaa sa(n)jog ||1||
verses.translation: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have been united with my Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat sukh paieeaai binasai biog ||
verses.translation: Contemplating Him, peace is obtained, and separation is ended.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩੪॥੬੪॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee karan kaaran jog ||2||34||64||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes. ||2||34||64||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੫
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ghar panjavaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay, Fifth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: avar upaav sabh tiaagiaa dhaaroo naam liaa ||
verses.translation: I have given up all other efforts, and have taken the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਰੋਗ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taap paap sabh miTe rog seetal man bhiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Fevers, sins and all diseases are eradicated, and my mind is cooled and soothed. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa sagalaa dhukh giaa ||
verses.translation: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, all pains are dispelled.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaarai raakhiaa apanee kar miaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Savior Lord has saved me; He has blessed me with His Kind Mercy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਕੀਨਾ ਅਪਨਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baeh pakaR prabh kaaddiaa keenaa apaniaa ||
verses.translation: Grabbing hold of my arm, God has pulled me up and out; He has made me His own.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੬੫॥
verses.translit: simar simar man tan sukhee naanak nirabhiaa ||2||1||65||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, my mind and body are at peace; Nanak has become fearless. ||2||1||65||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar dhar masatak thaapiaa naam dheeno dhaan ||
verses.translation: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, God has given me the gift of His Name.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: safal sevaa paarabraham kee taa kee nahee haan ||1||
verses.translation: One who performs fruitful service for the Supreme Lord God, never suffers any loss. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee prabh raakhataa bhagatan kee aan ||
verses.translation: God Himself saves the honor of His devotees.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਲੇਤਾ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo chitaveh saadh jan so letaa maan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever God's Holy servants wish for, He grants to them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: saran pare charanaarabi(n)dh jan prabh ke praan ||
verses.translation: God's humble servants seek the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet; they are God's very breath of life.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੬॥
verses.translit: sahaj subhai naanak mile jotee jot samaan ||2||2||66||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they automatically, intuitively meet God; their light merges into the Light. ||2||2||66||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੀਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal kaa aasaraa dheeno prabh aap ||
verses.translation: God Himself has given me the Support of His Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਪਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh saranaagat jan pare taa kaa sadh parataap ||1||
verses.translation: God's humble servants seek His Sanctuary; they are respected and famous forever. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaar apaar prabh taa kee niramal sev ||
verses.translation: God is the unparalleled Savior and Protector; service to Him is immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam raaj raamadhaas pur keen(h)e gurdhev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru has built the City of Ramdaspur, the royal domain of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa har dhiaaieeaai kichh bighan na laagai ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, meditate on the Lord, and no obstacles will obstruct you.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਇ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaaheeaai bhi dhusaman bhaagai ||2||3||67||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the fear of enemies runs away. ||2||3||67||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਮਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan prabh aaraadheeaai mil saadh samaagai ||
verses.translation: Worship and adore God in your mind and body; join the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਉਚਰਤ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਦੂਰ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aucharat gun gopaal jas dhoor te jam bhaagai ||1||
verses.translation: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Messenger of Death runs far away. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam jo jan japai anadhin sadh jaagai ||
verses.translation: That humble being who chants the Lord's Name, remains always awake and aware, night and day.

verses.original: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਹ ਜੋਹਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ta(n)t ma(n)t neh johiee tit chaakh na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is not affected by charms and spells, nor is he harmed by the evil eye. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਅਨਰਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh madh maan moh binase anaraagai ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, the intoxication of egotism and emotional attachment are dispelled, by loving devotion.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦ ਮਗਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੪॥੬੮॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh magan ras raam ra(n)g naanak saranaagai ||2||4||68||
verses.translation: One who enters the Lord's Sanctuary, O Nanak, remains merged in ecstasy in the subtle essence of the Lord's Love. ||2||4||68||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea jugat vas prabhoo kai jo kahai su karanaa ||
verses.translation: The living creatures and their ways are in God's power. Whatever He says, they do.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhe prasa(n)n gopaal rai bhau kichh nahee karanaa ||1||
verses.translation: When the Sovereign Lord of the Universe is pleased, there is nothing at all to fear. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਦੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh na laagai kadhe tudh paarabraham chitaare ||
verses.translation: Pain shall never afflict you, if you remember the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jamaka(n)kar neR na aaviee gursikh piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the beloved Sikhs of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath hai tis bin nahee hor ||
verses.translation: The All-powerful Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other than Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥੫॥੬੯॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee saachaa man jor ||2||5||69||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; the True Lord has given strength to the mind. ||2||5||69||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਨਾਠਾ ਦੁਖ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar prabh aapanaa naaThaa dhukh Thaau ||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering my God in meditation, the house of pain is removed.

verses.original: ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਪਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bisraam paae mil saadhasa(n)g taa te bahuR na dhaau ||1||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have found peace and tranquility; I shall not wander away from there again. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਨੇ ਚਰਨਨੑ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane charanan(h) bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am devoted to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to His Feet.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਨੇ ਪੇਖਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadh sookh ma(n)gal bane pekhat gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am blessed with ecstasy, peace and happiness, gazing upon the Guru, and singing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: kathaa keeratan raag naadh dhun ih banio suaau ||
verses.translation: This is my life's purpose, to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and listen to the vibrations of the sound current of the Naad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥੬॥੭੦॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh suprasa(n)n bhe baa(n)chhat fal paau ||2||6||70||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with me; I have obtained the fruits of my desires. ||2||6||70||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਿਦ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas tere kee benatee ridh kar paragaas ||
verses.translation: This is the prayer of Your slave: please enlighten my heart.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੋਖਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree kirapaa te paarabraham dhokhan ko naas ||1||
verses.translation: By Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, please erase my sins. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal kaa aasaraa prabh purakh gunataas ||
verses.translation: I take the Support of Your Lotus Feet, O God, Primal Lord, treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਉ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: keeratan naam simarat rahau jab lag ghaT saas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I shall meditate in remembrance on the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, as long as there is breath in my body. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੰਧਪ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa ba(n)dhap toohai too sarab nivaas ||
verses.translation: You are my mother, father and relative; You are abiding within all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੭੧॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa ko niramal jaas ||2||7||71||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; His Praise is immaculate and pure. ||2||7||71||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਸਭਿ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sidh har gaieeaai sabh bhalaa manaaveh ||
verses.translation: All perfect spiritual powers are obtained, when one sings the Lord's Praises; everyone wishes him well.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਦਾਸ ਮਿਲਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadh saadh mukh te kaheh sun dhaas milaaveh ||1||
verses.translation: Everyone calls him holy and spiritual; hearing of him, the Lord's slaves come to meet him. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰਸ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੑ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj kaliaan ras poorai gur keen(h) ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru blesses him with peace, poise, salvation and happiness.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਸਗਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੀਨੑ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeea sagal dhiaal bhe har har naam cheen(h) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All living beings become compassionate to him; he remembers the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: poor rahio sarabatr meh prabh gunee gaheer ||
verses.translation: He is permeating and pervading everywhere; God is the ocean of virtue.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਧੀਰ ॥੨॥੮॥੭੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagat aana(n)dh mai pekh prabh kee dheer ||2||8||72||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are in bliss, gazing upon God's abiding stability. ||2||8||72||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: aradhaas sunee dhaataar prabh hoe kirapaal ||
verses.translation: God, the Great Giver, has become merciful; He has listened to my prayer.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raakh leeaa apanaa sevako mukh ni(n)dhak chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: He has saved His servant, and put ashes into the mouth of the slanderer. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਕੋ ਮੀਤ ਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: tujheh na johai ko meet jan too(n) gur kaa dhaas ||
verses.translation: No one can threaten you now, O my humble friend, for you are the slave of the Guru.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਦੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham too raakhiaa dhe apane haath ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God reached out with His Hand and saved you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬੀਆ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeean kaa dhaataa ek hai beeaa nahee hor ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Giver of all beings; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥੯॥੭੩॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa mai teraa jor ||2||9||73||
verses.translation: Nanak prays, You are my only strength, God. ||2||9||73||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: meet hamaare saajanaa raakhe govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe has saved my friends and companions.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak mritak hoi ge tum(h) hoh nichi(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The slanderers have died, so do not worry. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath prabh ke'ee bheTe gurdhev ||
verses.translation: God has fulfilled all hopes and desires; I have met the Divine Guru.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar jagat meh safal jaa kee sev ||1||
verses.translation: God is celebrated and acclaimed all over the world; it is fruitful and rewarding to serve Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਨਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: uooch apaar aganat har sabh jeea jis haath ||
verses.translation: Lofty, infinite and immeasurable is the Lord; all beings are in His Hands.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੭੪॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee jat kat merai saath ||2||10||74||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; He is with me everywhere. ||2||10||74||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa hoe kirapaal ||
verses.translation: I worship the Perfect Guru in adoration; He has become merciful to me.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਤੂਟੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maarag sa(n)t bataiaa tooTe jam jaal ||1||
verses.translation: The Saint has shown me the Way, and the noose of Death has been cut away. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੰਸਾ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਗਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh bhookh sa(n)saa miTiaa gaavat prabh naam ||
verses.translation: Pain, hunger and scepticism have been dispelled, singing the Name of God.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sookh aana(n)dh ras pooran sabh kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am blessed with celestial peace, poise, bliss and pleasure, and all my affairs have been perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਰਾਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: jalan bujhee seetal bhe raakhe prabh aap ||
verses.translation: The fire of desire has been quenched, and I am cooled and soothed; God Himself saved me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੭੫॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kaa vadd parataap ||2||11||75||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His glorious radiance is so great! ||2||11||75||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਫਲ ਥਾਨੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dharat suhaavee safal thaan pooran bhe kaam ||
verses.translation: The earth is beautified, all places are fruitful, and my affairs are perfectly resolved.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhau naaThaa bhram miT giaa raviaa nit raam ||1||
verses.translation: Fear runs away, and doubt is dispelled, dwelling constantly upon the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa kai sa(n)g basat sukh sahaj bisraam ||
verses.translation: Dwelling with the humble Holy people, one finds peace, poise and tranquility.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਘੜੀ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saiee ghaRee sulakhanee simarat har naam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Blessed and auspicious is that time, when one meditates in remembrance on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤੇ ਪਹਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: pragaT bhe sa(n)saar meh firate pahanaam ||
verses.translation: They have become famous throughout the world; before this, no one even knew their names.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਸਭ ਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੭੬॥
verses.translit: naanak tis saranaagatee ghaT ghaT sabh jaan ||2||12||76||
verses.translation: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the One who knows each and every heart. ||2||12||76||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: rog miTaiaa aap prabh upajiaa sukh saa(n)t ||
verses.translation: God Himself eradicated the disease; peace and tranquility have welled up.

verses.original: ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vadd parataap acharaj roop har keen(h)ee dhaat ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord blessed me with the gifts of great, glorious radiance and wondrous form. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur govi(n)dh kirapaa karee raakhiaa meraa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has shown mercy to me, and saved my brother.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham tis kee saranaagatee jo sadhaa sahaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am under His Protection; He is always my help and support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: birathee kadhe na hoviee jan kee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: The prayer of the Lord's humble servant is never offered in vain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੭੭॥
verses.translit: naanak jor govi(n)dh kaa pooran gunataas ||2||13||77||
verses.translation: Nanak takes the strength of the Perfect Lord of the Universe, the treasure of excellence. ||2||13||77||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਜਿਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: mar mar janame jin bisariaa jeevan kaa dhaataa ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Giver of life, die, over and over again, only to be reborn and die.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jan seviaa anadhin ra(n)g raataa ||1||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Supreme Lord God serves Him; night and day, he remains imbued with His Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sahaj aanadh ghanaa pooran bhiee aas ||
verses.translation: I have found peace, tranquility and great ecstasy; my hopes have been fulfilled.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh paiaa har saadhasa(n)g simarat gunataas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have found peace in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਤੁਮੑ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun suaamee aradhaas jan tum(h) a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, please listen to the prayer of Your humble servant; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੭੮॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahe naanak ke suaamee ||2||14||78||
verses.translation: Nanak's Lord and Master is permeating and pervading all places and interspaces. ||2||14||78||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taatee vaau na lagiee paarabraham saranaiee ||
verses.translation: The hot wind does not even touch one who is under the Protection of the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਚਉਗਿਰਦ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਾਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chaugiradh hamaarai raam kaar dhukh lagai na bhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: On all four sides I am surrounded by the Lord's Circle of Protection; pain does not afflict me, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur pooraa bheTiaa jin banat banaiee ||
verses.translation: I have met the Perfect True Guru, who has done this deed.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਦੀਆ ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam aaukhadh dheeaa ekaa liv laiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has given me the medicine of the Lord's Name, and I enshrine love for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਖਨਹਾਰਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raakh le'ee tin rakhanahaar sabh biaadh miTaiee ||
verses.translation: The Savior Lord has saved me, and eradicated all my sickness.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੭੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak kirapaa bhiee prabh bhe sahaiee ||2||15||79||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, God has showered me with His Mercy; He has become my help and support. ||2||15||79||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਣੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: apane baalak aap rakhian paarabraham gurdhev ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, through the Divine Guru, has Himself protected and preserved His children.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saa(n)t sahaj aanadh bhe pooran bhiee sev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Celestial peace, tranquility and bliss have come to pass; my service has been perfect. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kee benatee sunee prabh aap ||
verses.translation: God Himself has heard the prayers of His humble devotees.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rog miTai jeevaalian jaa kaa vadd parataap ||1||
verses.translation: He dispelled my disease, and rejuvenated me; His glorious radiance is so great! ||1||

verses.original: ਦੋਖ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhokh hamaare bakhasian apanee kal dhaaree ||
verses.translation: He has forgiven me for my sins, and interceded with His power.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦਿਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੮੦॥
verses.translit: man baa(n)chhat fal dhitian naanak balihaaree ||2||16||80||
verses.translation: I have been blessed with the fruits of my mind's desires; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||80||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੬
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe dhupadhe ghar chhayvaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay And Dho-Padhay, Sixth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਇਹ ਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥ ਸਾਕਤ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਬੋਲਤ ਬੋਲ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere mohan sravanee ieh na sunaae || saakat geet naadh dhun gaavat bolat bol ajaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my fascinating Lord, let me not listen to the faithless cynic, singing his songs and tunes, and chanting his useless words. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਉ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਉ ਕਿਰਤਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sevat sev sev saadh sevau sadhaa karau kirataae ||
verses.translation: I serve, serve, serve, serve the Holy Saints; forever and ever, I do this.

verses.original: ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: abhai dhaan paavau purakh dhaate mil sa(n)gat har gun gaae ||1||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord, the Great Giver, has blessed me with the gift of fearlessness. Joining the Company of the Holy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਗੁਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa ageh ageh gun raatee nain dharas ra(n)g laae ||
verses.translation: My tongue is imbued with the Praises of the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, and my eyes are drenched with the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hoh kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan moh charan ridhai vasaae ||2||
verses.translation: Be Merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek, that I may enshrine Your Lotus Feet within my heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭਹੂ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਏਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabhahoo talai talai sabh uoopar eh dhirasaT dhirasaTaae ||
verses.translation: Beneath all, and above all; this is the vision I saw.

verses.original: ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਈ ਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: abhimaan khoi khoi khoi khoiee hau mo kau satigur ma(n)tr dhiraRaae ||3||
verses.translation: I have destroyed, destroyed, destroyed my pride, since the True Guru implanted His Mantra within me. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨਹ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: atul atul atul neh tuleeaai bhagat vachhal kirapaae ||
verses.translation: Immeasurable, immeasurable, immeasurable is the Merciful Lord; he cannot be weighed. He is the Lover of His devotees.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੧॥
verses.translit: jo jo saran pario gur naanak abhai dhaan sukh paae ||4||1||81||
verses.translation: Whoever enters the Sanctuary of Guru Nanak, is blessed with the gifts of fearlessness and peace. ||4||||1||81||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee too mere praan adhaarai ||
verses.translation: O Dear God, You are the Support of my breath of life.

verses.original: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਜਾਉ ਬਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: namasakaar dda(n)ddaut ba(n)dhanaa anik baar jaau baarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I bow in humility and reverence to You; so many times, I am a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat sovat jaagat ih man tujheh chitaarai ||
verses.translation: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, this mind thinks of You.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sookh dhookh is man kee birathaa tujh hee aagai saarai ||1||
verses.translation: I describe to You my pleasure and pain, and the state of this mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: too meree oT bal budh dhan tum hee tumeh merai paravaarai ||
verses.translation: You are my shelter and support, power, intellect and wealth; You are my family.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹਮਰੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮੨॥
verses.translit: jo tum karahu soiee bhal hamarai pekh naanak sukh charanaarai ||2||2||82||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, I know that is good. Gazing upon Your Lotus Feet, Nanak is at peace. ||2||2||82||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਉ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: suneeat prabh tau sagal udhaaran ||
verses.translation: I have heard that God is the Savior of all.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਐਸੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh magan patit sa(n)g praanee aaise maneh bisaaran ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated by attachment, in the company of sinners, the mortal has forgotten such a Lord from his mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਚਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)ch bikhiaa le graahaj keenee a(n)mrit man te ddaaran ||
verses.translation: He has collected poison, and grasped it firmly. But he has cast out the Ambrosial Nectar from his mind.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh rat ni(n)dhaa sat sa(n)tokh bidhaaran ||1||
verses.translation: He is imbued with sexual desire, anger, greed and slander; he has abandoned truth and contentment. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: ein te kaadd leh mere suaamee haar pare tum(h) saaran ||
verses.translation: Lift me up, and pull me out of these, O my Lord and Master. I have entered Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਕ ਤਾਰਨ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੩॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh peh saadhasa(n)g ra(n)k taaran ||2||3||83||
verses.translation: Nanak prays to God: I am a poor beggar; carry me across, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||3||83||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kai suneeat prabh kee baat ||
verses.translation: I listen to God's Teachings from the Saints.

verses.original: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਧੁਨਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kathaa keeratan aana(n)dh ma(n)gal dhun poor rahee dhinas ar raat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Sermon, the Kirtan of His Praises and the songs of bliss perfectly resonate, day and night. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apane prabh keene naam apune kee keenee dhaat ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, God has made them His own, and blessed them with the gift of His Name.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar gun gaavat prabh ke kaam karodh is tan te jaat ||1||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of God. Sexual desire and anger have left this body. ||1||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: tirapat aghaae pekh prabh dharasan a(n)mirat har ras bhojan khaat ||
verses.translation: I am satisfied and satiated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. I eat the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime food.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਤ ॥੨॥੪॥੮੪॥
verses.translit: charan saran naanak prabh teree kar kirapaa sa(n)tasa(n)g milaat ||2||4||84||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O God; in Your Mercy, unite him with the Society of the Saints. ||2||4||84||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: raakh le'ee apane jan aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself has saved His humble servant.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa har har naam dheeno binas ge sabh sog sa(n)taap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, the Lord, Har, Har, has blessed me with His Name, and all my pains and afflictions have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਲਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: gun govi(n)dh gaavahu sabh har jan raag ratan rasanaa aalaap ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, all you humble servants of the Lord; chant the jewels, the songs of the Lord with your tongue.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਆਤਮ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koT janam kee tirasanaa nivaree raam rasain aatam dhraap ||1||
verses.translation: The desires of millions of incarnations shall be quenched, and your soul shall be satisfied with the sweet, sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: charan gahe saran sukhadhaate gur kai bachan jape har jaap ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet; He is the Giver of peace; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I meditate and chant the Chant of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰੇ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੫॥੮੫॥
verses.translit: saagar tare bharam bhai binase kahu naanak Thaakur parataap ||2||5||85||
verses.translation: I have crossed over the world-ocean, and my doubt and fear are dispelled, says Nanak, through the glorious granduer of our Lord and Master. ||2||5||85||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਾਪੁ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: taap laahiaa gur sirajanahaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, the Creator Lord has subdued the fever.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀ ਸਾਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur apane kau bal jaiee jin paij rakhee saarai sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has saved the honor of the whole world. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਬਾਲਿਕੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: kar masatak dhaar baalik rakh leeno ||
verses.translation: Placing His Hand on the child's forehead, He saved him.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਨੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh a(n)mirat naam mahaa ras dheeno ||1||
verses.translation: God blessed me with the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖੈ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas kee laaj rakhai miharavaan ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord saves the honor of His slave.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੮੬॥
verses.translit: gur naanak bolai dharageh paravaan ||2||6||86||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak speaks - it is confirmed in the Court of the Lord. ||2||6||86||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੭
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe dhupadhe ghar satvaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay And Dho-Padhay, Seventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਜਾਰੋ ਦੀਪਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sabadh ujaaro dheepaa ||
verses.translation: The Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, is the light of the lamp.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤਿਹ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਖੁਲੑੀ ਅਨੂਪਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: binasio a(n)dhakaar teh ma(n)dhar ratan koThaRee khul(h)ee anoopaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It dispels the darkness from the body-mansion, and opens the beautiful chamber of jewels. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਜਉ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: bisaman bisam bhe jau pekhio kahan na jai vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: I was wonderstruck and astonished, when I looked inside; I cannot even describe its glory and grandeur.

verses.original: ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: magan bhe uoohaa sa(n)g maate ot pot lapaTaiee ||1||
verses.translation: I am intoxicated and enraptured with it, and I am wrapped in it, through and through. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੂ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aal jaal nahee kachhoo ja(n)jaaraa aha(n)budh nahee bhoraa ||
verses.translation: No worldly entanglements or snares can trap me, and no trace of egotistical pride remains.

verses.original: ਊਚਨ ਊਚਾ ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਖੀਚਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: uoochan uoochaa beech na kheechaa hau teraa too(n) moraa ||2||
verses.translation: You are the highest of the high, and no curtain separates us; I am Yours, and You are mine. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ਏਕੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eka(n)kaar ek paasaaraa ekai apar apaaraa ||
verses.translation: The One Creator Lord created the expanse of the one universe; the One Lord is unlimited and infinite.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek bisatheeran ek sa(n)pooran ekai praan adhaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: The One Lord pervades the one universe; the One Lord is totally permeating everywhere; the One Lord is the Support of the breath of life. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: niramal niramal soochaa soocho soochaa soocho soochaa ||
verses.translation: He is the most immaculate of the immaculate, the purest of the pure, so pure, so pure.

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na a(n)taa sadhaa bea(n)taa kahu naanak uoocho uoochaa ||4||1||87||
verses.translation: He has no end or limitation; He is forever unlimited. Says Nanak, He is the highest of the high. ||4||1||87||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: bin har kaam na aavat he ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, nothing is of any use.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਲਾਗੇ ਓਹ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa siau raach maach tum(h) laage oh mohanee mohaavat he ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are totally attached to that Enticer Maya; she is enticing you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: kanik kaaminee sej sohanee chhodd khinai meh jaavat he ||
verses.translation: You shall have to leave behind your gold, your woman and your beautiful bed; you shall have to depart in an instant.

verses.original: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aurajh rahio i(n)dhree ras prerio bikhai Thagauree khaavat he ||1||
verses.translation: You are entangled in the lures of sexual pleasures, and you are eating poisonous drugs. ||1||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਲੈ ਜਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: tiran ko ma(n)dhar saaj savaario paavak talai jaraavat he ||
verses.translation: You have built and adorned a palace of straw, and under it, you light a fire.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਐਠਿ ਹਠੀਲੋ ਫੂਲਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaise gaR meh aaiTh haTheelo fool fool kiaa paavat he ||2||
verses.translation: Sitting all puffed-up in such a castle, you stubborn-minded fool, what do you think you will gain? ||2||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮੂਡ ਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹੇ ਫੇਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhoot moodd par Thaadde kes gahe feraavat he ||
verses.translation: The five thieves stand over your head and seize you. Grabbing you by your hair, they will drive you on.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT na aaveh a(n)dh agiaanee soi rahio madh maavat he ||3||
verses.translation: You do not see them, you blind and ignorant fool; intoxicated with ego, you just keep sleeping. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾਲੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਚੋਗ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਪੰਖੀ ਜਿਉ ਫਾਹਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaal pasaar chog bisathaaree pa(n)khee jiau faahaavat he ||
verses.translation: The net has been spread out, and the bait has been scattered; like a bird, you are being trapped.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੮੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ba(n)dhan kaaTan kau mai satigur purakh dhiaavat he ||4||2||88||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my bonds have been broken; I meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||4||2||88||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam apaar amolee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is infinite and priceless.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: praan piaaro maneh adhaaro cheet chitavau jaise paan ta(n)bolee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is the Beloved of my breath of life, and the Support of my mind; I remember it, as the betel leaf chewer remembers the betel leaf. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaio gureh bataio ra(n)g ra(n)gee mere tan kee cholee ||
verses.translation: I have been absorbed in celestial bliss, following the Guru's Teachings; my body-garment is imbued with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਜਉ ਵਡਭਾਗੋ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pria mukh laago jau vaddabhaago suhaag hamaaro katahu na ddolee ||1||
verses.translation: I come face to face with my Beloved, by great good fortune; my Husband Lord never wavers. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੂਪ ਨ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਗੰਧ ਨ ਦੀਪਾ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: roop na dhoop na ga(n)dh na dheepaa ot pot a(n)g a(n)g sa(n)g maulee ||
verses.translation: I do not need any image, or incense, or perfume, or lamps; through and through, He is blossoming forth, with me, life and limb.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਵੀ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਟੋਲੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak pria ravee suhaagan at neekee meree banee khaTolee ||2||3||89||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my Husband Lord has ravished and enjoyed His soul-bride; my bed has become very beautiful and sublime. ||2||3||89||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਈ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh miee ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, Gobind, Gobind, Gobind, we become like Him.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਭਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab te bheTe saadh dhiaaraa tab te dhuramat dhoor bhiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Since I met the compassionate, Holy Saints, my evil-mindedness has been driven far away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਈ ॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahio sa(n)pooran seetal saa(n)t dhiaal dhiee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading everywhere. He is cool and calm, peaceful and compassionate.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਖਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh tirasanaa aha(n)kaaraa tan te hoe sagal khiee ||1||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and egotistical desires have all been eliminated from my body. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਲਈ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam such sa(n)tan te ih ma(n)t liee ||
verses.translation: Truth, contentment, compassion, Dharmic faith and purity - I have received these from the Teachings of the Saints.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੋਝ ਪਈ ॥੨॥੪॥੯੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jin manahu pachhaaniaa tin kau sagalee sojh piee ||2||4||90||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who realizes this in his mind, achieves total understanding. ||2||4||90||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹ ਏਕ ਰੋਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ham jeea ja(n)t bechaare baran na saakeh ek romaiee ||
verses.translation: What am I? Just a poor living being. I cannot even describe one of Your hairs, O Lord.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: braham mahes sidh mun i(n)dhraa bea(n)t Thaakur teree gat nahee paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Even Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas and the silent sages do not know Your State, O Infinite Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa katheeaai kichh kathan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: What can I say? I cannot say anything.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh rahiaa samaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਦੂਖ ਜਮ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh mahaa bhiaan dhookh jam suneeaai teh mere prabh toohai sahaiee ||
verses.translation: And there, where the most terrible tortures are heard to be inflicted by the Messenger of Death, You are my only help and support, O my God.

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੯੧॥
verses.translit: saran pario har charan gahe prabh gur naanak kau boojh bujhaiee ||2||5||91||
verses.translation: I have sought His Sanctuary, and grasped hold of the Lord's Lotus Feet; God has helped Guru Nanak to understand this understanding. ||2||5||91||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: agam roop abinaasee karataa patit pavit ik nimakh japaieeaai ||
verses.translation: O Inaccessible, Beautiful, Imperishable Creator Lord, Purifier of sinners, let me meditate on You, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭੇਟੁਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: acharaj sunio paraapat bheTule sa(n)t charan charan man laieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: O Wondrous Lord, I have heard that You are found by meeting the Saints, and focusing the mind on their feet, their holy feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kit bidheeaai kit sa(n)jam paieeaai ||
verses.translation: In what way, and by what discipline, is He obtained?

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਸੁਰਜਨ ਕਿਤੁ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahu surajan kit jugatee dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Tell me, O good man, by what means can we meditate on Him? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਓਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਲਈ ਲਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jo maanukh maanukh kee sevaa oh tis kee liee liee fun jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: If one human being serves another human being, the one served stands by him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰੋ ਇਕ ਨਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੬॥੯੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saran saran sukh saagar moh Tek tero ik naieeaai ||2||6||92||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary and Protection, O Lord, ocean of peace; He takes the Support of Your Name alone. ||2||6||92||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t saran sa(n)t Tahal karee ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, and I serve the Saints.

verses.original: ਧੰਧੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਰੋ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਜ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dh ba(n)dh ar sagal ja(n)jaaro avar kaaj te chhooT paree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am rid of all worldly concerns, bonds, entanglements and other affairs. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਰੁ ਘਨੋ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj ar ghano ana(n)dhaa gur te paio naam haree ||
verses.translation: I have obtained peace, poise and great bliss from the Guru, through the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaiso har ras baran na saakau gur poorai meree ulaT dharee ||1||
verses.translation: Such is the sublime essence of the Lord, that I cannot describe it. The Perfect Guru has turned me away from the world. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਗਲ ਭਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pekhio mohan sabh kai sa(n)ge uoon na kaahoo sagal bharee ||
verses.translation: I behold the Fascinating Lord with everyone. No one is without Him - He is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੯੩॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahio kirapaa nidh kahu naanak meree pooree paree ||2||7||93||
