verses.translation: The Perfect Lord, the treasure of mercy, is permeating everywhere. Says Nanak, I am fully fulfilled. ||2||7||93||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: man kiaa kahataa hau kiaa kahataa ||
verses.translation: What does the mind say? What can I say?

verses.original: ਜਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaan prabeen Thaakur prabh mere tis aagai kiaa kahataa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are wise and all-knowing, O God, my Lord and Master; what can I say to You? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਬੋਲੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਹੀ ਪਛਾਨਹਿ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: anabole kau tuhee pachhaaneh jo jeean meh hotaa ||
verses.translation: You know even what is not said, whatever is in the soul.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਡਹਕਹਿ ਜਉ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: re man kai kahaa lau ddahakeh jau pekhat hee sa(n)g sunataa ||1||
verses.translation: O mind, why do you deceive others? How long will you do this? The Lord is with you; He hears and sees everything. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਦ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਓ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso jaan bhe man aanadh aan na beeo karataa ||
verses.translation: Knowing this, my mind has become blissful; there is no other Creator.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲਹਤਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੯੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur bhe dhiaaraa har ra(n)g na kabahoo lahataa ||2||8||94||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has become kind to me; my love for the Lord shall never wear off. ||2||8||94||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਝਰਿ ਪਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak aaise hee jhar pareeaai ||
verses.translation: Thus, the slanderer crumbles away.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਲਰ ਭੀਤਿ ਗਿਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eeh neesaanee sunahu tum bhaiee jiau kaalar bheet gireeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is the distinctive sign - listen, O Siblings of Destiny: he collapses like a wall of sand. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਤਉ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਉਮਾਹੈ ਭਲੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਭਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jau dhekhai chhidhr tau ni(n)dhak umaahai bhalo dhekh dhukh bhareeaai ||
verses.translation: When the slanderer sees a fault in someone else, he is pleased. Seeing goodness, he is depressed.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar chitavai nahee pahuchai buraa chitavat chitavat mareeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he plots, but nothing works. The evil man dies, constantly thinking up evil plans. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਉਠਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak prabhoo bhulaiaa kaal nerai aaiaa har jan siau baadh uThareeaai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer forgets God, death approaches him, and he starts to argue with the humble servant of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨਸ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੨॥੯॥੯੫॥
verses.translit: naanak kaa raakhaa aap prabh suaamee kiaa maanas bapure kareeaai ||2||9||95||
verses.translation: God Himself, the Lord and Master, is Nanak's protector. What can any wretched person do to him? ||2||9||95||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaise kaahe bhool pare ||
verses.translation: Why do you wander in delusion like this?

verses.original: ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kareh karaaveh mookar paaveh pekhat sunat sadhaa sa(n)g hare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You act, and incite others to act, and then deny it. The Lord is always with you; He sees and hears everything. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਚ ਬਿਹਾਝਨ ਕੰਚਨ ਛਾਡਨ ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਸਾਜਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaach bihaajhan ka(n)chan chhaaddan bairee sa(n)g het saajan tiaag khare ||
verses.translation: You purchase glass, and discard gold; you are in love with your enemy, while you renounce your true friend.

verses.original: ਹੋਵਨੁ ਕਉਰਾ ਅਨਹੋਵਨੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਜਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hovan kauraa anahovan meeThaa bikhiaa meh lapaTai jare ||1||
verses.translation: That which exists, seems bitter; that which does not exist, seems sweet to you. Engrossed in corruption, you are burning away. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਭਰਮ ਗੁਬਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop meh pario paraanee bharam gubaar moh ba(n)dh pare ||
verses.translation: The mortal has fallen into the deep, dark pit, and is entangled in the darkness of doubt, and the bondage of emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਕਾਢੈ ਬਾਹ ਫਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੯੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh hot dhiaaraa gur bheTai kaaddai baeh fare ||2||10||96||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when God becomes merciful, one meets with the Guru, who takes him by the arm, and lifts him out. ||2||10||96||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rasanaa har cheen(h)aa ||
verses.translation: With my mind, body and tongue, I remember the Lord.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhe ana(n)dhaa miTe a(n)dhese sarab sookh mo kau gur dheen(h)aa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am in ecstasy, and my anxieties are dispelled; the Guru has blessed me with total peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਆਨਪ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਭਈ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: eiaanap te sabh bhiee siaanap prabh meraa dhaanaa beenaa ||
verses.translation: My ignorance has been totally transformed into wisdom. My God is wise and all-knowing.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haath dhei raakhai apane kau kaahoo na karate kachh kheenaa ||1||
verses.translation: Giving me His Hand, He saved me, and now no one can harm me at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bal jaavau dharasan saadhoo kai jeh prasaadh har naam leenaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Holy; by their Grace, I contemplate the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਰੋਸੈ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਛੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੯੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak Thaakur bhaarosai kahoo na maanio man chheenaa ||2||11||97||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I place my faith in my Lord and Master; within my mind, I do not believe in any other, even for an instant. ||2||11||97||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai meree raakh liee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has saved me.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam ridhe meh dheeno janam janam kee mail giee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has enshrined the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within my heart, and the filth of countless incarnations has been washed away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਵਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: nivare dhoot dhusaT bairaiee gur poore kaa japiaa jaap ||
verses.translation: The demons and wicked enemies are driven out, by meditating, and chanting the Chant of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahaa karai koiee bechaaraa prabh mere kaa badd parataap ||1||
verses.translation: What can any wretched creature do to me? The radiance of my God is gloriously great. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar simar sukh paiaa charan kamal rakh man maahee ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace; I have enshrined His Lotus Feet within my mind.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੯੮॥
verses.translit: taa kee saran pario naanak dhaas jaa te uoopar ko naahee ||2||12||98||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; there is none above Him. ||2||12||98||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa japeeaai prabh naam ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, chant the Name of God.

verses.original: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaraa maraa kachh dhookh na biaapai aagai dharageh pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The pains of old age and death shall not afflict you, and in the Court of the Lord hereafter, your affairs shall be perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪਰੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap tiaag pareeaai nit saranee gur te paieeaai eh nidhaan ||
verses.translation: So forsake your self-conceit, and ever seek Sanctuary. This treasure is obtained only from the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਾਸੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam maran kee kaTeeaai faasee saachee dharageh kaa neesaan ||1||
verses.translation: The noose of birth and death is snapped; this is the insignia, the hallmark, of the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo tum(h) karahu soiee bhal maanau man te chhooTai sagal gumaan ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, I accept as good. I have eradicated all egotistical pride from my mind.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੯੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak taa kee saranaiee jaa kaa keeaa sagal jahaan ||2||13||99||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am under His protection; He created the entire Universe. ||2||13||99||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar prabh aahee ||
verses.translation: Deep within the nucleus of his mind and body, is God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨਿਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavat paraupakaar nit tis rasanaa kaa mol kichh naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He continually sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and always does good for others; his tongue is priceless. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kul samooh udhare khin bheetar janam janam kee mal laahee ||
verses.translation: All his generations are redeemed and saved in an instant, and the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa anadh setee bikhiaa ban gaahee ||1||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, his Lord and Master, he passes blissfully through the forest of poison. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: charan prabhoo ke bohith paae bhav saagar paar paraahee ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the boat of God's Feet, to carry me across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੦੦॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sevak bhagat har taa ke naanak man laagaa hai taahee ||2||14||100||
verses.translation: The Saints, servants and devotees belong to the Lord; Nanak's mind is attached to Him. ||2||14||100||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੀਰਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheerau dhekh tum(h)aarai ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: I am reassured, gazing upon Your wondrous play.

verses.original: ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tuhee suaamee a(n)tarajaamee toohee vaseh saadh kai sa(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; You dwell with the Holy Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khin meh thaap nivaaje Thaakur neech keeT te kareh raaja(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: In an instant, our Lord and Master establishes and exalts. From a lowly worm, He creates a king. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਇਹੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੧੦੧॥
verses.translit: kabahoo na bisarai he'ee more te naanak dhaas ihee dhaan ma(n)gaa ||2||15||101||
verses.translation: May I never forget You from my heart; slave Nanak prays for this blessing. ||2||15||101||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਚੁਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੋਗ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: achut poojaa jog gopaal ||
verses.translation: The imperishable Lord God is worthy of worship and adoration.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਰਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arap rakhau har aagai sarab jeeaa kaa hai pratipaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Dedicating my mind and body, I place them before the Lord, the Cherisher of all beings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮ੍ਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਬਡੋ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: saran samrath akath sukhadhaataa kirapaa si(n)dh baddo dhiaal ||
verses.translation: His Sanctuary is All-powerful; He cannot be described; He is the Giver of peace, the ocean of mercy, supremely compassionate.

verses.original: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਾਤੀ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th lai raakhai apane kau tis no lagai na taatee baal ||1||
verses.translation: Holding him close in His embrace, the Lord protects and saves him, and then even the hot wind cannot touch him. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: dhaamodhar dhiaal suaamee sarabas sa(n)t janaa dhan maal ||
verses.translation: Our Merciful Lord and Master is wealth, property and everything to His humble Saints.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੧੦੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jaachik dharas prabh maagai sa(n)t janaa kee milai ravaal ||2||16||102||
verses.translation: Nanak, a beggar, asks for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; please, bless him with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||16||102||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam koT jatan bhe ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of efforts.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਜਮਦੂਤਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਅਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g mil har gun gaae jamadhootan kau traas ahe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and the Messenger of Death will be frightened away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ਸੇ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jete punahacharan se keen(h)e man tan prabh ke charan gahe ||
verses.translation: To enshrine the Feet of God in one's mind and body, is to perform all sorts of acts of atonement.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan bharam bhau naaThaa janam janam ke kilavikh dhahe ||1||
verses.translation: Coming and going, doubt and fear have run away, and the sins of countless incarnations are burnt away. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਲਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau hoi bhajahu jagadheesai eh padhaarath vaddabhaag lahe ||
verses.translation: So become fearless, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. This is true wealth, obtained only by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੧੦੩॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa pooran prabh dhaate niramal jas naanak dhaas kahe ||2||17||103||
verses.translation: Be merciful, O Perfect God, Great Giver, that slave Nanak may chant Your immaculate Praises. ||2||17||103||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਲਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: sulahee te naarain raakh ||
verses.translation: The Lord saved me from Sulhi Khan.

verses.original: ਸੁਲਹੀ ਕਾ ਹਾਥੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸੁਲਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਆ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sulahee kaa haath kahee na pahuchai sulahee hoi mooaa naapaak ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The emperor did not succeed in his plot, and he died in disgrace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਢਿ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaadd kuThaar khasam sir kaaTiaa khin meh hoi giaa hai khaak ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master raised His axe, and chopped off his head; in an instant, he was reduced to dust. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪਚਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਧਾਕੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa chitavat chitavat pachiaa jin rachiaa tin dheenaa dhaak ||1||
verses.translation: Plotting and planning evil, he was destroyed. The One who created him, gave him a push.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: putr meet dhan kichhoo na rahio su chhodd giaa sabh bhaiee saak ||
verses.translation: Of his sons, friends and wealth, nothing remains; he departed, leaving behind all his brothers and relatives.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਾਕੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੧੦੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tis prabh balihaaree jin jan kaa keeno pooran vaak ||2||18||104||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to God, who fulfilled the word of His slave. ||2||18||104||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kee pooree sev ||
verses.translation: Perfect is service to the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap varatai suaamee kaaraj raas keeaa gurdhev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master Himself is Himself all-pervading. The Divine Guru has resolved all my affairs. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: aadh madh prabh a(n)t suaamee apanaa thaaT banaio aap ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, God is our only Lord and Master. He Himself fashioned His Creation.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: apane sevak kee aape raakhai prabh mere ko vadd parataap ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself saves His servant. Great is the glorious grandeur of my God! ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesur satigur vas keen(h)e jin sagale ja(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord is the True Guru; all beings are in His power.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੧੦੫॥
verses.translit: charan kamal naanak saranaiee raam naam jap niramal ma(n)t ||2||19||105||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet, chanting the Lord's Name, the immaculate Mantra. ||2||19||105||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: taap paap te raakhe aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself protects me from suffering and sin.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: seetal bhe gur charanee laage raam naam hiradhe meh jaap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Falling at the Guru's Feet, I am cooled and soothed; I meditate on the Lord's Name within my heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa hasat prabh dheene jagat udhaar nav kha(n)dd prataap ||
verses.translation: Granting His Mercy, God has extended His Hands. He is the Emancipator of the World; His glorious radiance pervades the nine continents.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhukh binase sukh anadh pravesaa tirasan bujhee man tan sach dhraap ||1||
verses.translation: My pain has been dispelled, and peace and pleasure have come; my desire is quenched, and my mind and body are truly satisfied. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: anaath ko naath saran samarathaa sagal sirasaT ko maiee baap ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, All-powerful to give Sanctuary. He is the Mother and Father of the whole Universe.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਲਾਪ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੧੦੬॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal bhai bha(n)jan suaamee gun gaavat naanak aalaap ||2||20||106||
verses.translation: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; Nanak sings and chants the Glorious Praises of his Lord and Master. ||2||20||106||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis te upajiaa tiseh pachhaan ||
verses.translation: Acknowledge the One, from whom You originated.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਹੋਏ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesar dhiaaiaa kusal khem hoe kaliaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, I have found peace, pleasure and salvation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਡ ਭਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa bheTio badd bhaagee a(n)tarajaamee sughaR sujaan ||
verses.translation: I met the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, and so found the wise and all-knowing Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haath dhei raakhe kar apane badd samarath nimaaniaa ko maan ||1||
verses.translation: He gave me His Hand, and making me His own, He saved me; He is absolutely all-powerful, the honor of the dishonored. ||1||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhai binas ge khin bheetar a(n)dhakaar pragaTe chaanaan ||
verses.translation: Doubt and fear have been dispelled in an instant, and in the darkness, the Divine Light shines forth.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੧੦੭॥
verses.translit: saas saas aaraadhai naanak sadhaa sadhaa jaieeaai kurabaan ||2||21||107||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||2||21||107||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੋਵੈ ਥਾਵ ਰਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhovai thaav rakhe gur soore ||
verses.translation: Both here and hereafter, the Mighty Guru protects me.

verses.original: ਹਲਤ ਪਲਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat paarabraham savaare kaaraj hoe sagale poore ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God has embellished this world and the next for me, and all my affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japat sukh sahaje majan hovat saadhoo dhoore ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have found peace and poise, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਬਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rahe thit paiee janam maran ke miTe bisoore ||1||
verses.translation: Comings and goings have ceased, and I have found stability; the pains of birth and death are eradicated. ||1||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਤਰੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਭੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhai tare chhuTe bhai jam ke ghaT ghaT ek rahiaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: I cross over the ocean of doubt and fear, and the fear of death is gone; the One Lord is permeating and pervading in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੧੦੮॥
verses.translit: naanak saran pario dhukh bha(n)jan a(n)tar baahar pekh hajoore ||2||22||108||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; I behold His Presence deep within, and all around as well. ||2||22||108||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਦੋਖ ਨਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan dhekhat dhokh nase ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all pains run away.

verses.original: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kabahu na hovahu dhirasaT agochar jeea kai sa(n)g base ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please, never leave my vision, O Lord; please abide with my soul. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: preetam praan adhaar suaamee ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Lord and Master is the Support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poor rahe prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||1||
verses.translation: God, the Inner-knower, is all-pervading. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gun tere saar sam(h)aaree ||
verses.translation: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I contemplate and remember?

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saas saas prabh tujheh chitaaree ||2||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, O God, I remember You. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidh prabh dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: God is the ocean of mercy, merciful to the meek;

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t kee karahu pratipaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: He cherishes all beings and creatures. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar teraa naam jan jaape ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, Your humble servant chants Your Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੧੦੯॥
verses.translit: naanak preet laiee prabh aape ||4||23||109||
verses.translation: You Yourself, O God, have inspired Nanak to love You. ||4||23||109||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਚਲਤ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan dhan joban chalat giaa ||
verses.translation: Body, wealth and youth pass away.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam kaa bhajan na keeno karat bikaar nis bhor bhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You have not meditated and vibrated upon the Lord's Name; while you commit your sins of corruption in the night, the light of day dawns upon you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਨਿਤ ਖਾਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਦੰਤਾ ਘਸਿ ਖੀਨ ਖਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anik prakaar bhojan nit khaate mukh dha(n)taa ghas kheen khiaa ||
verses.translation: Continually eating all sorts of foods, the teeth in your mouth crumble, decay and fall out.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਠਉ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਨਹ ਪਰੀ ਦਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: meree meree kar kar mooThau paap karat neh paree dhiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Living in egotism and possessiveness, you are deluded; committing sins, you have no kindness for others. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa bikaar ghor dhukh saagar tis meh praanee galat piaa ||
verses.translation: The great sins are the terrible ocean of pain; the mortal is engrossed in them.

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੧੧੦॥
verses.translit: saran pare naanak suaamee kee baeh pakar prabh kaadd liaa ||2||24||110||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; taking him by the arm, God has lifted him up and out. ||2||24||110||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇਆ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa prabh aaiaa cheet ||
verses.translation: God Himself has come into my consciousness.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੁਸਟ ਰਹੇ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਤ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaman dhusaT rahe jhakh maarat kusal bhiaa mere bhaiee meet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My enemies and opponents have grown weary of attacking me, and now, I have become happy, O my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: giee biaadh upaadh sabh naasee a(n)geekaar keeo karataar ||
verses.translation: The disease is gone, and all misfortunes have been averted; the Creator Lord has made me His own.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sookh ar anadh ghanere preetam naam ridhai ur haar ||1||
verses.translation: I have found peace, tranquility and total bliss, enshrining the Name of my Beloved Lord within my heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd dhan raas prabh teree too(n) samarath suaamee meraa ||
verses.translation: My soul, body and wealth are all Your capital; O God, You are my All-powerful Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੧੧੧॥
verses.translit: dhaas apune kau raakhanahaaraa naanak dhaas sadhaa hai cheraa ||2||25||111||
verses.translation: You are the Saving Grace of Your slaves; slave Nanak is forever Your slave. ||2||25||111||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh simar hoaa kaliaan ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I am emancipated.

verses.original: ਮਿਟੀ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: miTee upaadh bhiaa sukh saachaa a(n)tarajaamee simariaa jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Suffering is eradicated, and true peace has come, meditating on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਸੁਖਾਲੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis ke jeea tin ke'ee sukhaale bhagat janaa kau saachaa taan ||
verses.translation: All beings belong to Him - He makes them happy. He is the true power of His humble devotees.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੀ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaas apune kee aape raakhee bhai bha(n)jan uoopar karate maan ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself saves and protects His slaves, who believe in their Creator, the Destroyer of fear. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਮਿਟੀ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟ ਦੂਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਛਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhiee mitraiee miTee buraiee dhrusaT dhoot har kaadde chhaan ||
verses.translation: I have found friendship, and hatred has been eradicated; the Lord has rooted out the enemies and villains.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥੨॥੨੬॥੧੧੨॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ghanere naanak jeevai har guneh vakhaan ||2||26||112||
verses.translation: Nanak has been blessed with celestial peace and poise and total bliss; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he lives. ||2||26||112||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh bhe kirapaal ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become Merciful.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaaraj sagal savaare satigur jap jap saadhoo bhe nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has arranged all my affairs; chanting and meditating with the Holy Saints, I have become happy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਏ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai dhokhee sagale bhe ravaal ||
verses.translation: God has made me His own, and all my enemies have been reduced to dust.

verses.original: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੀਏ ਲਾਇ ਅਪਨੈ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th lai raakhe jan apane udhar le'ee lai apanai paal ||1||
verses.translation: He hugs us close in His embrace, and protects His humble servants; attaching us to the hem of His robe, he saves us. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sahee salaamat mil ghar aae ni(n)dhak ke mukh hoe kaal ||
verses.translation: Safe and sound, we have returned home, while the slanderer's face is blackened.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੧੧੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak meraa satigur pooraa gur prasaadh prabh bhe nihaal ||2||27||113||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect; by the Grace of God and Guru, I am so happy. ||2||27||113||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੂ ਲਾਲਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moo laalan siau preet banee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have fallen in love with my Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੋਰੀ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਛੋਰੀ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਐਸੀ ਮਾਧੋ ਖਿੰਚ ਤਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: toree na tooTai chhoree na chhooTai aaisee maadho khi(n)ch tanee ||1||
verses.translation: Cutting it, it does not break, and releasing it, it does not let go. Such is the string the Lord has tied me with. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhinas rain man maeh basat hai too kar kirapaa prabh apanee ||2||
verses.translation: Day and night, He dwells within my mind; please bless me with Your Mercy, O my God. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕਉ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bal bal jaau siaam su(n)dhar kau akath kathaa jaa kee baat sunee ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my beauteous Lord; I have heard his Unspoken Speech and Story. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੧੧੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dhaasan dhaas kaheeat hai moh karahu kirapaa Thaakur apunee ||4||28||114||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is said to be the slave of His slaves; O my Lord and Master, please bless me with Your Mercy. ||4||28||114||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਂਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ke charan jap jaa(n)au kurabaan ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Lord's Feet; I am a sacrifice to Them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur meraa paarabraham paramesur taa kaa hiradhai dhar man dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; I enshrine Him within my heart, and meditate on Him within my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar simar sukhadhaataa jaa kaa keeaa sagal jahaan ||
verses.translation: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Giver of peace, who created the whole Universe.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਵਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rasanaa ravahu ek naarain saachee dharageh paavahu maan ||1||
verses.translation: With your tongue, savor the One Lord, and you shall be honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g paraapat jaa kau tin hee paiaa eh nidhaan ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains this treasure, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੧੧੫॥
verses.translit: gaavau gun keeratan nit suaamee kar kirapaa naanak dheejai dhaan ||2||29||115||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master, mercifully bless Nanak with this gift, that he may ever sing the Glorious Praises of Your Kirtan. ||2||29||115||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣ ॥
verses.translit: raakh le'ee satigur kee saran ||
verses.translation: I have been saved, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar hoaa jag a(n)tar paarabraham mero taaran taran ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am cheered and applauded throughout the world; my Supreme Lord God carries me across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੋਖਣ ਭਰਣ ॥
verses.translit: bisavai(n)bhar pooran sukhadhaataa sagal samagree pokhan bharan ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord fills the Universe; He is the Giver of peace; He cherishes and fulfills the whole Universe.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar bal bal jaa(n)iee har ke charan ||1||
verses.translation: He is completely filling all places and interspaces; I am a devoted sacrifice to the Lord's Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ॥
verses.translit: jeea jugat vas mere suaamee sarab sidh tum kaaran karan ||
verses.translation: The ways of all beings are in Your Power, O my Lord and Master. All supernatural spiritual powers are Yours; You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਡਰਣ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੧੧੬॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh prabh rakhadhaa aaiaa har simarat naanak nahee ddaran ||2||30||116||
verses.translation: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, God is our Savior and Protector; remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, fear is eliminated. ||2||30||116||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੮
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ghar atthvaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay, Eighth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai naahee prabh sabh kichh teraa ||
verses.translation: I am nothing, God; everything is Yours.

verses.original: ਈਘੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਊਘੈ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕੇਲ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਚਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e'eeghai niragun uooghai saragun kel karat bich suaamee meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In this world, You are the absolute, formless Lord; in the world hereafter, You are the related Lord of form. You play it both ways, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਪਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: nagar meh aap baahar fun aapan prabh mere ko sagal baseraa ||
verses.translation: You exist within the city, and beyond it as well; O my God, You are everywhere.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਇਆ ਕਹ ਕਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਹ ਕਹ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape hee raajan aape hee raiaa keh keh Thaakur keh keh cheraa ||1||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the King, and You Yourself are the subject. In one place, You are the Lord and Master, and in another place, You are the slave. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਰਾਉ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਲਬੰਚਾ ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaa kau dhuraau kaa siau balaba(n)chaa jeh jeh pekhau teh teh neraa ||
verses.translation: From whom should I hide? Whom should I try to deceive? Wherever I look, I see Him near at hand.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਨਹੀ ਅਨ ਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੧੭॥
verses.translit: saadh moorat gur bheTio naanak mil saagar boo(n)dh nahee an heraa ||2||1||117||
verses.translation: I have met with Guru Nanak, the Embodiment of the Holy Saints. When the drop of water merges into the ocean, it cannot be distinguished as separate again. ||2||1||117||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) samarathaa kaaran karan ||
verses.translation: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਢਾਕਨ ਢਾਕਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਰਨ ਚਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ddaakan ddaak gobidh gur mere moh aparaadhee saran charan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please cover my faults, Lord of the Universe, O my Guru; I am a sinner - I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਢੀਠ ਮੁਕਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo keeno so tum(h) jaanio pekhio Thaur naahee kachh ddeeTh mukaran ||
verses.translation: Whatever we do, You see and know; there is no way anyone can stubbornly deny this.

verses.original: ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: badd parataap sunio prabh tum(h)ro koT aghaa tero naam haran ||1||
verses.translation: Your glorious radiance is great! So I have heard, O God. Millions of sins are destroyed by Your Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੋ ਸਹਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਨ ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: hamaro sahaau sadhaa sadh bhoolan tum(h)ro biradh patit udharan ||
verses.translation: It is my nature to make mistakes, forever and ever; it is Your Natural Way to save sinners.

verses.original: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੮॥
verses.translit: karunaa mai kirapaal kirapaa nidh jeevan padh naanak har dharasan ||2||2||118||
verses.translation: You are the embodiment of kindness, and the treasure of compassion, O Merciful Lord; through the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, Nanak has found the state of redemption in life. ||2||2||118||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee kirapaa moh karahu ||
verses.translation: Bless me with such mercy, Lord,

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਣ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਮਾਥਾ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)teh charan hamaaro maathaa nain dharas tan dhoor parahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that my forehead may touch the feet of the Saints, and my eyes may behold the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, and my body may fall at the dust of their feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਬਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur ko sabadh merai heearai baasai har naamaa man sa(n)g dharahu ||
verses.translation: May the Word of the Guru's Shabad abide within my heart, and the Lord's Name be enshrined within my mind.

verses.original: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਨਿਵਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਰਮਾ ਹੋਮਿ ਜਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tasakar pa(n)ch nivaarahu Thaakur sagalo bharamaa hom jarahu ||1||
verses.translation: Drive out the five thieves, O my Lord and Master, and let my doubts all burn like incense. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਵਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਟਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo tum(h) karahu soiee bhal maanai bhaavan dhubidhaa dhoor Tarahu ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, I accept as good; I have driven out the sense of duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak ke prabh tum hee dhaate sa(n)tasa(n)g le moh udharahu ||2||3||119||
verses.translation: You are Nanak's God, the Great Giver; in the Congregation of the Saints, emancipate me. ||2||3||119||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee dheekhiaa jan siau ma(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: I ask for such advice from Your humble servants,

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ro dhiaan tum(h)aaro ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: that I may meditate on You, and love You,

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree sevaa tum(h)aare a(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and serve You, and become part and parcel of Your Being. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਊਠਨੁ ਬੈਠਨੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jan kee Tahal sa(n)bhaakhan jan siau uooThan baiThan jan kai sa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: I serve His humble servants, and speak with them, and abide with them.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਚਰ ਰਜ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan char raj mukh maathai laagee aasaa pooran ana(n)t tara(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: I apply the dust of the feet of His humble servants to my face and forehead; my hopes, and the many waves of desire, are fulfilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋਟਿ ਗੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jan paarabraham jaa kee niramal mahimaa jan ke charan teerath koT ga(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Immaculate and pure are the praises of the humble servants of the Supreme Lord God; the feet of His humble servants are equal to millions of sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਹਰੇ ਕਲੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੦॥
verses.translit: jan kee dhoor keeo majan naanak janam janam ke hare kala(n)gaa ||2||4||120||
verses.translation: Nanak bathes in the dust of the feet of His humble servants; the sinful resides of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||2||4||120||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau moh pratipaal ||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, then cherish me.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesar satigur ham baarik tum(h) pitaa kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, O True Guru, I am Your child, and You are my Merciful Father. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun gun naahee koiee pahuch na saakau tum(h)ree ghaal ||
verses.translation: I am worthless; I have no virtues at all. I cannot understand Your actions.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanahu jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tumaro maal ||1||
verses.translation: You alone know Your state and extent. My soul, body and property are all Yours. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਨਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee purakh suaamee anabolat hee jaanahu haal ||
verses.translation: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Primal Lord and Master; You know even what is unspoken.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੨੧॥
verses.translit: tan man seetal hoi hamaaro naanak prabh jeeau nadhar nihaal ||2||5||121||
verses.translation: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, O Nanak, by God's Glance of Grace. ||2||5||121||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: raakh sadhaa prabh apanai saath ||
verses.translation: Keep me with You forever, O God.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਹਮਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too hamaro preetam manmohan tujh bin jeevan sagal akaath ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my Beloved, the Enticer of my mind; without You, my life is totally useless. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਉ ਕਰਤ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)k te raau karat khin bheetar prabh mero anaath ko naath ||
verses.translation: In an instant, You transform the beggar into a king; O my God, You are the Master of the masterless.

verses.original: ਜਲਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jalat agan meh jan aap udhaare kar apune dhe raakhe haath ||1||
verses.translation: You save Your humble servants from the burning fire; You make them Your own, and with Your Hand, You protect them. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: seetal sukh paio man tirapate har simarat sram sagale laath ||
verses.translation: I have found peace and cool tranquility, and my mind is satisfied; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all struggles are ended.

verses.original: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੨॥
verses.translit: nidh nidhaan naanak har sevaa avar siaanap sagal akaath ||2||6||122||
verses.translation: Service to the Lord, O Nanak, is the treasure of treasures; all other clever tricks are useless. ||2||6||122||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: apane sevak kau kabahu na bisaarahu ||
verses.translation: Never forget Your servant, O Lord.

verses.original: ਉਰਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aur laagahu suaamee prabh mere poorab preet gobi(n)dh beechaarahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Hug me close in Your embrace, O God, my Lord and Master; consider my primal love for You, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਹਮਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਤ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan prabh biradh tum(h)aaro hamare dhokh ridhai mat dhaarahu ||
verses.translation: It is Your Natural Way, God, to purify sinners; please do not keep my errors in Your Heart.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਟਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeevan praan har dhan sukh tum hee haumai paTal kirapaa kar jaarahu ||1||
verses.translation: You are my life, my breath of life, O Lord, my wealth and peace; be merciful to me, and burn away the curtain of egotism. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮੀਨ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੂਧ ਬਿਨਾ ਰਹਨੁ ਕਤ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jal bihoon meen kat jeevan dhoodh binaa rahan kat baaro ||
verses.translation: Without water, how can the fish survive? Without milk, how can the baby survive?

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨੑ ਕੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak piaas charan kamalan(h) kee pekh dharas suaamee sukh saaro ||2||7||123||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak thirsts for the Lord's Lotus Feet; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of his Lord and Master's Darshan, he finds the essence of peace. ||2||7||123||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aagai paachhai kusal bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Here, and hereafter, there is happiness.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai pooree sabh raakhee paarabraham prabh keenee miaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has perfectly, totally saved me; the Supreme Lord God has been kind to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਸਗਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rav rahiaa har preetam dhookh dharadh sagalaa miT giaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, my Beloved, is pervading and permeating my mind and body; all my pains and sufferings are dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sahaj aanadh gun gaae dhoot dhusaT sabh hoe khiaa ||1||
verses.translation: In celestial peace, tranquility and bliss, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; my enemies and adversaries have been totally destroyed. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gun avagun prabh kachh na beechaario kar kirapaa apunaa kar liaa ||
verses.translation: God has not considered my merits and demerits; in His Mercy, He has made me His own.

verses.original: ਅਤੁਲ ਬਡਾਈ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੪॥
verses.translit: atul baddaiee achut abinaasee naanak ucharai har kee jiaa ||2||8||124||
verses.translation: Unweighable is the greatness of the immovable and imperishable Lord; Nanak proclaims the victory of the Lord. ||2||8||124||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਤਰਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhai bhagatee taran kaise ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, how can anyone cross over the world-ocean?

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪ ਭਰੋਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karahu anugrahu patit udhaaran raakh suaamee aap bharose ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Be kind to me, O Saving Grace of sinners; preserve my faith in You, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: simaran nahee aavat firat madh maavat bikhiaa raataa suaan jaise ||
verses.translation: The mortal does not remember the Lord in meditation; he wanders around intoxicated by egotism; he is engrossed in corruption like a dog.

verses.original: ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਵਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਬੁਡੇ ਐਸੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaudh bihaavat adhik mohaavat paap kamaavat budde aaise ||1||
verses.translation: Utterly cheated, his life is slipping away; committing sins, he is sinking away. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਵਣੁ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: saran dhukh bha(n)jan purakh nira(n)jan saadhoo sa(n)gat ravan jaise ||
verses.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Destroyer of pain; O Primal Immaculate Lord, may I dwell upon You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕੇਸਵ ਕਲੇਸ ਨਾਸ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਸੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੨੫॥
verses.translit: kesav kales naas agh kha(n)ddan naanak jeevat dharas dhise ||2||9||125||
verses.translation: O Lord of beautiful hair, Destroyer of pain, Eradicator of sins, Nanak lives, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||9||125||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੯
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ghar nauvaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay, Ninth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਪਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapeh mel le ||
verses.translation: He Himself merges us with Himself.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਏ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab te saran tumaaree aae tab te dhokh ge ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When I came to Your Sanctuary, my sins vanished. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਨ ਪਏ ॥
verses.translit: taj abhimaan ar chi(n)t biraanee saadheh saran pe ||
verses.translation: Renouncing egotistical pride and other anxieties, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ਖਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jap jap naam tum(h)aaro preetam tan te rog khe ||1||
verses.translation: Chanting, meditating on Your Name, O my Beloved, disease is eradicated from my body. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਰਾਖੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਦਏ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa mugadh ajaan agiaanee raakhe dhaar dhe ||
verses.translation: Even utterly foolish, ignorant and thoughtless persons have been saved by the Kind Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨ ਰਹੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur pooraa bheTio aavan jaan rahe ||2||1||126||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have met the Perfect Guru; my comings and goings have ended. ||2||1||126||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeevau naam sunee ||
verses.translation: Hearing Your Name, I live.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਬ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jau suprasa(n)n bhe gur poore tab meree aas punee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the Perfect Guru became pleased with me, then my hopes were fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਬਾਧੀ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰਾ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਅਨਦ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: peer giee baadhee man dheeraa mohio anadh dhunee ||
verses.translation: Pain is gone, and my mind is comforted; the music of bliss fascinates me.

verses.original: ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ਮਿਲਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aupajio chaau milan prabh preetam rahan na jai khinee ||1||
verses.translation: The yearning to meet my Beloved God has welled up within me. I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਮੁਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik bhagat anik jan taare simareh anik munee ||
verses.translation: You have saved so many devotees, so many humble servants; so many silent sages contemplate You.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੨੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhule Tik niradhan dhan paio prabh naanak anik gunee ||2||2||127||
verses.translation: The support of the blind, the wealth of the poor; Nanak has found God, of endless virtues. ||2||2||127||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ਪੜਤਾਲ
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar tayrvaa paRataal
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Thirteenth House, Partaal:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਵੈ ਹਾਰ ਕਜਰ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਭਰਨ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: mohan needh na aavai haavai haar kajar basatr abharan keene ||
verses.translation: O Enticing Lord, I cannot sleep; I sigh. I am adorned with necklaces, gowns, ornaments and make-up.

verses.original: ਉਡੀਨੀ ਉਡੀਨੀ ਉਡੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: auddeenee uddeenee uddeenee ||
verses.translation: I am sad, sad and depressed.

verses.original: ਕਬ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kab ghar aavai ree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When will You come home? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saran suhaagan charan sees dhar ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the happy soul-brides; I place my head upon their feet.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: laalan moh milaavahu ||
verses.translation: Unite me with my Beloved.

verses.original: ਕਬ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kab ghar aavai ree ||1||
verses.translation: When will He come to my home? ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਮਿਲਨ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਉ ਸਗਰੋ ਅਹੰ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sunahu saheree milan baat kahau sagaro aha(n) miTaavahu tau ghar hee laalan paavahu ||
verses.translation: Listen, my companions: tell me how to meet Him. Eradicate all egotism, and then you shall find your Beloved Lord within the home of your heart.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਰਸ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: tab ras ma(n)gal gun gaavahu ||
verses.translation: Then, in delight, you shall sing the songs of joy and praise.

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aanadh roop dhiaavahu ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, the embodiment of bliss.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhuaarai aaio ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I came to the Lord's Door,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਮੈ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tau mai laalan paio ree ||2||
verses.translation: and then, I found my Beloved. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: mohan roop dhikhaavai ||
verses.translation: The Enticing Lord has revealed His form to me,

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਨੀਦ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh needh suhaavai ||
verses.translation: and now, sleep seems sweet to me.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meree tikhaa bujhaanee ||
verses.translation: My thirst is totally quenched,

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: ab mai sahaj samaanee ||
verses.translation: and now, I am absorbed in celestial bliss.

verses.original: ਮੀਠੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: meeThee pireh kahaanee ||
verses.translation: How sweet is the story of my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੮॥
verses.translit: mohan laalan paio ree || rahaau dhoojaa ||1||128||
verses.translation: I have found my Beloved, Enticing Lord. ||Second Pause||1||128||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੋਰੀ ਅਹੰ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: moree aha(n) jai dharasan paavat he ||
verses.translation: My ego is gone; I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਰਾਚਹੁ ਨਾਥ ਹੀ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: raachahu naath hee sahaiee sa(n)tanaa ||
verses.translation: I am absorbed in my Lord and Master, the help and support of the Saints.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ab charan gahe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Now, I hold tight to His Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਹੇ ਮਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ ਉਲਝਿਓ ਅਲਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕਮਲ ਜਿਉ ॥
verses.translit: aahe man avar na bhaavai charanaavai charanaavai ulajhio al makara(n)dh kamal jiau ||
verses.translation: My mind longs for Him, and does not love any other. I am totally absorbed, in love with His Lotus Feet, like the bumble bee attached to the honey of the lotus flower.

verses.original: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹੈ ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: an ras nahee chaahai ekai har laahai ||1||
verses.translation: I do not desire any other taste; I seek only the One Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੀਐ ਰਿਖ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: an te TooTeeaai rikh te chhooTeeaai ||
verses.translation: I have broken away from the others, and I have been released from the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਘੂਟੀਐ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਲਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: man har ras ghooTeeaai sa(n)g saadhoo ulaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: O mind, drink in the subtle essence of the Lord; join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and turn away from the world.

verses.original: ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: an naahee naahee re ||
verses.translation: There is no other, none other than the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਚਰਨ ਹੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੨੯॥
verses.translit: naanak preet charan charan he ||2||2||129||
verses.translation: O Nanak, love the Feet, the Feet of the Lord. ||2||2||129||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa nauvaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Ninth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh harataa har naam pachhaano ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Dispeller of sorrow - realize this.

verses.original: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ajaamal ganikaa jeh simarat mukat bhe jeea jaano ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, even Ajaamal the robber and Ganikaa the prostitute were liberated; let your soul know this. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਜ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਛਿਨਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਜਬ ਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: gaj kee traas miTee chhinahoo meh jab hee raam bakhaano ||
verses.translation: The elephant's fear was taken away in an instant, as soon as he chanted the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਰਦ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਭਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naaradh kahat sunat dhraooa baarik bhajan maeh lapaTaano ||1||
verses.translation: Listening to Naarad's teachings, the child Dhroo was absorbed in deep meditation. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਚਲ ਅਮਰ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਗਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: achal amar nirabhai padh paio jagat jaeh hairaano ||
verses.translation: He obtained the immovable, eternal state of fearlessness, and all the world was amazed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਭਗਤ ਰਛਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kahat bhagat rachhak har nikaT taeh tum maano ||2||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord is the Saving Grace and the Protector of His devotees; believe it - He is close to you. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam binaa dhukh paavai ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, you shall only find pain.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat binaa sahasaa neh chookai gur ih bhedh bataavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship, doubt is not dispelled; the Guru has revealed this secret. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੀਰਥ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa bhio teerath brat ke'ee raam saran nahee aavai ||
verses.translation: Of what use are sacred shrines of pilgrimage, if one does not enter the Sanctuary of the Lord?

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਜਗ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਨਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jog jag nihafal teh maanau jo prabh jas bisaraavai ||1||
verses.translation: Know that Yoga and sacrificial feasts are fruitless, if one forgets the Praises of God. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੋਨੋ ਕਉ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: maan moh dhono kau parahar gobi(n)dh ke gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: One who lays aside both pride and attachment, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ieh bidh ko praanee jeevan mukat kahaavai ||2||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the mortal who does this is said to be 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yet alive. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਮੈ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa mai bhajan raam ko naahee ||
verses.translation: There is no meditation on the Lord within him.

verses.original: ਤਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਯਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teh nar janam akaarath khoiaa yeh raakhahu man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: That man wastes his life uselessly - keep this in mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit: teerath karai brat fun raakhai neh manooaa bas jaa ko ||
verses.translation: He bathes at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and adheres to fasts, but he has no control over his mind.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਤ ਮੈ ਯਾ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nihafal dharam taeh tum maanahu saach kahat mai yaa kau ||1||
verses.translation: Know that such religion is useless to him. I speak the Truth for his sake. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਹਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਭੇਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaise paahan jal meh raakhio bhedhai naeh teh paanee ||
verses.translation: It's like a stone, kept immersed in water; still, the water does not penetrate it.

verses.original: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taise hee tum taeh pachhaanahu bhagat heen jo praanee ||2||
verses.translation: So, understand it: that mortal being who lacks devotional worship is just like that. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਯਹ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kal mai mukat naam te paavat gur yeh bhedh bataavai ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, liberation comes from the Naam. The Guru has revealed this secret.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਗਰੂਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak soiee nar garooaa jo prabh ke gun gaavai ||3||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, he alone is a great man, who sings the Praises of God. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧੦
verses.translit: bilaaval asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar dasvaa
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, Tenth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nikaT vasai dhekhai sabh soiee ||
verses.translation: He dwells close at hand, and sees all,

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh viralaa boojhai koiee ||
verses.translation: but how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: vin bhai piaai bhagat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate sadhaa sukh hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, eternal peace is attained. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa giaan padhaarath naam ||
verses.translation: Such is the spiritual wisdom, the treasure of the Naam;

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paavas ras ras maan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: obtaining it, the Gurmukhs enjoy the subtle essence of this nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: giaan giaan kathai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone talks about spiritual wisdom and spiritual knowledge.

verses.original: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kath kath baadh kare dhukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Talking, talking, they argue, and suffer.

verses.original: ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kath kahanai te rahai na koiee ||
verses.translation: No one can stop talking and discussing it.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin ras raate mukat na hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: Without being imbued with the subtle essence, there is no liberation. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan sabh gur te hoiee ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom and meditation all come from the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਰਹਤ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saachee rahat saachaa man soiee ||
verses.translation: Through the lifestyle of Truth, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਥਨੀ ਹੈ ਪਰੁ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kathanee hai par rahat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh talks about it, but does not practice it.

verses.original: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naavahu bhoole thaau na koiee ||3||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਿਓ ਸਰ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man maiaa ba(n)dhio sar jaal ||
verses.translation: Maya has caught the mind in the trap of the whirlpool.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT biaap rahio bikh naal ||
verses.translation: Each and every heart is trapped by this bait of poison and sin.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਆਂਜੈ ਸੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo aa(n)jai so dheesai kaal ||
verses.translation: See that whoever has come, is subject to death.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੀਧੋ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kaaraj seedho ridhai sam(h)aal ||4||
verses.translation: Your affairs shall be adjusted, if you contemplate the Lord in your heart. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: so giaanee jin sabadh liv laiee ||
verses.translation: He alone is a spiritual teacher, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh haumai pat gavaiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed, egotistical manmukh loses his honor.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape karatai bhagat karaiee ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord Himself inspires us to His devotional worship.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aape dhe vaddiaaiee ||5||
verses.translation: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||5||

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: rain a(n)dhaaree niramal jot ||
verses.translation: The life-night is dark, while the Divine Light is immaculate.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਕੁਚਲ ਕਛੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa jhooThe kuchal kachhot ||
verses.translation: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are false, filthy and untouchable.

verses.original: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bedh pukaarai bhagat sarot ||
verses.translation: The Vedas preach sermons of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਜੋਤਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sun sun maanai vekhai jot ||6||
verses.translation: Listening, hearing and believing, one beholds the Divine Light. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: saasatr simirat naam dhiraRaama(n) ||
verses.translation: The Shaastras and Simritees implant the Naam within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਾਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saa(n)t uootam karaama(n) ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh lives in peace and tranquility, doing deeds of sublime purity.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh jonee dhookh sahaama(n) ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh suffers the pains of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਮੰ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan tooTe ik naam vasaama(n) ||7||
verses.translation: His bonds are broken, enshrining the Name of the One Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ne naam sachee pat poojaa ||
verses.translation: Believing in the Naam, one obtains true honor and adoration.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: kis vekhaa naahee ko dhoojaa ||
verses.translation: Who should I see? There is none other than the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh kahau bhaavai man soi ||
verses.translation: I see, and I say, that He alone is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai avar nahee koi ||8||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa kahiaa manasaa karai ||
verses.translation: The human acts according to the wishes of the mind.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man pu(n)n paap ucharai ||
verses.translation: This mind feeds on virtue and vice.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa madh maate tirapat na aavai ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with the wine of Maya, satisfaction never comes.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tirapat mukat man saachaa bhaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Satisfaction and liberation come, only to one whose mind is pleasing to the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tan dhan kalat sabh dhekh abhimaanaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon his body, wealth, wife and all his possessions, he is proud.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai kichh sa(n)g na jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But without the Name of the Lord, nothing shall go along with him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੀਚਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: keecheh ras bhog khuseeaa man keree ||
verses.translation: He enjoys tastes, pleasures and joys in his mind.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhan lokaa(n) tan bhasamai dderee ||
verses.translation: But his wealth will pass on to other people, and his body will be reduced to ashes.

verses.original: ਖਾਕੂ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: khaakoo khaak ralai sabh fail ||
verses.translation: The entire expanse, like dust, shall mix with dust.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਮੈਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai nahee utarai mail ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, his filth is not removed. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੀਤ ਰਾਗ ਘਨ ਤਾਲ ਸਿ ਕੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: geet raag ghan taal s koore ||
verses.translation: The various songs, tunes and rhythms are false.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tirahu gun upajai binasai dhoore ||
verses.translation: Trapped by the three qualities, people come and go, far from the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojee dhuramat dharadh na jai ||
verses.translation: In duality, the pain of their evil-mindedness does not leave them.

verses.original: ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਾਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chhooTai gurmukh dhaaroo gun gai ||3||
verses.translation: But the Gurmukh is emancipated by taking the medicine, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਧੋਤੀ ਊਜਲ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhotee uoojal tilak gal maalaa ||
verses.translation: He may wear a clean loin-cloth, apply the ceremonial mark to his forehead, and wear a mala around his neck;

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਨਾਟ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar karodh paReh naaT saalaa ||
verses.translation: but if there is anger within him, he is merely reading his part, like an actor in a play.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam visaar maiaa madh peeaa ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he drinks in the wine of Maya.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bin gur bhagat naahee sukh theeaa ||4||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship to the Guru, there is no peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਕਰ ਸੁਆਨ ਗਰਧਭ ਮੰਜਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sookar suaan garadhabh ma(n)jaaraa ||
verses.translation: The human is a pig, a dog, a donkey, a cat,

verses.original: ਪਸੂ ਮਲੇਛ ਨੀਚ ਚੰਡਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: pasoo malechh neech cha(n)ddaalaa ||
verses.translation: a beast, a filthy, lowly wretch, an outcast,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur te muh fere tin(h) jon bhavaieeaai ||
verses.translation: if he turns his face away from the Guru. He shall wander in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan baadhiaa aaieeaai jaieeaai ||5||
verses.translation: Bound in bondage, he comes and goes. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੈ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te lahai padhaarath ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, the treasure is found.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥੁ ॥
