verses.translit: hiradhai naam sadhaa kirataarath ||
verses.translation: With the Naam in the heart, one always prospers.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saachee dharageh poochh na hoi ||
verses.translation: And in the Court of the True Lord, you shall not called to account.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੀਝੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: maane hukam seejhai dhar soi ||6||
verses.translation: One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, is approved at the Lord's Door. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta tis kau jaanai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one knows the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਹੈ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: rahai rajaiee hukam pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: Understanding the Hukam of His Command, one acts according to His Will.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: hukam pachhaan sachai dhar vaas ||
verses.translation: Understanding the Hukam of His Command, he dwells in the Court of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਏ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kaal bikaal sabadh bhe naas ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, death and birth are ended. ||7||

verses.original: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: rahai ateet jaanai sabh tis kaa ||
verses.translation: He remains detached, knowing that everything belongs to God.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: tan man arapai hai ih jis kaa ||
verses.translation: He dedicates his body and mind unto the One who owns them.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa oh aavai naa oh jai ||
verses.translation: He does not come, and he does not go.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saache saach samai ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, absorbed in Truth, he merges in the True Lord. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa asaTapadhee ghar dasvaa
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਕਊਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੁੰਚ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jag kuooaa mukh chu(n)ch giaan ||
verses.translation: The world is like a crow; with its beak, it croaks spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar lobh jhooTh abhimaan ||
verses.translation: But deep within there is greed, falsehood and pride.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਗੁ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin naavai paaj lahag nidhaan ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, your thin outer covering shall wear off, you fool. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev naam vasai man cheet ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Naam shall dwell in your conscious mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur bheTe har naam chetaavai bin naavai hor jhooTh pareet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the Name of the Lord comes to mind. Without the Name, other loves are false. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kahiaa saa kaar kamaavahu ||
verses.translation: So do that work, which the Guru tells you to do.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh cheeni(h) sahaj ghar aavahu ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, you shall come to the home of celestial bliss.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saachai nai vaddaiee paavahu ||2||
verses.translation: Through the True Name, you shall obtain glorious greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap na boojhai lok bujhaavai ||
verses.translation: One who does not understand his own self, but still tries to instruct others,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaavai ||
verses.translation: is mentally blind, and acts in blindness.

verses.original: ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਠਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhar ghar mahal Thaur kaise paavai ||3||
verses.translation: How can he ever find a home and a place of rest, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence? ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau seveeaai a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: Serve the Dear Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts;

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar jis kee jot samaanee ||
verses.translation: deep within each and every heart, His Light is shining forth.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਪਹਨਾਮੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tis naal kiaa chalai pahanaamee ||4||
verses.translation: How can anyone hide anything from Him? ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa naam saachai sabadh jaanai ||
verses.translation: The True Name is known through the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: aapai aap milai chookai abhimaanai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself meets that one who eradicates egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam sadhaa sadhaa vakhaanai ||5||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh chants the Naam, forever and ever. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai dhoojee dhuramat jaiee ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, duality and evil-mindedness are taken away.

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਤਿ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaugan kaaT paapaa mat khaiee ||
verses.translation: Guilty mistakes are erased, and the sinful intellect is cleansed.

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan kaiaa jotee jot samaiee ||6||
verses.translation: One's body sparkles like gold, and one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, one is blessed with glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh kaaTai hiradhai naam vasaiee ||
verses.translation: Pain is taken away, and the Naam comes to dwell within the heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naam rate sadhaa sukh paiee ||7||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, one finds eternal peace. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat maaniaa karanee saar ||
verses.translation: Obeying the Gur's instructions, one's actions are purified.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat maaniaa mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Obeying the Guru's Instructions, one finds the state of salvation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmat maaniaa paravaarai saadhaar ||8||1||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who follow the Guru's Teachings are saved, along with their families. ||8||1||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੧
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa asaTapadheeaa ghar gayaarvaa
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Eleventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਹਉ ਮੇਟੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਗੀਤ ਗਵਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapai aap khai hau meTai anadhin har ras geet gavieeaa ||
verses.translation: One who eliminates his self-centeredness, and eradicates his ego, night and day sings the songs of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh parachai ka(n)chan kaiaa nirabhau jotee jot milieeaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is inspired, his body is golden, and his light merges into the Light of the Fearless Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਰਮਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai har har naam adhaar ramieeaa ||
verses.translation: I take the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khin pal reh na sakau bin naavai gurmukh har har paaTh paRieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot live, for a moment, even for an instant, without the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh reads the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਗਿਰਹੁ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: ek girahu dhas dhuaar hai jaa ke ahinis tasakar pa(n)ch chor lagieeaa ||
verses.translation: In the one house of the body, there are ten gates; night and day, the five thieves break in.

verses.original: ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dharam arath sabh hir le jaaveh manmukh a(n)dhule khabar na pieeaa ||2||
verses.translation: They steal the entire wealth of one's Dharmic faith, but the blind, self-willed manmukh does not know it. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟੁ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan koT bahu maanak bhariaa jaage giaan tat liv lieeaa ||
verses.translation: The fortress of the body is overflowing with gold and jewels; when it is awakened by spiritual wisdom, one enshrines love for the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਤਸਕਰ ਹੇਰੂ ਆਇ ਲੁਕਾਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tasakar heroo aai lukaane gur kai sabadh pakaR ba(n)dh pieeaa ||3||
verses.translation: The thieves and robbers hide out in the body; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are arrested and locked up. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੋਤੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam pot bohithaa khevaT sabadh gur paar la(n)ghieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the boatman, to carry us across.

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jam jaagaatee neR na aavai naa ko tasakar chor lagieeaa ||4||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even come close, and no thieves or robbers can plunder you. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavai sadhaa dhin raatee mai har jas kahate a(n)t na laheeaa ||
verses.translation: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night; singing the Lord's Praises, I cannot find His limits.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਈਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh manooaa ikat ghar aavai milau guopaal neesaan bajieeaa ||5||
verses.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh returns to its own home; it meets the Lord of the Universe, to the beat of the celestial drum. ||5||

verses.original: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: nainee dhekh dharas man tirapatai sravan baanee gur sabadh sunieeaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with my eyes, my mind is satisfied; with my ears, I listen to the Guru's Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਹੈ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਵਈਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sun sun aatam dhev hai bheene ras ras raam gopaal ravieeaa ||6||
verses.translation: Listening, listening, my soul is softened, delighted by His subtle essence, chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||6||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun maiaa moh viaape tureeaa gun hai gurmukh laheeaa ||
verses.translation: In the grip of the three qualities, they are engrossed in love and attachment to Maya; only as Gurmukh do they find the absolute quality, absorption in bliss.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਈਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ek dhirasaT sabh sam kar jaanai nadharee aavai sabh braham pasarieeaa ||7||
verses.translation: With a single, impartial eye, look upon all alike, and see God pervading all. ||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam hai jot sabaiee gurmukh aape alakh lakhieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Light of the Lord's Name permeates all; the Gurmukh knows the unknowable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dheen dhiaal bhe hai bhagat bhai har naam samieeaa ||8||1||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord has become merciful to the meek; through loving adoration, he merges in the Lord's Name. ||8||1||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਗੰਧਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam seetal jal dhiaavahu har cha(n)dhan vaas suga(n)dh ga(n)dhieeaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the cool water of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Perfume yourself with the fragrant scent of the Lord, the sandalwood tree.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਡ ਪਲਾਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਹੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat param padh paiaa mai hiradd palaas sa(n)g har buheeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have obtained the supreme status. I am just a castor-oil tree, made fragrant by their association. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: jap jaga(n)naath jagadhees gusieeaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the world, the Lord of creation.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saran pare seiee jan ubare jiau prahilaadh udhaar samieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who seek the Lord's Sanctuary are saved, like Prahlaad; they are emancipated and merge with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਊਤਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੁਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaar aThaareh meh cha(n)dhan uootam cha(n)dhan nikaT sabh cha(n)dhan huieeaa ||
verses.translation: Of all plants, the sandalwood tree is the most sublime. Everything near the sandalwood tree becomes fragrant like sandalwood.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਊਭ ਸੁਕ ਹੂਏ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saakat kooRe uoobh suk hooe man abhimaan vichhuR dhoor gieeaa ||2||
verses.translation: The stubborn, false faithless cynics are dried up; their egotistical pride separates them far from the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: har gat mit karataa aape jaanai sabh bidh har har aap banieeaa ||
verses.translation: Only the Creator Lord Himself knows the state and condition of everyone; the Lord Himself makes all the arrangements.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਮਿਟਈਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis satigur bheTe su ka(n)chan hovai jo dhur likhiaa su miTai na miTieeaa ||3||
verses.translation: One who meets the True Guru is transformed into gold. Whatever is pre-ordained, is not erased by erasing. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਖੁਲੑਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: ratan padhaarath gurmat paavai saagar bhagat bha(n)ddaar khul(h)ieeaa ||
verses.translation: The treasure of jewels is found in the ocean of the Guru's Teachings. The treasure of devotional worship is opened to me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਇਕ ਸਰਧਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਭਈਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur charanee ik saradhaa upajee mai har gun kahate tirapat na bhieeaa ||4||
verses.translation: Focused on the Guru's Feet, faith wells up within me; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I hunger for more. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਕਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: param bairaag nit nit har dhiaae mai har gun kahate bhaavanee kaheeaa ||
verses.translation: I am totally detached, continually, continuously meditating on the Lord; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I express my love for Him.

verses.original: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: baar baar khin khin pal kaheeaai har paar na paavai parai parieeaa ||5||
verses.translation: Time and time again, each and every moment and instant, I express it. I cannot find the Lord's limits; He is the farthest of the far. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: saasat bedh puraan pukaareh dharam karahu khaT karam dhiraRieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas advise righteous actions, and the performance of the six religious rituals.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਭਾਰਿ ਬੁਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: manmukh paakha(n)dd bharam vigoote lobh lahar naav bhaar buddieeaa ||6||
verses.translation: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are ruined by doubt; in the waves of greed, their boat is heavily loaded, and it sinks. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam japahu naame gat paavahu simirat saasatr naam dhiraRieeaa ||
verses.translation: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and through the Naam, find emancipation. The Simritees and Shaastras recommend the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: haumai jai ta niramal hovai gurmukh parachai param padh pieeaa ||7||
verses.translation: Eradicating egotism, one becomes pure. The Gurmukh is inspired, and obtains the supreme status. ||7||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag varan roop sabh teraa jit laaveh se karam kamieeaa ||
verses.translation: This world, with its colors and forms, is all Yours, O Lord; as You attach us, so do we do our deeds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਜਾਏ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਚਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak ja(n)t vajaae vaajeh jit bhaavai tit raeh chalieeaa ||8||2||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, we are the instruments upon which He plays; as He wills, so is the path we take. ||8||2||5||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh agam agochar dhiaaiaa hau bal bal satigur sat purakhieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the True Guru, the True Primal Being.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam merai praan vasaae satigur paras har naam samieeaa ||1||
verses.translation: He has brought the Lord's Name to dwell upon my breath of life; meeting with the True Guru, I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: jan kee Tek har naam Tikieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the only Support of His humble servants.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee dhar laagaa jaavaa gur kirapaa te har dhar laheeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I shall live under the protection of the True Guru. By Guru's Grace, I shall attain the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਥਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih sareer karam kee dharatee gurmukh math math tat kaddieeaa ||
verses.translation: This body is the field of karma; the Gurmukhs plow and work it, and harvest the essence.

verses.original: ਲਾਲੁ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਅਈਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laal javehar naam pragaasiaa bhaa(n)ddai bhaau pavai tit ieeaa ||2||
verses.translation: The priceless jewel of the Naam becomes manifest, and it pours into their vessels of love. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਜ ਭਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhaasan dhaas dhaas hoi raheeaai jo jan raam bhagat nij bhieeaa ||
verses.translation: Become the slave of the slave of the slave, of that humble being who has become the devotee of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਈਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man budh arap dharau gur aagai gur parasaadhee mai akath kathieeaa ||3||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind and intellect, and place them in offering before my Guru; by Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਤਿਖਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh maiaa moh viaape ih man tirasanaa jalat tikhieeaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in attachment to Maya; their minds are thirsty, burning with desire.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਈਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmat naam a(n)mirat jal paiaa agan bujhee gur sabadh bujhieeaa ||4||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, and the fire has been put out. The Word of the Guru's Shabad has put it out. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੂਰ ਵਜਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih man naachai satigur aagai anahadh sabadh dhun toor vajieeaa ||
verses.translation: This mind dances before the True Guru. The unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds, vibrating the celestial melody.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: har har usatat karai dhin raatee rakh rakh charan har taal poorieeaa ||5||
verses.translation: I praise the Lord, day and night, moving my feet to the beat of the drum. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: har kai ra(n)g rataa man gaavai ras rasaal ras sabadh ravieeaa ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, my mind sings His Praise, joyfully chanting the Shabad, the source of nectar and bliss.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: nij ghar dhaar chuaai at niramal jin peeaa tin hee sukh laheeaa ||6||
verses.translation: The stream of immaculate purity flows through the home of the self within; one who drinks it in, finds peace. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਉਸਰਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh karam karai abhimaanee jiau baalak baaloo ghar usarieeaa ||
verses.translation: The stubborn-minded, egotistical, proud-minded person performs rituals, but these are like sand castles built by children.

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aavai lahar samu(n)dh saagar kee khin meh bhi(n)n bhi(n)n ddeh pieeaa ||7||
verses.translation: When the waves of the ocean come in, they crumble and dissolve in an instant. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: har sar saagar har hai aape ih jag hai sabh khel khelieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the pool, and the Lord Himself is the ocean; this world is all a play which He has staged.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
verses.translit: jiau jal tara(n)g jal jaleh samaaveh naanak aape aap ramieeaa ||8||3||6||
verses.translation: As the waves of water merge into the water again, O Nanak, so does He merge into Himself. ||8||3||6||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur parachai man mu(n)dhraa paiee gur kaa sabadh tan bhasam dhiraRieeaa ||
verses.translation: My mind wears the ear-rings of the True Guru's acquaintance; I apply the ashes of the Word of the Guru's Shabad to my body.

verses.original: ਅਮਰ ਪਿੰਡ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: amar pi(n)dd bhe saadhoo sa(n)g janam maran dhouoo miT gieeaa ||1||
verses.translation: My body has become immortal, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Both birth and death have come to an end for me. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mere man saadhasa(n)gat mil raheeaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remain united with the Saadh Sangat.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧਉ ਮੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa karahu madhasoodhan maadhau mai khin khin saadhoo charan pakhieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Be merciful to me, O Lord; each and every instant, let me wash the Feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਜੈ ਗਿਰਸਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: tajai girasat bhiaa ban vaasee ik khin manooaa Tikai na Tikieeaa ||
verses.translation: Forsaking family life, he wanders in the forest, but his mind does not remain at rest, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਤਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhaavat dhai tadhe ghar aavai har har saadhoo saran pavieeaa ||2||
verses.translation: The wandering mind returns home, only when it seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy people. ||2||

verses.original: ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheeaa poot chhodd sa(n)niaasee aasaa aas man bahut karieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Sannyaasi renounces his daughters and sons, but his mind still conjures up all sorts of hopes and desires.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aasaa aas karai nahee boojhai gur kai sabadh niraas sukh laheeaa ||3||
verses.translation: With these hopes and desires, he still does not understand, that only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad does one become free of desires, and find peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਉਪਜੀ ਤਰਕ ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: aupajee tarak dhiga(n)bar hoaa man dheh dhis chal chal gavan karieeaa ||
verses.translation: When detachment from the world wells up within, he become a naked hermit, but still, his mind roams, wanders and rambles in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਵਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: prabhavan karai boojhai nahee tirasanaa mil sa(n)g saadh dhiaa ghar laheeaa ||4||
verses.translation: He wanders around, but his desires are not satisfied; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds the house of kindness and compassion. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਸਣ ਸਿਧ ਸਿਖਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚੇਟਕ ਚੇਟਕਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: aasan sidh sikheh bahutere man maageh ridh sidh cheTak cheTakieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas learn many Yogis postures, but their minds still yearn for riches, miraculous powers and energy.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tirapat sa(n)tokh man saa(n)t na aavai mil saadhoo tirapat har naam sidh pieeaa ||5||
verses.translation: Satisfaction, contentment and tranquility do not come to their minds; but meeting the Holy Saints, they are satisfied, and through the Name of the Lord, spiritual perfection is attained. ||5||

verses.original: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)ddaj jeraj setaj utabhuj sabh varan roop jeea ja(n)t upieeaa ||
verses.translation: Life is born from the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; God created the beings and creatures of all colors and forms.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ਚੰਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saadhoo saran parai so ubarai khatree braahaman soodh vais cha(n)ddaal cha(n)ddieeaa ||6||
verses.translation: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is saved, whether he is a Kh'shaatriya, a Brahmin, a Soodra, a Vaishya or the most untouchable of the untouchables. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕੰਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਅਉਜਾਤਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਿਆਰੁ ਚਮਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: naamaa jaidheau ka(n)beer tiralochan aaujaat ravidhaas chamiaar chamieeaa ||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the low-caste leather-worker,

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਸੈਣੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਈਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jo jo milai saadhoo jan sa(n)gat dhan dha(n)naa jaT sain miliaa har dhieeaa ||7||
verses.translation: blessed Dhanna and Sain; all those who joined the humble Saadh Sangat, met the Merciful Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee har paij rakhaiee bhagat vachhal a(n)geekaar karieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord protects the honor of His humble servants; He is the Lover of His devotees - He makes them His own.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਈਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak saran pare jagajeevan har har kirapaa dhaar rakhieeaa ||8||4||7||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Life of the world, who has showered His Mercy upon him, and saved him. ||8||||4||7||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਉਠੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਤੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar piaas uThee prabh keree sun gur bachan man teer lagieeaa ||
verses.translation: The thirst for God has welled up deep within me; hearing the Word of the Guru's Teachings, my mind is pierced by His arrow.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man kee birathaa man hee jaanai avar k jaanai ko peer parieeaa ||1||
verses.translation: The pain of my mind is known only to my own mind; who can know the pain of another? ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: raam gur mohan moh man lieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Guru, the Enticer, has enticed my mind.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਆਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਉ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਹੋਇ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau aakal bikal bhiee gur dhekhe hau loT poT hoi pieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am stunned and amazed, gazing upon my Guru; I have entered the realm of wonder and bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਫਿਰਉ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau nirakhat firau sabh dhes dhisa(n)tar mai prabh dhekhan ko bahut man chieeaa ||
verses.translation: I wander around, exploring all lands and foreign countries; within my mind, I have such a great longing to see my God.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਈਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man tan kaaT dheau gur aagai jin har prabh maarag pa(n)th dhikhieeaa ||2||
verses.translation: I sacrifice my mind and body to the Guru, who has shown me the Way, the Path to my Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਸਦੇਸਾ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: koiee aan sadhesaa dhei prabh keraa ridh a(n)tar man tan meeTh lagieeaa ||
verses.translation: If only someone would bring me news of God; He seems so sweet to my heart, mind and body.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: masatak kaaT dheau charanaa tal jo har prabh mele mel milieeaa ||3||
verses.translation: I would cut off my head and place it under the feet of that one who leads me to meet and unite with my Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਲੁ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: chal chal sakhee ham prabh parabodheh gun kaaman kar har prabh laheeaa ||
verses.translation: Let us go, O my companions, and understand our God; with the spell of virtue, let us obtain our Lord God.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਈਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal uaa ko naam kaheeat hai saran prabhoo tis paachhai pieeaa ||4||
verses.translation: He is called the Lover of His devotees; let us follow in the footsteps of those who seek God's Sanctuary. ||4||

verses.original: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: khimaa seegaar kare prabh khuseeaa man dheepak gur giaan balieeaa ||
verses.translation: If the soul-bride adorns herself with compassion and forgiveness, God is pleased, and her mind is illumined with the lamp of the Guru's wisdom.

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ras ras bhog kare prabh meraa ham tis aagai jeeau kaT kaT pieeaa ||5||
verses.translation: With happiness and ecstasy, my God enjoys her; I offer each and every bit of my soul to Him. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਹੈ ਬਨਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀਚੂਰੁ ਵਡ ਗਹਨ ਗਹਨਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har haar ka(n)Th hai baniaa man moteechoor vadd gahan gahanieeaa ||
verses.translation: I have made the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my necklace; my mind tinged with devotion is the intricate ornament of crowning glory.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਈਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har har saradhaa sej vichhaiee prabh chhodd na sakai bahut man bhieeaa ||6||
verses.translation: I have spread out my bed of faith in the Lord, Har, Har. I cannot abandon Him - my mind is filled with such a great love for Him. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਫੋਕਟ ਫੋਕਟਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahai prabh avar avar kichh keejai sabh baadh seegaar fokaT fokaTieeaa ||
verses.translation: If God says one thing, and the soul-bride does something else, then all her decorations are useless and false.

verses.original: ਕੀਓ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੀਓ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: keeo seegaar milan kai taiee prabh leeo suhaagan thook mukh pieeaa ||7||
verses.translation: She may adorn herself to meet her Husband Lord, but still, only the virtuous soul-bride meets God, and the other's face is spat upon. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: ham cheree too agam gusaiee kiaa ham kareh terai vas pieeaa ||
verses.translation: I am Your hand-maiden, O Inaccessible Lord of the Universe; what can I do by myself? I am under Your power.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੮॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dheen karahu rakh levahu naanak har gur saran samieeaa ||8||5||8||
verses.translation: Be merciful, Lord, to the meek, and save them; Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, and the Guru. ||8||5||8||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan prem agam Thaakur kaa khin khin saradhaa man bahut uThieeaa ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are filled with love for my Inaccessible Lord and Master. Each and every instant, I am filled with immense faith and devotion.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur dhekhe saradhaa man pooree jiau chaatirak priau priau boo(n)dh mukh pieeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Guru, my mind's faith is fulfilled, like the song-bird, which cries and cries, until the rain-drop falls into its mouth. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil mil sakhee har kathaa sunieeaa ||
verses.translation: Join with me, join with me, O my companions, and teach me the Sermon of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhiaa kare prabh mele mai tis aagai sir kaT kaT pieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has mercifully united me with God. Cutting off my head, and chopping it into pieces, I offer it to Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਇਕ ਬੇਦਨ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: rom rom man tan ik bedhan mai prabh dhekhe bin needh na pieeaa ||
verses.translation: Each and every hair on my head, and my mind and body, suffer the pains of separation; without seeing my God, I cannot sleep.

verses.original: ਬੈਦਕ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: baidhak naaTik dhekh bhulaane mai hiradhai man tan prem peer lagieeaa ||2||
verses.translation: The doctors and healers look at me, and are perplexed. Within my heart, mind and body, I feel the pain of divine love. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau khin pal reh na sakau bin preetam jiau bin amalai amalee mar gieeaa ||
verses.translation: I cannot live for a moment, for even an instant, without my Beloved, like the opium addict who cannot live without opium.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦੁਈਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin kau piaas hoi prabh keree tin(h) avar na bhaavai bin har ko dhuieeaa ||3||
verses.translation: Those who thirst for God, do not love any other. Without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: koiee aan aan meraa prabhoo milaavai hau tis viTahu bal bal ghum gieeaa ||
verses.translation: If only someone would come and unite me with God; I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to him.

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: anek janam ke vichhuRe jan mele jaa sat sat satigur saran pavieeaa ||4||
verses.translation: After being separated from the Lord for countless incarnations, I am re-united with Him, entering the Sanctuary of the True, True, True Guru. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sej ek eko prabh Thaakur mahal na paavai manmukh bharamieeaa ||
verses.translation: There is one bed for the soul-bride, and the same bed for God, her Lord and Master. The self-willed manmukh does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; she wanders around, in limbo.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਢੀਲ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur gur karat saran je aavai prabh aai milai khin ddeel na pieeaa ||5||
verses.translation: Uttering, ""Guru, Guru"", she seeks His Sanctuary; so God comes to meet her, without a moment's delay. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਵਧਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਪਟ ਲੋਭਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar kiriaachaar vadhaae man paakha(n)dd karam kapaT lobhieeaa ||
verses.translation: One may perform many rituals, but the mind is filled with hypocrisy, evil deeds and greed.

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟਾ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਪਿਤਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਈਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: besuaa kai ghar beTaa janamiaa pitaa taeh kiaa naam sadhieeaa ||6||
verses.translation: When a son is born in the house of a prostitute, who can tell the name of his father? ||6||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorab janam bhagat kar aae gur har har har har bhagat jamieeaa ||
verses.translation: Because of devotional worship in my past incarnations, I have been born into this life. The Guru has inspired me to worship the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhagat karate har paiaa jaa har har har har naam samieeaa ||7||
verses.translation: Worshipping, worshipping Him with devotion, I found the Lord, and then I merged into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||7||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਆਣਿ ਮਹਿੰਦੀ ਪੀਸਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh aan aan mahi(n)dhee peesaiee aape ghol ghol a(n)g lieeaa ||
verses.translation: God Himself came and ground the henna leaves into powder, and applied it to my body.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਢਿ ਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੨॥੧॥੬॥੯॥
verses.translit: jin kau Thaakur kirapaa dhaaree baeh pakar naanak kadd lieeaa ||8||6||2||1||6||9||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master showers His Mercy upon us, and grasps hold of our arms; O Nanak, He lifts us up and saves us. ||8||6||9||2||1||6||9||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੨
verses.translit: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadhee ghar baarvaa
verses.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Twelfth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aupamaa jaat na kahee mere prabh kee upamaa jaat na kahee ||
verses.translation: I cannot express the Praises of my God; I cannot express His Praises.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taj aan saran gahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have abandoned all others, seeking His Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: prabh charan kamal apaar ||
verses.translation: God's Lotus Feet are Infinite.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hau jaau sadh balihaar ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to Them.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: man preet laagee taeh ||
verses.translation: My mind is in love with Them.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taj aan kateh na jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: If I were to abandon Them, there is nowhere else I could go. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਨ ॥
verses.translit: har naam rasanaa kahan ||
verses.translation: I chant the Lord's Name with my tongue.

verses.original: ਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਕਲਮਲ ਦਹਨ ॥
verses.translit: mal paap kalamal dhahan ||
verses.translation: The filth of my sins and evil mistakes is burnt off.

verses.original: ਚੜਿ ਨਾਵ ਸੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: chaR naav sa(n)t udhaar ||
verses.translation: Climbing aboard the Boat of the Saints, I am emancipated.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhai tare saagar paar ||2||
verses.translation: I have been carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਡੋਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: man ddor prem pareet ||
verses.translation: My mind is tied to the Lord with the string of love and devotion.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: eeh sa(n)t niramal reet ||
verses.translation: This is the Immaculate Way of the Saints.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: taj ge paap bikaar ||
verses.translation: They forsake sin and corruption.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har mile prabh nira(n)kaar ||3||
verses.translation: They meet the Formless Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: prabh pekheeaai bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon God, I am wonderstruck.

verses.original: ਚਖਿ ਅਨਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: chakh anadh pooran saadh ||
verses.translation: I taste the Perfect Flavor of Bliss.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਡੋਲੀਐ ਇਤ ਊਤ ॥
verses.translit: neh ddoleeaai it uoot ||
verses.translation: I do not waver or wander here or there.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਤ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: prabh base har har cheet ||4||
verses.translation: The Lord God, Har, Har, dwells within my consciousness. ||4||

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥ ਨਿਤ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h) naeh narak nivaas || nit simar prabh gunataas ||
verses.translation: Those who constantly remember God, the treasure of virtue, will never go to hell.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਨੈਨ ॥ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬੈਨ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: te jam na pekheh nain || sun mohe anahat bain ||5||
verses.translation: Those who listen, fascinated, to the Unstruck Sound-Current of the Word, will never have to see the Messenger of Death with their eyes. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: har saran soor gupaal ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Heroic Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਗਤ ਵਸਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bhagat vas dhiaal ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord God is under the power of His devotees.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਗਮ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਭੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: har nigam laheh na bhev ||
verses.translation: The Vedas do not know the Mystery of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: nit kareh mun jan sev ||6||
verses.translation: The silent sages constantly serve Him. ||6||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh dheen dharadh nivaar ||
verses.translation: He is the Destroyer of the pains and sorrows of the poor.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੜੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee mahaa bikhaRee kaar ||
verses.translation: It is so very difficult to serve Him.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee mit na jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: No one knows His limits.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal soi ||7||
verses.translation: He is pervading the water, the land and the sky. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਲਖ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kar ba(n)dhanaa lakh baar ||
verses.translation: Hundreds of thousands of times, I humbly bow to Him.

verses.original: ਥਕਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: thak pario prabh dharabaar ||
verses.translation: I have grown weary, and I have collapsed at God's Door.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh karahu saadhoo dhoor ||
verses.translation: O God, make me the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak manasaa poor ||8||1||
verses.translation: Please fulfill this, Nanak's wish. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh janam maran nivaar ||
verses.translation: God, please release me from birth and death.

verses.original: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: haar pario dhuaar ||
verses.translation: I have grown weary, and collapsed at Your door.

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: geh charan saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: I grasp Your Feet, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਿਸਟ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: man misaT har har ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The Love of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet to my mind.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਲੇਹੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kar dhiaa leh laR lai ||
verses.translation: Be Merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanakaa naam dhiaai ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath dhiaal mere suaamee dheenaa naath dhiaal ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Master of the meek, You are my Lord and Master, O Merciful Master of the meek.

verses.original: ਜਾਚਉ ਸੰਤ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaachau sa(n)t ravaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I yearn for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar bikhiaa koop ||
verses.translation: The world is a pit of poison,

verses.original: ਤਮ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮੋਹਤ ਘੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: tam agiaan mohat ghoop ||
verses.translation: filled with the utter darkness of ignorance and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: geh bhujaa prabh jee leh ||
verses.translation: Please take my hand, and save me, Dear God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naam apunaa dheh ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Name, Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh tujh binaa nahee Thaau ||
verses.translation: Without You, God, I have no place at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanakaa bal bal jaau ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||2||

verses.original: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਧੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: lobh moh baadhee dheh ||
verses.translation: The human body is in the grip of greed and attachment.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਖੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhajan hovat kheh ||
verses.translation: Without meditating and vibrating upon the Lord, it is reduced to ashes.

verses.original: ਜਮਦੂਤ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: jamadhoot mahaa bhiaan ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death is dreadful and horrible.

verses.original: ਚਿਤ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: chit gupat karameh jaan ||
verses.translation: The recording scribes of the conscious and the unconscious, Chitr and Gupt, know all actions and karma.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhin rain saakh sunai ||
verses.translation: Day and night, they bear witness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanakaa har saranai ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bha(n)janaa muraar ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Destroyer of fear and egotism,

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar dhiaa patit udhaar ||
verses.translation: be merciful, and save the sinners.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere dhokh gane na jaeh ||
verses.translation: My sins cannot even be counted.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਤਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har binaa kateh samaeh ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, who can hide them?

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਓਟ ਚਿਤਵੀ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: geh oT chitavee naath ||
verses.translation: I thought of Your Support, and seized it, O my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੇ ਰਖੁ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanakaa dhe rakh haath ||4||
verses.translation: Please, give Nanak Your hand and save him, Lord! ||4||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: har gun nidhe gopaal ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of the world,

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sarab ghaT pratipaal ||
verses.translation: cherishes and sustains every heart.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: man preet dharasan piaas ||
verses.translation: My mind is thirsty for Your Love, and the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh pooran aas ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the Universe, please fulfill my hopes.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik nimakh rahan na jai ||
verses.translation: I cannot survive, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: vadd bhaag naanak pai ||5||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, Nanak has found the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: prabh tujh binaa nahee hor ||
verses.translation: Without You, God, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: man preet cha(n)dh chakor ||
verses.translation: My mind loves You, as the partridge loves the moon,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau meen jal siau het ||
verses.translation: as the fish loves the water,

verses.original: ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਭਿੰਨੁ ਨ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: al kamal bhi(n)n na bhet ||
verses.translation: as the bee and the lotus cannot be separated.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: jiau chakavee sooraj aas ||
verses.translation: As the chakvi bird longs for the sun,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak charan piaas ||6||
verses.translation: so does Nanak thirst for the Lord's feet. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤਰੁਨਿ ਭਰਤ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jiau tarun bharat paraan ||
verses.translation: As the young bride places the hopes of her life in her husband,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਭੀਐ ਧਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau lobheeaai dhan dhaan ||
verses.translation: as the greedy person looks upon the gift of wealth,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਦੂਧ ਜਲਹਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau dhoodh jaleh sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: as milk is joined to water,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਖੁਧਿਆਰਥ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau mahaa khudhiaarath bhog ||
verses.translation: as food is to the very hungry man,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤ ਪੂਤਹਿ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau maat pooteh het ||
verses.translation: and as the mother loves her son,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੇਤ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har simar naanak net ||7||
verses.translation: so does Nanak constantly remember the Lord in meditation. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਦੀਪ ਪਤਨ ਪਤੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: jiau dheep patan pata(n)g ||
verses.translation: As the moth falls into the lamp,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਚੋਰੁ ਹਿਰਤ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: jiau chor hirat nisa(n)g ||
verses.translation: as the thief steals without hesitation,

verses.original: ਮੈਗਲਹਿ ਕਾਮੈ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: maigaleh kaamai ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: as the elephant is trapped by its sexual urges,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਬਿਖਈ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau grasat bikhiee dha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: as the sinner is caught in his sins,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜੂਆਰ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jooaar bisan na jai ||
verses.translation: as the gambler's addiction does not leave him,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: har naanak ih man lai ||8||
verses.translation: so is this mind of Nanak's attached to the Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦੈ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kura(n)k naadhai neh ||
verses.translation: As the deer loves the sound of the bell,

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਚਾਹਤ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaatirak chaahat meh ||
verses.translation: and as the song-bird longs for the rain,

verses.original: ਜਨ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: jan jeevanaa satasa(n)g ||
verses.translation: the Lord's humble servant lives in the Society of the Saints,

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਭਜਨਾ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh bhajanaa ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: lovingly meditating and vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa bakhaanai naam ||
verses.translation: My tongue chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak dharasan dhaan ||9||
verses.translation: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||9||

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਸੁਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun gai sun likh dhei ||
verses.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and hears them, and writes them,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: so sarab fal har lei ||
verses.translation: receives all fruits and rewards from the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਕਰਤ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kul samooh karat udhaar ||
verses.translation: He saves all his ancestors and generations,

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar utaras paar ||
verses.translation: and crosses over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har charan bohith taeh ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Feet are the boat to carry him across.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)g jas gaeh ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har paij rakhai muraar ||
verses.translation: The Lord protects his honor.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
verses.translit: har naanak saran dhuaar ||10||2||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's door. ||10||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਥਿਤੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਜਤਿ
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa thitee ghar dasvaa jat
verses.translation: Bilaaval, First Mehla, T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days, Tenth House, To The Drum-Beat Jat:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ekam eka(n)kaar niraalaa ||
verses.translation: The First Day: The One Universal Creator is unique,

verses.original: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: amar ajonee jaat na jaalaa ||
verses.translation: immortal, unborn, beyond social class or involvement.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar roop na rekhiaa ||
verses.translation: He is inaccessible and unfathomable, with no form or feature.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat ghaT ghaT dhekhiaa ||
verses.translation: Searching, searching, I have seen Him in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhekh dhikhaavai tis kau bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to one who sees, and inspires others to see Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh param padh paiee ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa jap jaapau bin jagadheesai ||
verses.translation: Whose Name should I chant, and meditate on, except the Lord of the Universe?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh mahal ghar dheesai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed within the home of one's own heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai lage pachhutaane ||
verses.translation: The Second Day: Those who are in love with another, come to regret and repent.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jam dhar baadhe aavan jaane ||
verses.translation: The are tied up at Death's door, and continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa lai aaveh kiaa le jaeh ||
verses.translation: What have they brought, and what will they take with them when they go?

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sir jamakaal s choTaa khaeh ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death looms over their heads, and they endure his beating.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh na chhooTas koi ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one finds release.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੑੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd keen(h)ai mukat na hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Practicing hypocrisy, no one finds liberation. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape sach keeaa kar joR ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself created the universe, joining the elements together.

verses.original: ਅੰਡਜ ਫੋੜਿ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)ddaj foR joR vichhoR ||
verses.translation: Breaking the cosmic egg, He united, and separated.

verses.original: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਕੀਏ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharat akaas ke'ee baisan kau thaau ||
verses.translation: He made the earth and the sky into places to live.

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਕੀਏ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raat dhina(n)t ke'ee bhau bhaau ||
verses.translation: He created day and night, fear and love.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin ke'ee kar vekhanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: The One who created the Creation, also watches over it.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: avar na dhoojaa sirajanahaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: There is no other Creator Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tirateeaa brahamaa bisan mahesaa ||
verses.translation: The Third Day: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,

verses.original: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhevee dhev upaae vesaa ||
verses.translation: the gods, goddesses and various manifestations.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜਾਤੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jotee jaatee ganat na aavai ||
verses.translation: The lights and forms cannot be counted.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin saajee so keemat paavai ||
verses.translation: The One who fashioned them, knows their value.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: keemat pai rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: He evaluates them, and totally pervades them.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kis neRai kis aakhaa dhoor ||4||
verses.translation: Who is close, and who is far away? ||4||

verses.original: ਚਉਥਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: chauth upaae chaare bedhaa ||
verses.translation: The Fourth Day: He created the four Vedas,

verses.original: ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ਬਾਣੀ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: khaanee chaare baanee bhedhaa ||
verses.translation: the four sources of creation, and distinct forms of speech.

verses.original: ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਖਟੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: asaT dhasaa khaT teen upaae ||
verses.translation: He created the eighteen Puraanas, the six Shaastras and the three qualities.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: so boojhai jis aap bujhaae ||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: teen samaavai chauthai vaasaa ||
verses.translation: One who overcomes the three qualities, dwells in the fourth state.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak ham taa ke dhaasaa ||5||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am his slave. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੰਚਮੀ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)chamee pa(n)ch bhoot betaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Fifth Day: The five elements are demons.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap agochar purakh niraalaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is unfathomable and detached.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik bhram bhookhe moh piaase ||
verses.translation: Some are gripped by doubt, hunger, emotional attachment and desire.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik ras chaakh sabadh tirapataase ||
verses.translation: Some taste the sublime essence of the Shabad, and are satisfied.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik ra(n)g raate ik mar dhoor ||
verses.translation: Some are imbued with the Lord's Love, while some die, and are reduced to dust.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eik dhar ghar saachai dhekh hadhoor ||6||
verses.translation: Some attain the Court and the Mansion of the True Lord, and behold Him, ever-present. ||6||

verses.original: ਝੂਠੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThe kau naahee pat naau ||
verses.translation: The false one has no honor or fame;

verses.original: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਕਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kabahu na soochaa kaalaa kaau ||
verses.translation: like the black crow, he never becomes pure.

verses.original: ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਬੰਧਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: pi(n)jar pa(n)khee ba(n)dhiaa koi ||
verses.translation: He is like the bird, imprisoned in a cage;

verses.original: ਛੇਰੀਂ ਭਰਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chheree(n) bharamai mukat na hoi ||
verses.translation: he paces back and forth behind the bars, but he is not released.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tau chhooTai jaa khasam chhaddaae ||
verses.translation: He alone is emancipated, whom the Lord and Master emancipates.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmat mele bhagat dhiraRaae ||7||
verses.translation: He follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines devotional worship. ||7||

verses.original: ਖਸਟੀ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: khasaTee khaT dharasan prabh saaje ||
verses.translation: The Sixth Day: God organized the six systems of Yoga.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਵਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh sabadh niraalaa vaaje ||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates of itself.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je prabh bhaavai taa mahal bulaavai ||
verses.translation: If God wills it so, then one is summoned to the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਭੇਦੇ ਤਉ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe bhedhe tau pat paavai ||
verses.translation: One who is pierced through by the Shabad, obtains honor.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਖਪਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar ves khapeh jal jaaveh ||
verses.translation: Those who wear religious robes burn, and are ruined.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: saachai saache saach samaaveh ||8||
verses.translation: Through Truth, the truthful ones merge into the True Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਪਤਮੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sapatamee sat sa(n)tokh sareer ||
verses.translation: The Seventh Day: When the body is imbued with Truth and contentment,

verses.original: ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਭਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨੀਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saat samu(n)dh bhare niramal neer ||
verses.translation: the seven seas within are filled with the Immaculate Water.

verses.original: ਮਜਨੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: majan seel sach ridhai veechaar ||
verses.translation: Bathing in good conduct, and contemplating the True Lord within the heart,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh paavai sabh paar ||
verses.translation: one obtains the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and carries everyone across.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਉ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man saachaa mukh saachau bhai ||
verses.translation: With the True Lord in the mind, and the True Lord lovingly on one's lips,

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sach neesaanai Thaak na pai ||9||
verses.translation: one is blessed with the banner of Truth, and meets with no obstructions. ||9||

verses.original: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਧੈ ॥
verses.translit: asaTamee asaT sidh budh saadhai ||
verses.translation: The Eighth Day: The eight miraculous powers come when one subdues his own mind,

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਅਰਾਧੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach nihakeval karam araadhai ||
verses.translation: and contemplates the True Lord through pure actions.

verses.original: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਬਿਸਰਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee aganee bisaraau ||
verses.translation: Forget the three qualities of wind, water and fire,

verses.original: ਤਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tahee nira(n)jan saacho naau ||
verses.translation: and concentrate on the pure True Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis meh manooaa rahiaa liv lai ||
verses.translation: That human who remains lovingly focused on the Lord,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak kaal na khai ||10||
verses.translation: prays Nanak, shall not be consumed by death. ||10||

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੇ ਨਾਥ ਨਵ ਖੰਡਾ ॥ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਲਵੰਡਾ ॥
verses.translit: naau naumee nave naath nav kha(n)ddaa || ghaT ghaT naath mahaa balava(n)ddaa ||
verses.translation: The Ninth Day: The Name is the supreme almighty Master of the nine masters of Yoga, the nine realms of the earth, and each and every heart.

verses.original: ਆਈ ਪੂਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaiee pootaa ih jag saaraa ||
verses.translation: This whole world is the child of Maya.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh aadhes aadh rakhavaaraa ||
verses.translation: I bow in submission to God, my Protector from the very beginning of time.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee hai bhee hog ||
verses.translation: He was in the beginning, He has been throughout the ages, He is now, and He shall always be.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: oh apara(n)par karanai jog ||11||
verses.translation: He is unlimited, and capable of doing everything. ||11||

verses.original: ਦਸਮੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhasamee naam dhaan isanaan ||
verses.translation: The Tenth Day: Meditate on the Naam, give to charity, and purify yourself.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin majan sachaa gun giaan ||
verses.translation: Night and day, bathe in spiritual wisdom and the Glorious Virtues of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach mail na laagai bhram bhau bhaagai ||
verses.translation: Truth cannot be polluted; doubt and fear run away from it.

verses.original: ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਕਾਚੈ ਤਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: bilam na tooTas kaachai taagai ||
verses.translation: The flimsy thread breaks in an instant.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤਾਗਾ ਜਗੁ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau taagaa jag evai jaanahu ||
verses.translation: Know that the world is just like this thread.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਹੁ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: asathir cheet saach ra(n)g maanahu ||12||
verses.translation: Your consciousness shall become steady and stable, enjoying the Love of the True Lord. ||12||

verses.original: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਇਕੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ekaadhasee ik ridhai vasaavai ||
verses.translation: The Eleventh Day: Enshrine the One Lord within your heart.

verses.original: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hi(n)saa mamataa moh chukaavai ||
verses.translation: Eradicate cruelty, egotism and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: fal paavai brat aatam cheenai ||
verses.translation: Earn the fruitful rewards, by observing the fast of knowing your own self.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਤਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd raach tat nahee beenai ||
verses.translation: One who is engrossed in hypocrisy, does not see the true essence.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: niramal niraahaar nihakeval ||
verses.translation: The Lord is immaculate, self-sustaining and unattached.

verses.original: ਸੂਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਲੁ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: soochai saache naa laagai mal ||13||
verses.translation: The Pure, True Lord cannot be polluted. ||13||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਏਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhau teh eko ekaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the One Lord there.

verses.original: ਹੋਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਕੋ ਵੇਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: hor jeea upaae veko vekaa ||
verses.translation: He created the other beings, of many and various kinds.

verses.original: ਫਲੋਹਾਰ ਕੀਏ ਫਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: falohaar ke'ee fal jai ||
verses.translation: Eating only fruits, one loses the fruits of life.

verses.original: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਏ ਸਾਦੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ras kas khaae saadh gavai ||
verses.translation: Eating only delicacies of various sorts, one loses the true taste.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਪਟੈ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kooRai laalach lapaTai lapaTai ||
verses.translation: In fraud and greed, people are engrossed and entangled.

verses.original: ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: chhooTai gurmukh saach kamai ||14||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is emancipated, practicing Truth. ||14||

verses.original: ਦੁਆਦਸਿ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhuaadhas mudhraa man aaudhootaa ||
verses.translation: The Twelfth Day: One whose mind is not attached to the twelve signs,

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis jaageh kabeh na sootaa ||
verses.translation: remains awake day and night, and never sleeps.

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat jaag rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: He remains awake and aware, lovingly centered on the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parachai tis kaal na khai ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Guru, he is not consumed by death.

verses.original: ਅਤੀਤ ਭਏ ਮਾਰੇ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ateet bhe maare bairaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who become detached, and conquer the five enemies

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਹ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak teh liv laiee ||15||
verses.translation: - prays Nanak, they are lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||15||

verses.original: ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhuaadhasee dhiaa dhaan kar jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Twelfth Day: Know, and practice, compassion and charity.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤੋ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: baahar jaato bheetar aanai ||
verses.translation: Bring your out-going mind back home.

verses.original: ਬਰਤੀ ਬਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: baratee barat rahai nihakaam ||
verses.translation: Observe the fast of remaining free of desire.

verses.original: ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ajapaa jaap japai mukh naam ||
verses.translation: Chant the unchanted Chant of the Naam with your mouth.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: teen bhavan meh eko jaanai ||
verses.translation: Know that the One Lord is contained in the three worlds.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: sabh such sa(n)jam saach pachhaanai ||16||
verses.translation: Purity and self-discipline are all contained in knowing the Truth. ||16||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਸਿ ਤਰਵਰ ਸਮੁਦ ਕਨਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: teras taravar samudh kanaarai ||
verses.translation: The Thirteenth Day: He is like a tree on the sea-shore.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਿਖਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit mool sikhar liv taarai ||
verses.translation: But his roots can become immortal, if his mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਡਰ ਡਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬੂਡੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ddar ddar marai na booddai koi ||
verses.translation: Then, he will not die of fear or anxiety, and he will never drown.

verses.original: ਨਿਡਰੁ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: niddar boodd marai pat khoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, he drowns and dies, and loses his honor.

verses.original: ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: ddar meh ghar ghar meh ddar jaanai ||
verses.translation: With the Fear of God in his heart, and his heart in the Fear of God, he knows God.

verses.original: ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: takhat nivaas sach man bhaanai ||17||
verses.translation: He sits on the throne, and becomes pleasing to the Mind of the True Lord. ||17||

verses.original: ਚਉਦਸਿ ਚਉਥੇ ਥਾਵਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: chaudhas chauthe thaaveh leh paavai ||
verses.translation: The Fourteenth Day: One who enters into the fourth state,

verses.original: ਰਾਜਸ ਤਾਮਸ ਸਤ ਕਾਲ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: raajas taamas sat kaal samaavai ||
verses.translation: overcomes time, and the three qualities of raajas, taamas and satva.

verses.original: ਸਸੀਅਰ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saseear kai ghar soor samaavai ||
verses.translation: Then the sun enters into the house of the moon,

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jog jugat kee keemat paavai ||
verses.translation: and one knows the value of the technology of Yoga.

verses.original: ਚਉਦਸਿ ਭਵਨ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਸਮਾਏ ॥ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: chaudhas bhavan paataal samaae || kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd rahiaa liv laae ||18||
verses.translation: He remains lovingly focused on God, who is permeating the fourteen worlds, the nether regions of the underworld, the galaxies and solar systems. ||18||

verses.original: ਅਮਾਵਸਿਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਗੈਣਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: amaavasiaa cha(n)dh gupat gainaar ||
verses.translation: Amaavas - The Night of the New Moon: The moon is hidden in the sky.

verses.original: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: boojhahu giaanee sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: O wise one, understand and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਗਗਨਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saseear gagan jot tih loiee ||
verses.translation: The moon in the sky illuminates the three worlds.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar vekhai karataa soiee ||
verses.translation: Creating the creation, the Creator beholds it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur te dheesai so tis hee maeh ||
verses.translation: One who sees, through the Guru, merges into Him.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhoole aaveh jaeh ||19||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, coming and going in reincarnation. ||19||

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar dhar thaap thir thaan suhaavai ||
verses.translation: One who establishes his home within his own heart, obtains the most beautiful, permanent place.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaanai jaa satigur paavai ||
verses.translation: One comes to understand his own self, when he finds the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਆਸਾ ਤਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh aasaa teh binas binaasaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever there is hope, there is destruction and desolation.

verses.original: ਫੂਟੈ ਖਪਰੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: fooTai khapar dhubidhaa manasaa ||
verses.translation: The bowl of duality and selfishness breaks.

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥ ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
verses.translit: mamataa jaal te rahai udhaasaa || pranavat naanak ham taa ke dhaasaa ||20||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of that one, who remains detached amidst the traps of attachment. ||20||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਵਾਰ ਸਤ ਘਰੁ ੧੦
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa vaar sat ghar dasvaa
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehla, The Seven Days, Tenth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਦਿਤ ਵਾਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aadhit vaar aadh purakh hai soiee ||
verses.translation: Sunday: He, the Lord, is the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape varatai avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Pervading Lord; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਰੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ot pot jag rahiaa paroiee ||
verses.translation: Through and through, He is woven into the fabric of the world.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa karai su hoiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator Himself does, that alone happens.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate sadhaa sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is forever in peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh viralaa boojhai koiee ||1||
verses.translation: But how rare is the one, who, as Gurmukh, understands this. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਨੀ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai japanee japau gunataasaa ||
verses.translation: Within my heart, I chant the Chant of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har agam agochar apara(n)par suaamee jan pag lag dhiaavau hoi dhaasan dhaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, my Lord and Master, is inaccessible, unfathomable and unlimited. Grasping the feet of the Lord's humble servants, I meditate on Him, and become the slave of His slaves. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋਮਵਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: somavaar sach rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: Monday: The True Lord is permeating and pervading.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee keemat kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: His value cannot be described.

verses.original: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aakh aakh rahe sabh liv lai ||
verses.translation: Talking and speaking about Him, all keep themselves lovingly focused on Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhevai tis palai pai ||
