verses.translation: Devotion falls into the laps of those whom He so blesses.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਲਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar lakhiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be seen.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh har rahiaa samai ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen to be permeating and pervading everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੰਗਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gal maiaa moh upaiaa ||
verses.translation: Tuesday: The Lord created love and attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape sir sir dha(n)dhai laiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself has enjoined each and every being to their tasks.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap bujhaae soiee boojhai ||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh dhar ghar soojhai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one understands his heart and home.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat kare liv lai ||
verses.translation: He worships the Lord in loving devotion.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa sabadh jalai ||3||
verses.translation: His egotism and self-conceit are burnt away by the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੁਧਵਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: budhavaar aape budh saar ||
verses.translation: Wednesday: He Himself bestows sublime understanding.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh karanee sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh does good deeds, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate man niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind become pure and immaculate.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavai haumai mal khoi ||
verses.translation: He sings the Glorious Glorious Praises of the Lord, and washes off the filth of egotism.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਦ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhar sachai sadh sobhaa paae ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains lasting glory.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam rate gur sabadh suhaae ||4||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa naam paae gur dhuaar ||
verses.translation: The profit of the Naam is obtained through the Door of the Guru.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhevai dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver Himself gives it.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhevai tis kau bal jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the One who gives it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee aap gavaieeaai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart.

verses.original: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhevanahaare kau jaikaar ||5||
verses.translation: I celebrate the victory of the Lord, the Great Giver. ||5||

verses.original: ਵੀਰਵਾਰਿ ਵੀਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: veeravaar veer bharam bhulaae ||
verses.translation: Thursday: The fifty-two warriors were deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਭੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pret bhoot sabh dhoojai laae ||
verses.translation: All the goblins and demons are attached to duality.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵੇਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae kar vekhai vekaa ||
verses.translation: God Himself created them, and sees each one distinct.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa karate teree Tekaa ||
verses.translation: O Creator Lord, You are the Support of all.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t teree saranaiee ||
verses.translation: The beings and creatures are under Your protection.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: so milai jis laih milaiee ||6||
verses.translation: He alone meets You, whom You Yourself meet. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਵਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sukaravaar prabh rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: Friday: God is permeating and pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਭ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap upai sabh keemat paiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself created all, and appraises the value of all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su karai beechaar ||
verses.translation: One who become Gurmukh, contemplates the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)jam karanee hai kaar ||
verses.translation: He practices truth and self-restraint.

verses.original: ਵਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਤਾਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: varat nem nitaaprat poojaa || bin boojhe sabh bhaau hai dhoojaa ||7||
verses.translation: Without genuine understanding, all fasts, religious rituals and daily worship services lead only to the love of duality. ||7||

verses.original: ਛਨਿਛਰਵਾਰਿ ਸਉਣ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: chhanichharavaar saun saasat beechaar ||
verses.translation: Saturday: Contemplating good omens and the Shaastras,

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa bharamai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: in egotism and self-conceit, the world wanders in delusion.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dhaa dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukh in engrossed in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jam dhar baadhaa choTaa khai ||
verses.translation: Bound and gagged at death's door, he is beaten and punished.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sadhaa sukh paae ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one finds lasting peace.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sach karanee saach liv laae ||8||
verses.translation: He practices Truth, and lovingly focuses on the Truth. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh se vaddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar sach liv laagee ||
verses.translation: Conquering their ego, they embrace love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: terai ra(n)g raate sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: They are automatically imbued with Your Love, O Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: too sukhadhaataa laih milai ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of peace; You merge them into Yourself.

verses.original: ਏਕਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ekas te dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: Everything comes from the One and only Lord; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: gurmukh boojhai sojhee hoi ||9||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh realizes this, and understands. ||9||

verses.original: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਥਿਤਂੀ ਤੈ ਸਤ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)dhreh thita(n)ee tai sat vaar ||
verses.translation: The fifteen lunar days, the seven days of the week,

verses.original: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: maahaa rutee aaveh vaar vaar ||
verses.translation: the months, seasons, days and nights, come over and over again;

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhinas rain tivai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: so the world goes on.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gaun keeaa karataar ||
verses.translation: Coming and going were created by the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal saach rahiaa kal dhaar ||
verses.translation: The True Lord remains steady and stable, by His almighty power.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh boojhai ko sabadh veechaar ||10||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how rare is that Gurmukh who understands, and contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh aape sirasaT saaje ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord Himself formed the Universe.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t maiaa moh paaje ||
verses.translation: The beings and creatures are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai parapa(n)ch laage ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, they are attached to the illusory material world.

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaveh jaaveh mareh abhaage ||
verses.translation: The unfortunate ones die, and continue to come and go.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTiaai sojhee pai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: parapa(n)ch chookai sach samai ||1||
verses.translation: Then, the illusion of the material world is shattered, and one merges in Truth. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai masatak likhiaa lekh ||
verses.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa kai man vasiaa prabh ek ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - the One God abides within his mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: sirasaT upai aape sabh vekhai ||
verses.translation: He created the Universe, and He Himself beholds all.

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: koi na meTai terai lekhai ||
verses.translation: No one can erase Your record, Lord.

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik je ko kahai kahaae ||
verses.translation: If someone calls himself a Siddha or a seeker,

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bharame bhoolaa aavai jaae ||
verses.translation: he is deluded by doubt, and will continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevai so jan boojhai ||
verses.translation: That humble being alone understands, who serves the True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: haumai maare taa dhar soojhai ||2||
verses.translation: Conquering his ego, he finds the Lord's Door. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: ekas te sabh dhoojaa hooaa ||
verses.translation: From the One Lord, all others were formed.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: eko varatai avar na beeaa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੇ ਤੇ ਜੇ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhooje te je eko jaanai ||
verses.translation: Renouncing duality, one comes to know the One Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh har dhar neesaanai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one knows the Lord's Door, and His Banner.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTe taa eko paae ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one finds the One Lord.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vichahu dhoojaa Thaak rahaae ||3||
verses.translation: Duality is subdued within. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਡਾਢਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhaa saahib ddaaddaa hoi ||
verses.translation: One who belongs to the All-powerful Lord and Master

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis no maar na saakai koi ||
verses.translation: no one can destroy him.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saahib kee sevak rahai saranaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servant remains under His protection;

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase dhe vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself forgives him, and blesses him with glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis te uoopar naahee koi ||
verses.translation: There is none higher than Him.

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਡਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kaun ddarai ddar kis kaa hoi ||4||
verses.translation: Why should he be afraid? What should he ever fear? ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee saa(n)t vasai sareer ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace and tranquility abide within the body.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh cheeni(h) fir lagai na peer ||
verses.translation: Remember the Word of the Shabad, and you shall never suffer pain.

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aavai na jai naa dhukh paae ||
verses.translation: You shall not have to come or go, or suffer in sorrow.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naame raate sahaj samaae ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall merge in celestial peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh vekhai hadhoor ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present, close at hand.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh sadh rahiaa bharapoor ||5||
verses.translation: My God is always fully pervading everywhere. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eik sevak ik bharam bhulaae ||
verses.translation: Some are selfless servants, while others wander, deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape kare har aap karaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself does, and causes everything to be done.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eko varatai avar na koi ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is all-pervading; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man ros keejai je dhoojaa hoi ||
verses.translation: The mortal might complain, if there were any other.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve karanee saaree ||
verses.translation: Serve the True Guru; this is the most excellent action.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: dhar saachai saache veechaaree ||6||
verses.translation: In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be judged true. ||6||

verses.original: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: thitee vaar sabh sabadh suhaae ||
verses.translation: All the lunar days, and the days of the week are beautiful, when one contemplates the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve taa fal paae ||
verses.translation: If one serves the True Guru, he obtains the fruits of his rewards.

verses.original: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: thitee vaar sabh aaveh jaeh ||
verses.translation: The omens and days all come and go.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh nihachal sadhaa sach samaeh ||
verses.translation: But the Word of the Guru's Shabad is eternal and unchanging. Through it, one merges in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: thitee vaar taa jaa sach raate ||
verses.translation: The days are auspicious, when one is imbued with Truth.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin naavai sabh bharameh kaache ||7||
verses.translation: Without the Name, all the false ones wander deluded. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਬਿਗਤੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mareh mar bigatee jaeh ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs die, and dead, they fall into the most evil state.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ek na cheteh dhoojai lobhaeh ||
verses.translation: They do not remember the One Lord; they are deluded by duality.

verses.original: ਅਚੇਤ ਪਿੰਡੀ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: achet pi(n)ddee agiaan a(n)dhaar ||
verses.translation: The human body is unconscious, ignorant and blind.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai kiau paae paar ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over?

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae upaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself creates.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aape keeton gur veechaar ||8||
verses.translation: He Himself contemplates the Guru's Word. ||8||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bahute bhekh kareh bhekhadhaaree ||
verses.translation: The religious fanatics wear all sorts of religious robes.

verses.original: ਭਵਿ ਭਵਿ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਕਾਚੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhav bhav bharameh kaachee saaree ||
verses.translation: They roll around and wander around, like the false dice on the board.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai sukh na aagai hoi ||
verses.translation: They find no peace, here or hereafter.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਅਪਣਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mue apanaa janam khoi ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs waste away their lives, and die.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve bharam chukaae ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, doubt is driven away.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: ghar hee a(n)dhar sach mahal paae ||9||
verses.translation: Deep within the home of the heart, one finds the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence. ||9||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape pooraa kare su hoi ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Perfect Lord does, that alone happens.

verses.original: ਏਹਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eh thitee vaar dhoojaa dhoi ||
verses.translation: Concern with these omens and days leads only to duality.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur baajhahu a(n)dh gubaar ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

verses.original: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: thitee vaar seveh mugadh gavaar ||
verses.translation: Only idiots and fools worry about these omens and days.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh boojhai sojhee pai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains understanding and realization;

verses.original: ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
verses.translit: eikat naam sadhaa rahiaa samai ||10||2||
verses.translation: he remains forever merged in the Name of the One Lord. ||10||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਦਖਣੀ
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t dhakhanee
verses.translation: Bilaaval, First Mehla, Chhant, Dakhnee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਆ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh navelaReeaa goil aaiee raam ||
verses.translation: The young, innocent soul-bride has come to the pasture lands of the world.

verses.original: ਮਟੁਕੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: maTukee ddaar dharee har liv laiee raam ||
verses.translation: Laying aside her pitcher of worldly concern, she lovingly attunes herself to her Lord.

verses.original: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: liv lai har siau rahee goil sahaj sabadh seegaareeaa ||
verses.translation: She remains lovingly absorbed in the pasture of the Lord, automatically embellished with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar joR gur peh kar bina(n)tee milahu saach piaareeaa ||
verses.translation: With her palms pressed together, she prays to the Guru, to unite her with her True Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan bhai bhagatee dhekh preetam kaam karodh nivaariaa ||
verses.translation: Seeing His bride's loving devotion, the Beloved Lord eradicates unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak mu(n)dh navel su(n)dhar dhekh pir saadhaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the young, innocent bride is so beautiful; seeing her Husband Lord, she is comforted. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sach navelaRe'e joban baalee raam ||
verses.translation: Truthfully, O young soul-bride, your youth keeps you innocent.

verses.original: ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਉ ਕਹੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਹ ਨਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aau na jaau kahee apane seh naalee raam ||
verses.translation: Do not come and go anywhere; stay with your Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਹ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਮੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: naeh apane sa(n)g dhaasee mai bhagat har kee bhaave ||
verses.translation: I will stay with my Husband Lord; I am His hand-maiden. Devotional worship to the Lord is pleasing to me.

verses.original: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: agaadh bodh akath katheeaai sahaj prabh gun gaave ||
verses.translation: I know the unknowable, and speak the unspoken; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Celestial Lord God.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸੀਆ ਰਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam rasaal raseeaa ravai saach piaareeaa ||
verses.translation: She who chants and savors the taste of the Lord's Name is loved by the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh dheeaa dhaan keeaa naanakaa veechaareeaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru grants her the gift of the Shabad; O Nanak, she contemplates and reflects upon it. ||2||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sreedhar mohiaRee pir sa(n)g sootee raam ||
verses.translation: She who is fascinated by the Supreme Lord, sleeps with her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhai chalo saach sa(n)gootee raam ||
verses.translation: She walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, attuned to the Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan saach sa(n)gootee har sa(n)g sootee sa(n)g sakhee saheleeaa ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is attuned to the Truth, and sleeps with the Lord, along with her companions and sister soul-brides.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik bhai ik man naam vasiaa satiguroo ham meleeaa ||
verses.translation: Loving the One Lord, with one-pointed mind, the Naam dwells within; I am united with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: dhin rain ghaRee na chasaa visarai saas saas nira(n)jano ||
verses.translation: Day and night, with each and every breath, I do not forget the Immaculate Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabadh jot jagai dheepak naanakaa bhau bha(n)jano ||3||
verses.translation: So light the lamp of the Shabad, O Nanak, and burn away your fear. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਇੜੀਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jot sabaiRe'e tirabhavan saare raam ||
verses.translation: O soul-bride, the Lord's Light pervades all the three worlds.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT rav rahiaa alakh apaare raam ||
verses.translation: He is pervading each and every heart, the Invisible and Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: alakh apaar apaar saachaa aap maar milaieeaai ||
verses.translation: He is Invisible and Infinite, Infinite and True; subduing his self-conceit, one meets Him.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਾਲਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa lobh jaalahu sabadh mail chukaieeaai ||
verses.translation: So burn away your egotistical pride, attachment and greed, with the Word of the Shabad; wash away your filth.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhar jai dharasan karee bhaanai taar taaranahaariaa ||
verses.translation: When you go to the Lord's Door, you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; by His Will, the Savior will carry you across and save you.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naam a(n)mrit chaakh tirapatee naanakaa ur dhaariaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, the soul-bride is satisfied; O Nanak, she enshrines Him in her heart. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਣਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mai man chaau ghanaa saach vigaasee raam ||
verses.translation: My mind is filled with such a great joy; I have blossomed forth in Truth.

verses.original: ਮੋਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mohee prem pire prabh abinaasee raam ||
verses.translation: I am enticed by the love of my Husband Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God.

verses.original: ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: avigato har naath naatheh tisai bhaavai so theeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is everlasting, the Master of masters. Whatever He wills, happens.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaal sadhaa dhiaal dhaataa jeeaa a(n)dhar too(n) jeeaai ||
verses.translation: O Great Giver, You are always kind and compassionate. You infuse life into all living beings.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai avar giaan na dhiaan poojaa har naam a(n)tar vas rahe ||
verses.translation: I have no other spiritual wisdom, meditation or worship; the Name of the Lord alone dwells deep within me.

verses.original: ਭੇਖੁ ਭਵਨੀ ਹਠੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhekh bhavanee haTh na jaanaa naanakaa sach geh rahe ||1||
verses.translation: I know nothing about religious robes, pilgrimages or stubborn fanaticism; O Nanak, I hold tight to the Truth. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਿੰਨੜੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਲੀ ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhi(n)naRee rain bhalee dhinas suhaae raam ||
verses.translation: The night is beautiful, drenched with dew, and the day is delightful,

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਜਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar sootaRe'e piram jagaae raam ||
verses.translation: when her Husband Lord wakes the sleeping soul-bride, in the home of the self.

verses.original: ਨਵ ਹਾਣਿ ਨਵ ਧਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: nav haan nav dhan sabadh jaagee aapane pir bhaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: The young bride has awakened to the Word of the Shabad; she is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: taj kooR kapaT subhaau dhoojaa chaakaree lokaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: So renounce falsehood, fraud, love of duality and working for people.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai naam har kaa haar ka(n)The saach sabadh neesaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is my necklace, and I am anointed with the True Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar joR naanak saach maagai nadhar kar tudh bhaaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for the gift of the True Name; please, bless me with Your Grace, through the pleasure of Your Will. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਗੁ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jaag salonaRe'e bolai gurbaanee raam ||
verses.translation: Awake, O bride of splendored eyes, and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਅੜੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jin sun ma(n)niaRee akath kahaanee raam ||
verses.translation: Listen, and place your faith in the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਏ ॥
verses.translit: akath kahaanee padh nirabaanee ko viralaa gurmukh boojhe ||
verses.translation: The Unspoken Speech, the state of Nirvaanaa - how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਸੂਝਏ ॥
verses.translit: oh sabadh samaae aap gavaae tirabhavan sojhee soojhe ||
verses.translation: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, self-conceit is eradicated, and the three worlds are revealed to her understanding.

verses.original: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: rahai ateet apara(n)par raataa saach man gun saariaa ||
verses.translation: Remaining detached, with infinity infusing, the true mind cherishes the virtues of the Lord.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oh poor rahiaa sarab Thaiee naanakaa ur dhaariaa ||3||
verses.translation: He is fully pervading and permeating all places; Nanak has enshrined Him within his heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇੜੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mahal bulaiRe'e bhagat sanehee raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord is calling you to the Mansion of His Presence; O soul-bride, He is the Lover of His devotees.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat man rahasee seejhas dhehee raam ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, your mind shall be delighted, and your body shall be fulfilled.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਰੀਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਝੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
verses.translit: man maar reejhai sabadh seejhai trai lok naath pachhaane ||
verses.translation: Conquer and subdue your mind, and love the Word of the Shabad; reform yourself, and realize the Lord of the three worlds.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
verses.translit: man ddeeg ddol na jai kat hee aapanaa pir jaane ||
verses.translation: Her mind shall not waver or wander anywhere else, when she comes to know her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਖਸਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੇਰਓ ॥
verses.translit: mai aadhaar teraa too khasam meraa mai taan takeeaa tero ||
verses.translation: You are my only Support, You are my Lord and Master. You are my strength and anchor.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਝਗਰੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਓ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: saach soochaa sadhaa naanak gur sabadh jhagar nibero ||4||2||
verses.translation: She is forever truthful and pure, O Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conflicts are resolved. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਮੰਗਲ
verses.translit: chha(n)t bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ma(n)gal
verses.translation: Chhant, Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: meraa har prabh sejai aaiaa man sukh samaanaa raam ||
verses.translation: My Lord God has come to my bed, and my mind is merged with the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur tuThai har prabh paiaa ra(n)g raleeaa maanaa raam ||
verses.translation: As it pleases the Guru, I have found the Lord God, and I revel and delight in His Love.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaageeaa sohaaganee har masatak maanaa raam ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate are those happy soul-brides, who have the jewel of the Naam upon their foreheads.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har prabh har sohaag hai naanak man bhaanaa raam ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Lord God, is Nanak's Husband Lord, pleasing to his mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)maaniaa har maan hai har prabh har aapai raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the honor of the dishonored. The Lord, the Lord God is Himself by Himself.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aap gavaiaa nit har har jaapai raam ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh eradicates self-conceit, and constantly chants the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mere har prabh bhaavai so karai har ra(n)g har raapai raam ||
verses.translation: My Lord God does whatever He pleases; the Lord imbues mortal beings with the color of His Love.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak sahaj milaiaa har ras har dhraapai raam ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is easily merged into the Celestial Lord. He is satisfied with the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵਣ ਵੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: maanas janam har paieeaai har raavan veraa raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord is found only through this human incarnation. This is the time to contemplate the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mil sohaaganee ra(n)g hoi ghaneraa raam ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukhs, the happy soul-brides meet Him, and their love for Him is abundant.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jin maanas janam na paiaa tin(h) bhaag ma(n)dheraa raam ||
verses.translation: Those who have not attained human incarnation, are cursed by evil destiny.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har har har raakh prabh naanak jan teraa raam ||3||
verses.translation: O Lord, God, Har, Har, Har, Har, save Nanak; he is Your humble servant. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur har prabh agam dhiraRaiaa man tan ra(n)g bheenaa raam ||
verses.translation: The Guru has implanted within me the Name of the Inaccessible Lord God; my mind and body are drenched with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal har naam hai gurmukh har leenaa raam ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; the Gurmukhs attain the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bin har naam na jeevadhe jiau jal bin meenaa raam ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, they cannot even live, like the fish without water.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: safal janam har paiaa naanak prabh keenaa raam ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: Finding the Lord, my life has become fruitful; O Nanak, the Lord God has fulfilled me. ||4||1||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa salok ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Shalok:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh sajan loR lahu man vasai vaddabhaag ||
verses.translation: Seek out the Lord God, your only true Friend. He shall dwell in your mind, by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poorai vekhaaliaa naanak har liv laag ||1||
verses.translation: The True Guru shall reveal Him to you; O Nanak, lovingly focus yourself on the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਈਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: meraa har prabh raavan aaieeaa haumai bikh jhaage raam ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride has come to ravish and enjoy her Lord God, after eradicating the poison of egotism.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat aap miTaiaa har har liv laage raam ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, she has eliminated her self-conceit; she is lovingly attuned to her Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kamal paragaasiaa gur giaanee jaage raam ||
verses.translation: Her heart-lotus deep within has blossomed forth, and through the Guru, spiritual wisdom has been awakened within her.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har prabh paiaa poorai vaddabhaage raam ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has found the Lord God, by perfect, great good fortune. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਧਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh har man bhaiaa har naam vadhaiee raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Lord God, is pleasing to her mind; the Lord's Name resounds within her.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai prabh paiaa har har liv laiee raam ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, God is obtained; she is lovingly focused on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan a(n)dheraa kaTiaa jot paragaTiaaiee raam ||
verses.translation: The darkness of ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light radiantly shines forth.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam adhaar hai har naam samaiee raam ||2||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Nanak's only Support; he merges into the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਰਾਵੀਆ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhan har prabh piaarai raaveeaa jaa(n) har prabh bhaiee raam ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is ravished and enjoyed by her Beloved Lord God, when the Lord God is pleased with her.

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਈਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਲਕ ਮਸਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: akhee prem kasaieeaa jiau bilak masaiee raam ||
verses.translation: My eyes are drawn to His Love, like the cat to the mouse.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har meliaa har ras aaghaiee raam ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord; I am satisfied by the subtle essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam vigasiaa har har liv laiee raam ||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is lovingly attuned to the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ham moorakh mugadh milaiaa har kirapaa dhaaree raam ||
verses.translation: I am a fool and an idiot, but the Lord showered me with His Mercy, and united me with Himself.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n guroo saabaas hai jin haumai maaree raam ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the most wonderful Guru, who has conquered egotism.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) vaddabhaageeaa vaddabhaag hai har har ur dhaaree raam ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate, of blessed destiny are those, who enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam salaeh too naame balihaaree raam ||4||2||4||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, and be a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੰਗਲ ਸਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gal saaj bhiaa prabh apanaa gaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: The time of rejoicing has come; I sing of my Lord God.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਵਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਚਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: abinaasee var suniaa man upajiaa chaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: I have heard of my Imperishable Husband Lord, and happiness fills my mind.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: man preet laagai vaddai bhaagai kab mileeaai pooran pate ||
verses.translation: My mind is in love with Him; when shall I realize my great good fortune, and meet with my Perfect Husband?

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje samaieeaai govi(n)dh paieeaai dheh sakhe'ee moh mate ||
verses.translation: If only I could meet the Lord of the Universe, and be automatically absorbed into Him; tell me how, O my companions!

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਠਾਢੀ ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhin rain Thaaddee karau sevaa prabh kavan jugatee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Day and night, I stand and serve my God; how can I attain Him?

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੈਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa laih moh laR laiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, have mercy on me, and attach me to the hem of Your robe, O Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਇਆ ਸਮਾਹੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhiaa samaahaRaa har ratan visaahaa raam ||
verses.translation: Joy has come! I have purchased the jewel of the Lord.

verses.original: ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: khojee khoj ladhaa har sa(n)tan paahaa raam ||
verses.translation: Searching, the seeker has found the Lord with the Saints.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: mile sa(n)t piaare dhiaa dhaare katheh akath beechaaro ||
verses.translation: I have met the Beloved Saints, and they have blessed me with their kindness; I contemplate the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: eik chit ik man dhiaai suaamee lai preet piaaro ||
verses.translation: With my consciousness centered, and my mind one-pointed, I meditate on my Lord and Master, with love and affection.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar joR prabh peh kar bina(n)tee milai har jas laahaa ||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, I pray unto God, to bless me with the profit of the Lord's Praise.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhaas teraa meraa prabh agam athaahaa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. My God is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਗਣਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: saahaa aTal ganiaa pooran sa(n)jogo raam ||
verses.translation: The date for my wedding is set, and cannot be changed; my union with the Lord is perfect.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਭਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sukheh samooh bhiaa giaa vijogo raam ||
verses.translation: I am totally at peace, and my separation from Him has ended.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਏ ਬਣੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਜਾਞੀਆਂ ॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)t aae prabh dhiaae bane acharaj jaan(j)eeaa(n) ||
verses.translation: The Saints meet and come together, and meditate on God; they form a wondrous wedding party.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਢੋਏ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਮਾਞੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil ikatr hoe sahaj ddoe man preet upajee maan(j)eeaa ||
verses.translation: Gathering together, they arrive with poise and grace, and love fills the minds of the bride's family.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: mil jot jotee ot potee har naam sabh ras bhogo ||
verses.translation: Her light blends with His Light, through and through, and everyone enjoys the Nectar of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਤਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sabh sa(n)t melee prabh karan kaaran jogo ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the Saints have totally united me with God, the All-powerful Cause of causes. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਵਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhavan suhaavaRaa dharat sabhaagee raam ||
verses.translation: Beautiful is my home, and beauteous is the earth.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਅੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ghar aaiaRaa gur charanee laagee raam ||
verses.translation: God has entered the home of my heart; I touch the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur charan laagee sahaj jaagee sagal ichhaa pu(n)neeaa ||
verses.translation: Grasping the Guru's feet, I awake in peace and poise. All my desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: meree aas pooree sa(n)t dhooree har mile ka(n)t vichhu(n)niaa ||
verses.translation: My hopes are fulfilled, through the dust of the feet of the Saints. After such a long separation, I have met my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਹੰ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh anadhin vajeh vaaje aha(n) mat man kee tiaagee ||
verses.translation: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; I have forsaken my stubborn-minded intellect.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee sa(n)tasa(n)g liv laagee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; in the Society of the Saints, I am lovingly attuned to Him. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਾਗ ਸੁਲਖਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhaag sulakhanaa har ka(n)t hamaaraa raam ||
verses.translation: By blessed destiny, I have found my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh baajitraa tis dhun dharabaaraa raam ||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh anadhin vajeh vaaje dhinas rain umaahaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; day and night, I am enraptured.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh rog sog na dhookh biaapai janam maran na taahaa ||
verses.translation: Disease, sorrow and suffering do not afflict anyone there; there is no birth or death there.

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ridh sidh sudhaa ras a(n)mrit bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: There are treasures overflowing there - wealth, miraculous powers, ambrosial nectar and devotional worship.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਵੰਞਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak balihaar va(n)n(j)aa paarabraham praan adhaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am a sacrifice, devoted to the Supreme Lord God, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਅ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sun sakheea sahelaReeho mil ma(n)gal gaaveh raam ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my companions, and sister soul-brides, let's join together and sing the songs of joy.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਰਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: man tan prem kare tis prabh kau raaveh raam ||
verses.translation: Loving our God with mind and body, let's ravish and enjoy Him.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਾਵਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵਹ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kar prem raaveh tisai bhaaveh ik nimakh palak na tiaageeaai ||
verses.translation: Lovingly enjoying Him, we become pleasing to Him; let's not reject Him, for a moment, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਨਹ ਲਜਾਈਐ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਗੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: geh ka(n)Th laieeaai neh lajaieeaai charan raj man paageeaai ||
verses.translation: Let's hug Him close in our embrace, and not feel shy; let's bathe our minds in the dust of His feet.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਮੋਹਹ ਅਨਤ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਧਾਵਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat Thagauree pai moheh anat katahoo na dhaaveh ||
verses.translation: With the intoxicating drug of devotional worship, let's entice Him, and not wander anywhere else.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਅਮਰ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak mil sa(n)g saajan amar padhavee paaveh ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, meeting with our True Friend, we attain the immortal status. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bisaman bisam bhiee pekh gun abinaasee raam ||
verses.translation: I am wonder-struck and amazed, gazing upon the Glories of my Imperishable Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kar geh bhujaa gahee kaT jam kee faasee raam ||
verses.translation: He took my hand, and held my arm, and cut away the noose of Death.

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੑੀ ਦਾਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਅੰਕੁਰਿ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: geh bhujaa leen(h)ee dhaas keen(h)ee a(n)kur udhot janaiaa ||
verses.translation: Holding me by the arm, He made me His slave; the branch has sprouted in abundance.

verses.original: ਮਲਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਦਿਵਸ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: malan moh bikaar naaThe dhivas niramal aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Pollution, attachment and corruption have run away; the immaculate day has dawned.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT dhaaree man piaaree mahaa dhuramat naasee ||
verses.translation: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord loves me with His Mind; my immense evil-mindedness is dispelled.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak bhiee niramal prabh mile abinaasee ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I have become immaculate and pure; I have met the Imperishable Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਹੂਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sooraj kiran mile jal kaa jal hooaa raam ||
verses.translation: The rays of light merge with the sun, and water merges with water.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲੀ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jotee jot ralee sa(n)pooran theeaa raam ||
verses.translation: One's light blends with the Light, and one becomes totally perfect.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: braham dheesai braham suneeaai ek ek vakhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: I see God, hear God, and speak of the One and only God.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aatam pasaaraa karanahaaraa prabh binaa nahee jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: The soul is the Creator of the expanse of creation. Without God, I know no other at all.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap kaaran keeaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He created the Creation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak seiee jaaneh jin(h)ee har ras peeaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, they alone know this, who drink in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਅਸੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee aau sakhee vas aau sakhee asee pir kaa ma(n)gal gaaveh ||
verses.translation: Come, O my sisters, come, O my companions, and let us remain under the Lord's control. Let's sing the Songs of Bliss of our Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਤੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਵਹ ॥
verses.translit: taj maan sakhee taj maan sakhee mat aapane preetam bhaaveh ||
verses.translation: Renounce your pride, O my companions, renounce your egotistical pride, O my sisters, so that you may become pleasing to your Beloved.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: taj maan moh bikaar dhoojaa sev ek nira(n)jano ||
verses.translation: Renounce pride, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, and serve the One Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਲਗੁ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਤ ਬਿਖੰਡਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: lag charan saran dhiaal preetam sagal dhurat bikha(n)ddano ||
verses.translation: Hold tight to the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Merciful Lord, your Beloved, the Destroyer of all sins.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਿਧੀ ਨ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: hoi dhaas dhaasee taj udhaasee bahuR bidhee na dhaavaa ||
verses.translation: Be the slave of His slaves, forsake sorrow and sadness, and do not bother with other devices.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai karahu kirapaa taam ma(n)gal gaavaa ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, O Lord, please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may sing Your songs of bliss. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit pria kaa naam mai a(n)dhule Tohanee ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of my Beloved, is like a cane to a blind man.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਜੋਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: oh johai bahu parakaar su(n)dhar mohanee ||
verses.translation: Maya seduces in so many ways, like a beautiful enticing woman.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: mohanee mahaa bachitr cha(n)chal anik bhaav dhikhaave ||
verses.translation: This enticer is so incredibly beautiful and clever; she entices with countless suggestive gestures.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਢੀਠ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਣ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: hoi ddeeTh meeThee maneh laagai naam lain na aave ||
verses.translation: Maya is stubborn and persistent; she seems so sweet to the mind, and then he does not chant the Naam.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਹਿ ਤੀਰੈ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟੈ ਜੋਹਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gireh baneh teerai barat poojaa baaT ghaaTai johanee ||
verses.translation: At home, in the forest, on the banks of sacred rivers, fasting, worshipping, on the roads and on the shore, she is spying.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai dhiaa dhaarahu mai naam a(n)dhule Tohanee ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, please bless me with Your Kindness, Lord; I am blind, and Your Name is my cane. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: moh anaath pria naath jiau jaanahu tiau rakhahu ||
verses.translation: I am helpless and masterless; You, O my Beloved, are my Lord and Master. As it pleases You, so do You protect me.

verses.original: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaturaiee moh naeh reejhaavau keh mukhahu ||
verses.translation: I have no wisdom or cleverness; what face should I put on to please You?

verses.original: ਨਹ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਸੁਘਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਬੇਤੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: neh chatur sughar sujaan betee moh niragun gun nahee ||
verses.translation: I am not clever, skillful or wise; I am worthless, without any virtue at all.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਨੈਣ ਬੰਕੇ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: neh roop dhoop na nain ba(n)ke jeh bhaavai teh rakh tuhee ||
verses.translation: I have no beauty or pleasing smell, no beautiful eyes. As it pleases You, please preserve me, O Lord.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਜਇਅੰਪਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਲਖਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai jia(n)peh sagal jaa kau karunaapat gat kin lakhahu ||
verses.translation: His victory is celebrated by all; how can I know the state of the Lord of Mercy?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਹੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai sev sevak jiau jaanahu tiau moh rakhahu ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am the servant of Your servants; as it pleases You, please preserve me. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੁਮ ਨੀਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: moh machhulee tum neer tujh bin kiau sarai ||
verses.translation: I am the fish, and You are the water; without You, what can I do?

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੂੰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: moh chaatirak tum(h) boo(n)dh tirapatau mukh parai ||
verses.translation: I am the rainbird, and You are the rain-drop; when it falls into my mouth, I am satisfied.

verses.original: ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਹੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: mukh parai harai piaas meree jeea heeaa praanapate ||
verses.translation: When it falls into my mouth, my thirst is quenched; You are the Lord of my soul, my heart, my breath of life.

verses.original: ਲਾਡਿਲੇ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: laaddile laadd laddai sabh meh mil hamaaree hoi gate ||
verses.translation: Touch me, and caress me, O Lord, You are in all; let me meet You, so that I may be emancipated.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਿਟੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਆਸ ਚਕਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: cheet chitavau miT a(n)dhaare jiau aas chakavee dhin charai ||
verses.translation: In my consciousness I remember You, and the darkness is dispelled, like the chakvi duck, which longs to see the dawn.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai pria sa(n)g melee machhulee neer na veesarai ||4||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, O my Beloved, please unite me with Yourself; the fish never forgets the water. ||4||

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਭਾਗ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n hamaare bhaag ghar aaiaa pir meraa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is my destiny; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

verses.original: ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਸਗਲਾ ਬਨੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sohe ba(n)k dhuaar sagalaa ban haraa ||
verses.translation: The gate of my mansion is so beautiful, and all my gardens are so green and alive.

verses.original: ਹਰ ਹਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: har haraa suaamee sukheh gaamee anadh ma(n)gal ras ghanaa ||
verses.translation: My peace-giving Lord and Master has rejuvenated me, and blessed me with great joy, bliss and love.

verses.original: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਭਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: naval navatan naahu baalaa kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
verses.translation: My Young Husband Lord is eternally young, and His body is forever youthful; what tongue can I use to chant His Glorious Praises?

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਸਗਲ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: meree sej sohee dhekh mohee sagal sahasaa dhukh haraa ||
verses.translation: My bed is beautiful; gazing upon Him, I am fascinated, and all my doubts and pains are dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai meree aas pooree mile suaamee apara(n)paraa ||5||1||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; my Lord and Master is unlimited. ||5||1||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਮੰਗਲ
verses.translit: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ma(n)gal
verses.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chhant, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar saa(n)t dhiaal prabh sarab sukhaa nidh peeau ||
verses.translation: God is beautiful, tranquil and merciful; He is the treasure of absolute peace, my Husband Lord.
